Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू का पहला केस: 2 साल की बच्ची निकली पॉजिटिव, अलर्ट मोड पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of swine flu: 2-year-old girl tests positive, health department on high alert.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed swine flu case (H1N1) in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, during the monsoon season. A 2-year-11-month-old girl was admitted with two days of high fever and flu-like symptoms; RT-PCR testing confirmed H1N1 infection at a private hospital. Civil Surgeon Dr. Ashish Kumar Minj stated the health department has activated alert and intensified surveillance at the patient’s home and surrounding areas, including house-to-house checks and sampling of family members to detect secondary infections and trace contacts. Transmission is via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking, with children under five at higher risk for severe illness and crowded places driving spread. Authorities will maintain monitoring to prevent community transmission; the report does not denote additional cases beyond this single confirmed infection.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフル最初の症例:2歳の女児が陽性反応、保健部門が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1単発症例であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の兆候がないため、現時点でのシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: インド・チャッティースガル州ドゥルグ地区で単発のH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例が確認され、保健当局が接触者調査と監視を強化しているのみで、地域的・国際的な拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: राज्यात साथीच्या आजाराचे थैमान; १२ हजारांहून अधिक मलेरियाची रुग्ण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contagious diseases ravage the state; over 12,000 malaria patients.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 August 2026, Maharashtra reports rising vector-borne diseases amid monsoon rains. Malaria stands at 12,219 statewide (4,393 P. falciparum) with 2 deaths; Mumbai leads overall, Gadchiroli district recording the largest malaria burden (3,426 cases; 2,754 Pf). In the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, malaria totals 6,339 (Pf 1,200); Thane 502; Panvel 394; Mira-Bhayandar 100. Dengue reaches 6,379 cases with 3 deaths; Mumbai city area reports 1,810; Pune 1,140; Thane 450; Palghar 240; Pune district 193; Dhule 148; Latur 126. Chikungunya has 1,093 cases, led by Palghar (264); Pune district 138; Latur 56; Dhule 55; urban pockets show Pune city 71, Mumbai 61, Akola 41, Kolhapur 34. Mumbai remains a major hotspot; sustained monsoon vector control and prompt fever investigations are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で伝染病が猛威;マラリア患者12,000人超
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州でマラリア・デング・チクングニアの季節性増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の公衆衛生負荷としては注視が必要。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の季節性ベクター媒介感染症（マラリア、デング、チクングニア）の増加であり、既知のパターン。死亡例あり（マラリア2件、デング3件）で重症度は一定程度あるが、異常性・国際拡大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Court orders compensation of Rs 96,500 for food poisoning caused by stale Al Faham
article.articleSummary: Salmonella infection from stale Al Faham caused food poisoning in Pathanamthitta, Kerala. On Oct 21, 2025, Reena Thomas of Vechoochira and her sister were hospitalised after eating at Kings Biryani Cafe, Chethomkara, Ranni, with tests confirming Salmonella from stale food. The hotel allegedly ignored the stale-food complaint and charged Rs 740. Reena filed a complaint with the Pathanamthitta consumer dispute redressal commission against owner Ashish John Mathew and the manager. The bench of Babychan Vechoochira and Nishad Thankappan ordered compensation of Rs 96,500 to be paid within 30 days, comprising Rs 36,500 for hospital expenses, Rs 50,000 for physical and mental suffering, and Rs 10,000 in court costs. No fatalities are reported; the case centers on consumer dispute over unsafe food and medical costs. The published date is 2026-08-23.

triage.headline_ja: 腐敗したアル・ファハムによる食中毒に対し、9万6500ルピーの賠償を裁判所が命令
triage.triage_reason: 単一のレストランでの個別の食中毒事案に関する消費者紛争裁判の判決報道であり、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威や流行性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 個人2名の食中毒（サルモネラ）に関する消費者裁判の結果報告であり、疫学的なアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。Bihar州の地名も発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はKerala州の事案のみを扱っている。

article.articleHeadline: Avec les femmes congolaises, face à l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With Congolese women, facing the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: East of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak. The United Nations warns that women are at greater risk of infection and death from the virus. The report recalls that between 2018 and 2020, during the largest Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC, women were disproportionately affected. The story is presented as a video feature highlighting the human impact in the region. No specific case counts are provided in the excerpt. This ongoing outbreak highlights gendered vulnerability in affected communities and the continued public health risk posed by Ebola in eastern DRC. The article centers on the current outbreak in the eastern part of the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に立ち向かうコンゴ人女性たち
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR/WPRO基準における重症度・流行可能性が高く、国連が女性への感染・死亡リスク増大を警告するなど社会的関心も認められるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の第17次エボラ流行に関する人道的視点の映像特集であり、新規症例数などの定量データは含まれていないが、国連が女性の脆弱性について警告しており継続監視の価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Woman develops Salmonella infection after eating at cafe, gets hospitalised for a week; Consumer commission orders outlet to pay Rs 96,500 including hospital expenses
article.articleSummary: Salmonella infection linked to a Kerala cafe case: A woman from Vechoochira, Kerala, fell ill after eating alfaham at King's Biriyani Cafe in Chethonkara, Ranni, on Oct 21, 2025. She experienced vomiting, stomach pain, dizziness and weakness, requiring a week-long hospital stay. Doctors diagnosed Salmonella infection, attributed to undercooked or stale food. She filed a complaint with the Pathanamthitta District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission; the cafe proprietor Ashish John Mathew and the manager were directed to jointly pay Rs 96,500 within 30 days, covering Rs 36,500 hospital expenses, Rs 50,000 compensation and Rs 10,000 litigation costs. The commission found the allegations substantiated after reviewing discharge summaries and statements; the manager did not appear. The cafe had offered Rs 6,000 earlier, which was not accepted. No broader outbreak details were reported.

triage.headline_ja: 女性がカフェで食事後にサルモネラ感染症を発症、1週間入院；消費者委員会が店舗に病院費用を含む96,500ルピーの支払いを命令
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人の食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性は認められず、消費者紛争処理の結果を報じる記事に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidとあるが、記事内容はSalmonella食中毒の単一症例であり、広域的なアウトブレイクの記載はない。単一個人の事例であり対象国のイベントとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế: Tăng cường giám sát, hạn chế thấp nhất ca tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: Strengthen surveillance to minimize rabies-related deaths.
article.articleSummary: Rabies surveillance in Vietnam shows 34 rabies deaths nationwide from January to June 2026, down 10 versus the same period in 2025, with the Southern region reporting 23 deaths. To support World Rabies Day on September 28, 2026, the Ministry of Health urges provincial health authorities to coordinate with veterinary services to implement practical activities, raise community awareness (including schools), and focus on prevention in high-risk areas. Emphasis on immediate wound washing and seeking medical care for post-exposure management, including timely rabies vaccination and, when indicated, rabies immunoglobulin; clinics should follow risk assessment, wound treatment, and post-exposure prophylaxis protocols. Strengthened surveillance for exposure events is requested to minimize fatalities. Global data from WOAH/OIE: 99% of human rabies cases result from dog bites; >95% of deaths occur in Asia and Africa; >80% in rural areas; around 40% of deaths occur in children. Rabies is nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset; preventive care is essential.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：狂犬病による死亡を最小限に抑えるため監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向。世界狂犬病デーに向けた通常の啓発・監視強化に関する行政広報であり、異常な増加や新規性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナム保健省による定期的な狂犬病監視状況報告および世界狂犬病デー（9月28日）に向けた啓発呼びかけであり、死亡者数は前年より減少している。国際的関心や渡航制限等の要素はなく、既知の風土病に関する通常業務的内容と判断。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : à Beni, une caravane de jeunes contre Ebola et la désinformation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Beni, a caravan of young people against Ebola and disinformation.
article.articleSummary: In Beni, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a youth-led caravan on bicycles and on foot mobilizes to raise awareness about Ebola, restore trust in health teams, and counter disinformation amid an Ebola response strained by insecurity. The campaign, organized with Congolese NGOs and the World Health Organization, follows violent incidents including attacks on burial teams and arson of treatment centers in affected zones. Officials warn that worsening security coincides with Ebola transmission, and that rumors and fear fuel distrust of responders. Organizers stress the need for sustained community engagement, with some youths opposing intervention teams and hindering operations. As the epicenter of the 2018–2020 outbreak, Beni again faces Ebola threats, and authorities urge ongoing local participation to slow transmission and protect health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ベニで、エボラとデマ情報に対抗する若者のキャラバン
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部ベニで治安悪化を背景にエボラ伝播が継続しており、埋葬チームへの襲撃や治療センター放火など対応活動を阻害する事態が発生。WHO関与や外部支援の必要性も示唆されており、重篤な疾患であることからフルRRAが妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生報告ではなく、既存のエボラ対応における治安悪化・住民の不信感対策に関するもの。具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はないが、継続中の伝播と対応の困難さが示唆されているためPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: lourd bilan après cent jours d'une épidémie toujours pas maîtrisée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Grim toll after 100 days of an outbreak still not under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 100 days with six provinces affected and roughly 55 health zones now involved, indicating rapid spread beyond the initial outbreak area declared on May 15. The current epidemic is attributed to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, differing from the previously familiar Zaire strain, contributing to late detection. International financial support has been substantial: promises total about US$1 billion, with Africa CDC reporting roughly US$700 million already mobilized by partners for field actors and NGOs. Fund management is framed as the RDC government’s responsibility, per Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya. The response is supported by WHO, and its Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated on August 22 that all actors must intensify efforts to eradicate the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国 100日経っても制御できない流行の深刻な被害状況
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州・55保健地域に拡大し、100日経過しても制御できていない深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 通常のザイール株と異なるブンディブギョ株による流行で検出が遅れたことが拡大要因。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが国際支援を主導しており、資金管理はDRC政府の責任とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Le prime dosi del vaccino contro ebola sono arrivate nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first doses of the Ebola vaccine have arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to combat an outbreak that began in May, with 2,557 deaths to date—the deadliest and most contagious in the country's history. The World Health Organization has 70,000 doses available, with shipments due in coming weeks. About 20,000 doses will be used in a patient-treatment trial, and 50,000 for health-care workers. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less-studied species with no specific vaccine; Ervebo, used against other Ebola species, may offer protection, but confirmation for Bundibugyo is lacking. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and potentially severe bleeding. Containment relies on early identification and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの初回分がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最も致死率・感染力の高いエボラ流行（死者2,557人）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 原因ウイルスはBundibugyo ebolavirusであり、既存ワクチン（Ervebo、通常のZaire種向け）の有効性は未確認。WHOが70,000回分のワクチンを供給予定であり、国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: मेरठ में मिल चुके 4200 एचआइवी-एड्स संक्रमित, जांच के लिए उच्च प्राथमिकता वाले नौ शहरों में मेरठ भी - meerut records 4200 hiv cases i scan campaign launched
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meerut records 4,200 HIV-AIDS infections; Meerut among nine high-priority cities for testing; HIV testing campaign launched.
article.articleSummary: As of August 23, 2026, Meerut records 4,200 HIV/AIDS patients and is among nine high-priority cities for HIV testing under the National AIDS Control Organization's iScan campaign. From August 24 to September 30, 200 villages will host open meetings, distributing 30 QR-code pamphlets per village to enable self-risk assessment; individuals with elevated risk are advised to visit the nearest center for free testing. District TB Officer Dr. Vipul Kumar says the iScan QR code has been launched. HIV/AIDS remains incurable, but correct information and early detection are key. The QR-based tool aims to identify new cases in the district for timely treatment initiation. The nine prioritized cities include Meerut, Lucknow, Kanpur, Ghaziabad, and Varanasi, reflecting substantial cross-traffic of outsiders and justifying targeted testing to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: メーラトで4,200件のHIV/AIDS感染確認、検査のための優先9都市にメーラトも含まれる—iScanキャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症であるHIV/AIDSに関する通常の公衆衛生キャンペーンの報道であり、突発的・異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 国家AIDS対策機構(NACO)によるHIV検査促進のための通常の公衆衛生プログラムに関する報道であり、突発的な感染症アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola para el que no hay vacuna: cómo el brote de Congo vuelve a poner a prueba al continente africano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola for which there is no vaccine: how the Congo outbreak is testing the African continent once again
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has surpassed 5,200 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths as of August 18, 2026—roughly 100 days after declaration. It is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-deadliest in Africa after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, with rapid spread from the Ituri epicenter to six provinces and 55 health zones. Bundibugyo differs from Ebola virus (EBOV); vaccines and antibodies effective against EBOV are not proven for Bundibugyo. The WHO and Africa CDC are shipping 70,000 Ervebo doses to Congo—20,000 for a Phase 3 trial and 50,000 for frontline workers—though their effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are entering human trials. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days. More than 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers, highlighting gaps in detection, isolation, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンのないエボラ出血熱：コンゴの流行がアフリカ大陸を再び試練にさらす
triage.triage_reason: DRCで最大・最多死者数のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo型）が発生し、有効なワクチン未確立のまま6州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Ituriを起点に6州55保健地区）での流行のみが述べられており、Angolaでの発生には言及がないため除外した。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスは既存のEBOV用ワクチン・抗体の有効性が未確認であり、規模・死亡率ともに西アフリカ流行に次ぐ深刻さである点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: The desperate race to contain Ebola in DR Congo as deadly outbreak reaches 100 days
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 100 days. With more than 5,000 confirmed infections and over 2,500 deaths, it is the deadliest and fastest-growing Ebola crisis in the DRC, spreading beyond Ituri and North Kivu; more than half of deaths occur outside treatment centres, and four in five new infections are detected outside known transmission chains, signaling surveillance gaps. The Bundibugyo strain drives rapid spread, with little treatment or cure; it surpasses the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak and the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. WHO suspects spread since February, though officially declared May 15. Over 160 health workers infected (43 dead); 260+ attacks on responders (eight killed). Women now make up 53% of cases (18–49); almost 180 children have lost a parent or caregiver, and 63,700 pregnant women are affected. Funding shortfalls and conflict threaten the response, as disbursement remains well under pledged amounts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ発生から100日、封じ込めへの必死の闘い
triage.triage_reason: 5000人超の感染、2500人超の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、監視網の外での感染拡大や国際的拡大リスクが高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）のみが主題として言及されており、アンゴラでの発生は確認されない。対象国リストにアンゴラは含まれないため除外。史上最悪級の流行で、資金不足・紛争・攻撃も response を脅かしている。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट की सर्वाधिक प्रभावित पंचायत अडोरी, जहां आठ बैगा बच्चों की मौत, वहां सिर्फ एक एएनएम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adori, Balaghat's most affected panchayat, where eight Baiga children died and there is only one ANM.
article.articleSummary: Adori panchayat in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, is the epicenter of an outbreak that has killed eight Baiga children, with only one Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) serving the area. Notable cases include Sachin, a 5-year-old who fell ill on 25 July and died on 1 August after incurring ~₹70,000 in medical costs across a district hospital and a private facility in Gondia; his family received just ₹20,000 in compensation. Sachin was vaccinated at 10–11 months, but vaccination teams have not visited since. Puja Dhurve, aged 1 year 9 months, died on 26 July; her death is not recorded in government records, though the village head provided ₹5,000. Government departments only began field visits after rising deaths; handpump cleaning and chlorination are underway, while a halted drinking-water scheme forces residents to rely on zhiriya water. As of 23 August 2026, gaps in surveillance and public health response persist.

triage.headline_ja: バラガートの最も被害を受けたパンチャーヤト、アドリで8人のバイガ族の子どもが死亡、ANMは1人のみ
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデシュ州のバイガ族居住地域で原因不明の疾患により子ども8人が死亡し、医療体制・監視体制の不備が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 原因不明の疾患による児童の集団死亡事例。給水設備の停止・塩素消毒未実施等から水系感染症の可能性が示唆されるが、病原体は特定されていない。チャド関連の地名はBluedotの誤タグと判断し除外。続報で原因病原体の特定状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors caution against indiscriminate antibiotic use as monsoon-related illnesses rise - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: In India amid rising monsoon-related illnesses, doctors warn against self-medication with antibiotics, as fever signals illness type rather than bacterial infection. Viral illnesses, dengue, malaria, and typhoid can present with fever; antibiotic use when not indicated fuels side effects and antimicrobial resistance (AMR), which is already complicating clinical care. Treatment must follow clinical assessment, illness duration, symptoms, and indicated diagnostics. Do not reuse leftover antibiotics or take others' prescriptions; antibiotics should not be started, stopped, or dose-modified without medical advice. If fever persists or worsens, or if breathing difficulty, altered consciousness, severe dehydration, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or marked weakness occur, seek prompt medical evaluation. ICMR guidelines stress appropriate antibiotic selection and caution against indiscriminate empirical therapy when bacterial infection isn't established. Clinicians at AIIMS Delhi and the Sitaram Bhartia Institute advocate careful observation and reassessment rather than automatic antibiotic escalation.

triage.headline_ja: 医師ら、モンスーン関連疾患の増加に伴う無分別な抗生物質使用に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱・マラリア・腸チフスなどモンスーン季に一般的な疾患について、抗生物質の不適切使用とAMR（薬剤耐性）への注意喚起を行う啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数や異常な流行を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors warn against indiscriminate antibiotic use amid monsoon illnesses
article.articleSummary: India faces a surge of monsoon-related illnesses, with doctors warning against self-medication with antibiotics. Fever is a symptom, not a diagnosis, and can arise from viral illnesses, dengue, malaria, or typhoid among others. Antibiotics treat bacteria only and have no effect on viruses; unnecessary use drives antimicrobial resistance (AMR), already impacting clinical practice. Management should follow clinical assessment, illness duration, symptoms, and indicated diagnostics, with no reuse of leftovers or sharing prescriptions. If fever persists, worsens, or is accompanied by breathing difficulty, dehydration, altered consciousness, severe weakness, or other concerning signs, prompt medical evaluation is advised. Indian Council of Medical Research guidelines emphasize appropriate antibiotic selection and caution against indiscriminate empirical treatment when bacterial infection is unestablished. Responsible prescribing and patient awareness are essential to curb AMR while ensuring antibiotics are used when genuinely needed.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期の疾患増加に伴い、医師らが抗生物質の無分別な使用に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性疾患と抗菌薬耐性(AMR)に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリア・腸チフスは季節性の発熱原因として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生状況や症例数の報告はない。AMRに関する一般的な医療啓発記事。

article.articleHeadline: #H1N1 Virus | Delhi Swine Flu Surge: 1,777 Cases Reported, Health Advisory Issued | Health News

H1N1 can cause fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue and respiratory problems; while most patients recover with appropriate care, certain groups face higher risk of complications. The report presents the situation as a local outbreak in the capital requiring vigilance and adherence to public health guidance. article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Spike In Delhi: Swine Flu Cases Cross 2,600-Mark, Govt Issues Advisory - 10 Points
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 2,602 influenza cases this year through August 21, including 2,392 Influenza-A and 210 Influenza-B. H1N1 accounts for 1,777 Influenza-A cases (dominant subtype), with 37 H1, 138 H3 and 440 other Influenza-A cases. Health Ministry lists common symptoms: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches, fatigue, plus nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. The Delhi government issued a health advisory urging respiratory etiquette, avoiding crowds, seeking medical advice for flu-like symptoms, wearing masks in crowded places, hand hygiene, coughing etiquette, and not touching the face. Do not self-medicate. Thirty-five hospitals are under special surveillance; AIIMS and NCDC designated as referral labs. Preparedness is being reviewed; no shortages of beds, doctors, or medicines reported. IDSP/IHIP daily surveillance with bulletins; district health officers trained. Public awareness campaigns are ongoing. Seasonal peaks occur Jan-Mar and post-monsoon; young children and older adults remain high-risk.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1が急増：豚インフルエンザ症例が2,600件を突破、政府が注意喚起を発表（10のポイント）
triage.triage_reason: デリーでインフルエンザA(H1N1優勢)が2,600例超に急増し、政府が病院の特別監視体制・注意喚起を発出。持続的な曝露とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、行政・メディアの関心も高い。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行として報告されており、季節的なピーク（1-3月、モンスーン後）に一致。病床・医薬品の不足はなく、国内対応で管理可能とされている。ただし症例急増と政府の注意喚起発出により社会的関心が高いため、続報の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Bali aman, wisman diminta tak khawatirkan isu virus Zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bali Safe, Foreign Tourists Urged Not to Worry About the Zika Virus
article.articleSummary: Zika virus remains not reported in Bali, Indonesia, where authorities say Bali is safe for foreign tourists. Denpasar-based officials from Bali's Tourism Office say no Zika cases have been documented across Bali, though travel health advisories urge vigilance due to the tropical climate conducive to Aedes mosquitoes. The U.S. CDC has issued a Travel Health Notice Level 2 for Indonesia with specific attention to Bali as of 7 August 2026, following reports of Zika in travelers returning from Bali. Travelers are advised to prevent mosquito bites and to consider sexual transmission risk. Zika infections are typically mild or asymptomatic but can cause fever, rash, headache, joint pain, and red eyes; risk to pregnant women includes fetal birth defects. Local health authorities emphasize routine dengue-like vector control and ongoing precautions to protect tourists and workers.

triage.headline_ja: バリは安全、外国人観光客にジカウイルスの噂を心配しないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 米国CDCがバリ発の渡航者にジカウイルス感染が確認されたとしてレベル2の渡航健康情報を発出しており、国際的拡大と渡航制限（勧告）の両基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: バリ現地当局はジカ症例なしと主張する一方、CDCは渡航者の感染報告に基づき渡航健康情報レベル2を発出しており、情報に一部矛盾があるため続報確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: A seasonal flu, a sharper surge
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026 in the National Capital Region (NCR), including Delhi, H1N1 influenza (swine flu) is rising, with 1,777 H1N1 cases reported in 2026 so far versus 229 by the same point last year, alongside H3N2 and other viruses. Patients present with fever, cough and cold-like symptoms; infection can be confirmed via throat or nasal swab. Most healthy individuals recover in about a week with rest, fluids and symptomatic care, but severe symptoms or underlying conditions may require closer medical attention. Do not self-diagnose or self-medicate; seek medical care if symptoms persist or worsen, or if there is trouble breathing, chest pain, confusion, dehydration or low oxygen. High-risk groups—older adults, young children, pregnant individuals, and those with chronic illnesses—should seek medical advice promptly. Vaccination with the flu vaccine is advised for vulnerable groups after discussing with a doctor; antivirals may be effective if started early.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザ、鋭い増加
triage.triage_reason: デリー首都圏でH1N1インフルエンザ症例が前年同時期比で大幅増加しているが、多くは軽症で季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: H1N1症例数が前年の229件から1,777件へ大幅増加している点は注視すべきだが、記事内容から重症例の急増や医療逼迫の記載はなく、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と考えられる。今後の重症化率や医療機関の対応状況の続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola preocupa cientistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak concerns scientists.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-23, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with more than 2,500 deaths in three months and an exponential spread. There are no vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo, and tools developed for other ebolaviruses cannot be automatically applied. The crisis is worsened by armed conflict, population displacement, and cross-border movement that hinder surveillance, care, and transmission control. Separately, a Nature Microbiology study using human brain organoids found Ebola can persist and replicate for up to 120 days in neural tissue, infecting neurons, astrocytes, and microglia, with pro-inflammatory cytokine elevations suggesting prolonged inflammation. This productive persistence may explain delayed complications in survivors, including ocular, meningeal, or brain involvement. The virus can persist in vitreous humor and semen, enabling extended transmission. WHO prioritizes MBP134 and maftivimab, remdesivir; obeldesivir is considered for post-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、科学者らに懸念広がる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が発生し、3か月で2,500人以上が死亡、指数関数的拡大とワクチン・治療薬不在という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 国境を越えた人の移動や武力紛争によりサーベイランス・対応が困難とされ、国際的拡大リスクが高い。Bundibugyo型には既存のワクチン・治療法が効かない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Banten sets health check, TB detection example after surpassing target
article.articleSummary: Banten Province, notably Tangerang District, surpassed national targets for Indonesia’s Free Health Check (CKG) and TB case detection, making it a national pilot. As of August 19, 2026, CKG coverage in Banten reached 5,934,010 people (100.60% of target), placing the province among the top three in the country. TB case detection in the region last year reached 112% of the estimated caseload, with a TB treatment success rate of 91%. Portable X-ray equipment used during CKG screenings speeds TB detection and allows screening for hypertension and diabetes mellitus; patients with these conditions can be treated at community health centers and referred if needed. The Health Ministry allocated 16 X-ray units through the 2026 State Budget for eight districts/cities in Banten. In Tangerang, the CKG target is 1.6 million; 1.52 million have been reached, leaving about 100,000 to be covered by September. National CKG target: 130 million; about 82 million checked to date.

triage.headline_ja: バンテン州、目標達成後の健康診断・結核検出の模範例に
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策の成功事例を伝える内容であり、異常な公衆衛生事象ではなく、通常の保健政策の進捗報告である。
triage.notes: 結核の流行や異常発生を報告するものではなく、健康診断プログラムの目標達成を称える肯定的な内容の記事。トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: 180 Kinder zu Vollwaisen geworden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: 180 children have become orphans.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows high child mortality: under-1 case fatality around two-thirds; ages 1–4 CFR 58.5%; overall CFR 47.5% in the population. UNICEF reports children aged 0–17 comprise about 20% of confirmed infections. At least 180 children have become full orphans since the outbreak was announced about 100 days ago. Stigma and trauma accompany loss, with reports of exclusion and restricted meals even after isolation periods. The 21-day incubation period requires monitoring of close contacts, adding emotional burden for affected children. Save the Children is establishing specialized observation and care centers to provide medical care, psychosocial support, and safe environments for children separated from or losing their Ebola-affected parents. Contact tracing is hampered in areas where Ebola is denied or doubted; early detection and treatment remain critical to improve child survival.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：180人の子どもが完全孤児に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は致死率が高く（全体47.5%、乳児で約2/3）、多数の孤児が発生するなど深刻な公衆衛生・人道的影響があり、国際支援も必要とされているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFやSave the Childrenの人道支援活動、孤児の心理社会的影響に焦点を当てており、感染拡大状況の詳細な疫学データ（新規症例数、地理的拡大範囲）は限定的。続報での感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 Cases Surge To 1,777: Swine Flu Infections Rise Nearly 8-Fold; Check Symptoms & Health Advisory
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 H1N1 infections in 2026, up from 229 last year, as overall influenza cases reach 2,602. Influenza-A includes 1,777 H1N1, 37 H1, 138 H3, and 440 other A strains; Influenza-B has 210 cases, with 200 Victoria strain. Health authorities launched intensified surveillance and a high-level review chaired by Union Health Minister J P Nadda and Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh, while reassuring no panic and ensuring adequate bed, doctor, medicine, and equipment availability. Delhi advisories urge respiratory hygiene, hand-washing, avoiding crowded places, and seeking medical care if flu-like symptoms persist. H1N1 symptoms mirror seasonal flu: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headaches, body aches, and fatigue; warning signs include difficulty breathing, pneumonia, low oxygen, or worsening symptoms, especially in vulnerable groups. Monitoring continues with hospital arrangements strengthened as cases rise during the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのH1N1感染者数が1,777人に急増：豚インフルエンザ感染がほぼ8倍に増加、症状と健康アドバイザリーを確認
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数が前年比約8倍に急増し、インド保健省が高官級レビューを実施するなど政府の関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の急増であり、重症度や死亡者数に関する具体的データは記事に含まれていない。モンスーン期の流行拡大とインド政府の高官級対応が確認されているため、続報を含めたリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 3 Leptospirosis Deaths Recorded at San Lazaro Hospital
article.articleSummary: Three leptospirosis deaths recorded at San Lazaro Hospital as of 2026-08-23. A patient developed fever and breathlessness without evident wounds; another minor patient was transferred from Gat Andres Bonifacio Medical Center for dialysis due to elevated creatinine and BUN and anuria after floodwater exposure. Severe leptospirosis can affect kidneys, liver, and respiratory system; kidney involvement may require hemodialysis, liver involvement causes jaundice, and respiratory involvement can necessitate intubation. Mortality in multi-organ dysfunction cases can reach 50%. DOH Secretary Edwin Mercado visited San Lazaro on 2026-08-22. Incubation ranges from about 2 days to 60 days, typically manifesting in 5–15 days. The DOH is monitoring dengue, reporting 111,302 dengue cases nationwide as of 17 August this year. Despite rising leptospirosis and dengue, hospitals reportedly have sufficient capacity to accommodate patients.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ラザロ病院でレプトスピラ症による死亡3例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症・デング熱は毎年フィリピンで発生する季節性疾患であり異常性は低いが、死亡例と保健省長官の視察など一定の関心があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症・デング熱ともにフィリピンで毎年雨季・洪水後に発生する既知の感染症であり、病院の収容能力は十分とされている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死者数や保健省の対応状況について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में क्यों बढ़ रहे स्वाइन फ्लू के केस? H1N1 कितना खतरनाक, डॉ. रणदीप गुलेरिया ने बताए लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why are swine flu cases rising in Delhi? How dangerous is H1N1? Dr. Randeep Guleria explains the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR has recorded 1,777 H1N1 swine flu cases this year, about seven times higher than last year. AIIMS Director Dr. Randeep Guleria says the rise is due to antigenic drift, yielding a newer, more transmissible strain that bypasses existing immunity from prior infection or vaccination. The virus’s outer structure evolves and monsoon humidity helps it survive longer, aiding spread. More pneumonia patients are reaching hospitals; the elderly and chronically ill increasingly require ICU care. Symptoms: fever, cough, body aches, sore throat, and runny nose; warning signs: chest pain, shortness of breath, fever persisting beyond 4–5 days, and productive cough. Transmission often starts at home after a child brings it from school. Public health measures: stay home when sick, wear masks, cover coughs, sanitize, limit contact with high-risk groups. India’s adult flu vaccination rate is under 2%; vaccinating those over 50 or with diabetes or hypertension reduces severity and hospitalization risk.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでなぜ豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）の症例が増加しているのか？危険性は？ランディープ・グレリア医師が症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が前年比約7倍に急増し、ICU入院例も増加しているため、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、メディアでの関心も高い。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり新規病原体ではないが、抗原ドリフトによる感染力増大と重症例増加が報告されており、国内公衆衛生対応の状況把握のためフルリスク評価への移行が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh: ​Xử lý ổ dịch tả lợn châu Phi tại xã Xuân Sơn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Containing the African swine fever outbreak in Xuân Sơn Commune
article.articleSummary: On August 22, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City's Xuân Sơn Commune culled 62 pigs from a household in Ấp Tân Xuân after clinical signs prompted testing for African swine fever. Lab confirmation identified African swine fever virus by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center II under the Department of Livestock and Veterinary. Since January 2026, Xuân Sơn has recorded two ASF outbreaks, with Xuân Sơn located in the eastern Ho Chi Minh City area described as the region's largest pig-raising zone. Weather fluctuations—alternating rain and sun—are cited as facilitating disease emergence and spread. Authorities advise farmers to promptly report pigs showing high fever, loss of appetite, hemorrhaging, weakness, or unexplained death to local authorities or veterinary staff, and to avoid self-treatment, concealment, or moving sick animals.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市:​ スアンソン地区でアフリカ豚熱の発生を処理
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）のみで人への健康影響はなく、地域限定的な家畜対応であり公衆衛生上の国際的懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物感染症であり、ヒトへの感染性はないため人的公衆衛生リスクの評価対象外。地方の家畜管理当局による通常の防疫対応。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: तेजी से फैल रहा H1N1, डॉक्टरों ने सांस फूलने और ऑक्सीजन गिरने को लेकर किया अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 is spreading rapidly; doctors have issued an alert about shortness of breath and falling oxygen levels.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H1N1) cases are rising in Delhi-NCR, India, with 1,449 confirmed infections reported by the National Centre for Disease Control as of 12 August 2026, more than sixfold higher than 229 cases in the same period last year. While most patients recover with supportive care, some infections reach the lower respiratory tract, causing pneumonia and reduced oxygen levels. Severe signs include shortness of breath at rest, rapid breathing, falling oxygen saturation, chest pain, blue lips, confusion, and rapid clinical deterioration. Oxygen therapy is advised when SpO2 falls below 90% per India’s seasonal influenza clinical management protocol. Most cases do not develop serious complications, but rising vigilance is urged. Hospitals in Delhi, including Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital and Safdarjung Hospital, have strengthened preparedness for influenza and potential complications. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, and fatigue, with possible progression to pneumonia, ARDS, sepsis, or respiratory failure.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1が急速に拡大中、医師らが呼吸困難と酸素飽和度低下について警告
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数が前年比6倍以上に増加し重症化リスクへの注意喚起があるが、季節性インフルエンザの流行拡大であり国際的な異常事態とまでは言えず、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の症例増加であり、既知の病原体・既存の医療対応プロトコルが機能している。国レベルの医療体制強化で対応可能と見られ、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言い切れないが、症例数の急増(前年比6倍)は注視が必要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: छत्तीसगढ़ में स्वाइन फ्लू का पहला मामला, 2 साल की बच्ची में H1N1 वायरस की पुष्टि
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Swine Flu Case in Chhattisgarh, H1N1 Virus Confirmed in a 2-Year-Old Girl.
article.articleSummary: First swine flu case reported in Durg district, Chhattisgarh: a 2-year 11-month-old girl tested positive for H1N1 after two days of high fever and flu-like symptoms and admission to a private hospital. RT-PCR confirmed the infection; health authorities have placed the district on alert. Surveillance has been intensified at the child’s home and surrounding areas, with house-to-house checks and testing of other family members. Officials are tracing contacts who may have been exposed. Swine flu presents with high fever and flu-like symptoms; transmission occurs via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking, and risk is higher in closed, crowded spaces. Children under five are at greater risk for severe illness. Ongoing monitoring and household-level data collection are underway.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州で初のスワインフル症例、2歳女児のH1N1感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の単発小児例であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、地域初発例として当局が監視を強化しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、単発の小児例。地域当局が接触者調査・監視強化を実施しているが、広域拡大の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 중국, 코로나 한달 새 52만 명...국내 검출률도 3배 증가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China logs 520,000 COVID-19 cases in a month... domestic detection rate also tripled
article.articleSummary: China reports 522,000 new COVID-19 cases in a month, about 6.6 times June’s 79,000, with 1 death and a rise in severe cases from 130 to 478. Chinese CDC frames the surge as a seasonal, endemic respiratory infection rather than a new pandemic wave, though officials warn that older adults and people with chronic diseases are at higher risk of severe disease. In Korea, domestic surveillance shows renewed transmission: the 9–15 day period across 106 clinic-level facilities yielded a 9.1% COVID-19 detection rate, reaching the 9% level after three weeks. Hospitalizations have climbed over four weeks: hospital-grade facilities recorded 23, 27, 48, and 56 patients in successive weeks, while higher-tier tertiary hospitals increased from 2 to 5 to 7 in the same span. Published 2026-08-23.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、コロナ1か月で52万人…国内検出率も3倍増加
triage.triage_reason: 中国での重症例増加（130→478）と韓国での検出率・入院数上昇が報告されており、WPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当し、報道による社会的関心も認められるため。
triage.notes: 中国CDCは季節性・地方病的な呼吸器感染症の波と説明しており、新規変異株や病原性変化の言及はない。ただし重症例・入院数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。韓国(Republic of Korea)は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Beni/Ebola : des écoles dépourvues de dispositifs de prévention à quelques jours de la rentrée scolaire (Constat)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni/Ebola: Schools lacking preventive measures a few days before the start of the school year (Findings).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease risk highlighted in Beni, Nord-Kivu province, DRC, as the 2026-2027 school year nears. On Aug 22, about ten schools across four Beni communes visited by 7SUR7.CD reporters showed no handwashing facilities at several entrances. Parents were already registering children, while some school heads cited financial constraints that prevent installing hygiene and prevention devices. A principal noted that the Ebola-affected region requires reinforced barrier measures to protect learners, teachers, and parents, but funding gaps hinder action. Kambale Kibonge, the sous-PROVED of the Ministry of National Education and Citizenship in Beni, urged school authorities to strengthen barrier measures to limit contamination risk. Reopening is scheduled for Sept 1, 2026, per the national calendar, with authorities urging preparation amid a dangerous health context. The article does not provide Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ/エボラ：新学期を数日後に控え、学校に感染予防設備が不足
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の影響地域とされる北キブ州ベニで、学校再開を前に手洗い設備等の予防措置が不足しており、行政・教育当局が懸念を表明している。具体的な症例数は記載されていないが、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある疾患であり社会的関心も高いためピックアップと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は学校における予防設備不足に焦点を当てたもので、エボラの新規症例数や検査確認情報は含まれていない。既存の流行状況を踏まえた予防的観点からの報道と考えられ、続報で症例動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases surge, NKTI limits walk-in admissions
article.articleSummary: NKTI in Quezon City, Philippines, limited walk-in admissions at its emergency room due to full bed capacity amid a surge in leptospirosis cases and high patient volumes. The Department of Health issued a Code White alert and is monitoring possible increases after widespread floods in Metro Manila and other areas. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria from rat urine, surviving in water or soil for weeks to months. Exposure during floodwaters or mud can cause fever, headache, muscle aches, vomiting, and jaundice, with onset 2–30 days post-exposure (avg 7–14 days). Mortality is about 10–15%, and 5% progress to Weil's syndrome with kidney failure or lung hemorrhage. Public guidance urges seeking medical assessment within 24–48 hours after exposure, as well as coordinating elective admissions with doctors and considering other facilities with available beds.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症症例が急増、NKTIが飛び込み入院を制限
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症急増により病院のベッド逼迫とDOHのCode White警報発令があり、重症度・曝露継続・社会的関心の基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 洪水後の季節的増加であり人畜共通感染症のため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、病院キャパシティ逼迫とDOHの公式警報発令により国内の公衆衛生対応が必要な状況。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Haryana में बढ़ा स्वाइन फ्लू का खतरा; इस जिले में अब तक 21 मामले आए सामने...स्वास्थ्य विभाग की एडवाइजरी जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu threat has increased in Haryana; 21 cases have been reported so far in this district... Health Department issues advisory.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) risk has risen in Haryana as Delhi-NCR reports rising cases; the Haryana Health Department has issued an advisory. In Gurugram, August has seven H1N1 cases, lifting Jan–Aug 2026 total to 21. Months with three cases: January, March, June, July; February two; April–May zero. Experts say monsoon humidity and changing weather favor influenza spread, though a long outbreak cannot yet be confirmed. Delhi has 1,777 H1N1 cases in 2026, with 114 new cases reported on August 20. In Haryana, hospitals in Faridabad and Gurugram report more flu-like symptoms. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body/joint pains, breathing difficulty, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. Advisory: avoid public places with symptoms, seek medical care, cover coughs, wash hands, stay hydrated, eat well, sleep, and avoid handshakes or spitting in public.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州でスワインフルの脅威増大;この地区でこれまでに21件の症例が報告される…保健局が勧告を発表

article.articleHeadline: 6,7 Juta Penduduk Indonesia Terinfeksi Hepatitis B, Kenali Gejala dan Cara Cegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6.7 Million Indonesians Infected with Hepatitis B: Know the Symptoms and How to Prevent It
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Ministry, via the 2023 Indonesia Health Survey (SKI 2023), reports approximately 6.7 million people infected with hepatitis B and 2.5 million with hepatitis C. Hepatitis B virus (HBV) spreads through blood and bodily fluids, including sexual contact, contaminated needles, or mother-to-child transmission at birth. Many infections are asymptomatic; when symptoms appear they include fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, dark urine, and jaundice. Infections can be acute or chronic; chronic HBV raises risks of cirrhosis and liver cancer, and rarely acute liver failure and death. Vaccination is the primary prevention method: newborns should receive the first HBV dose within 24 hours of birth, followed by two or three doses at least four weeks apart. Prevention also includes avoiding shared needles, sterilizing tattoo/piercing equipment, and practicing safe sex. For HBV-infected pregnant women, maternal management and immediate newborn vaccination reduce mother-to-child transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Cien días del brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo: el peor en la historia del país con 2.500 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 days into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the deadliest in the country's history with 2,500 deaths.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 100 days into the Ebola outbreak declared on 15 May in the eastern region, there are 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths, with underreporting suspected. This is the most extensive outbreak by case count in the DRC and the second deadliest in its history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak, though far from the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that caused about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 infections. The outbreak is the fastest-growing since declaration; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns it could reach West Africa’s historical levels. About half of the deaths have occurred in the last three weeks, with two orphans reported daily. Health teams are overwhelmed; MSF reports over 1,400 healthcare workers on duty but insufficient. The UN warns of spillover risk to neighboring countries, with reinforced surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: 사망자만 2300여명...콩고민주공화국 에볼라 사태 100일
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll reaches about 2,300... 100 days into the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda grows, centered in Ituri and North Kivu. First reported May 15; 100 days in, 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths as of Aug 15. If trend continues, it could become the largest Ebola outbreak yet. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist; control relies on isolation, treatment, and contact tracing, but about 12% of contacts are traced vs 95%. About 850 confirmed patients are not categorized as currently treated, survivors, or deaths. Community distrust, late care seeking, and funerals without PPE worsen spread. Funding bottlenecks: Africa CDC requests $5.18B for direct health response and $8.82B for humanitarian issues; WHO says only $2.64B of direct funds has been disbursed. Two Bundibugyo vaccine candidates are in safety trials; cross-protection research with Ervebo is considered. WHO urges village-by-village case finding and tool development; ~47% case fatality and cross-border risk ahead.

article.articleHeadline: RDC lucha a la desesperada contra el peor brote de ébola de su historia a los 100 días de su declaración
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC fights desperately against the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, 100 days since its declaration.
article.articleSummary: 100 days after the Ebola outbreak declaration in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15, the epidemic has surpassed 2,500 deaths, with about half identified in the last three weeks and UN reporting exponential spread. The Ituri Province hosts the epicenter, where violent armed groups including the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), linked to ISIS, drive mass displacement toward North and South Kivu, complicating case tracking. In Kivu, the M23 militia controls provincial capitals and coordinates with international health actors but not with the central government. About 260 attacks on health workers have occurred, with eight medical staff killed and 43 additional deaths linked to Ebola. A first shipment of Ervebo arrived, though its efficacy against Bundibugyo is doubtful; 70,000 doses are slated for broader trial use. WHO calls for strengthened cross-border surveillance; Uganda briefly considered expansion. Some 236,000 Congolese refugees resided in neighboring countries in 2025.

Initial treatment failed, and follow-up studies indicated the causative agent originated from the local water supply, which is not adequately purified compared with Russian standards. She has since undergone a second course of treatment, which is ongoing. The case is noted alongside a statement by epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko of the Russian Academy of Sciences, who said that import of sexually transmitted infections from Europe to Russia is possible, but there are no systemic grounds for a rise in incidence. Published 2026-08-23.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Animal Husbandry is running a free vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease; how to avail the benefits.
article.articleSummary: Free vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is being run across Bihar, including Sitamarhi district, by the Department of Animal Husbandry. The program, initiated on July 10, targets cattle, with emphasis on high milk-yielding cows and young calves, as FMD is described as a highly virulent viral disease damaging livestock health. District Animal Husbandry Officer Prem Kumar Jha warns that without timely vaccination, the infection can spread to the entire region. In calves, the disease can cause reproductive problems such as repeat breeding and abortions. It is described as zoonotic and highly contagious, making vaccination the sole effective preventive measure. This year, the vaccination process is digital and online: livestock owners first register via mobile number, receive an OTP, and after verification, vaccinations are recorded and trackable on the departmental portal. Officials clarify vaccines are given only to healthy animals, to build immunity.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu is raising concerns in Delhi! Dengue has also gained pace along with H1N1 and H3N2; ignoring these symptoms can be fatal.
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR faces rising fever and viral infections during the monsoon, with escalating H1N1 (swine flu) and Dengue alongside influenza A. By 21 August, Delhi reported 1,777 H1N1 cases and 2,392 total Influenza-A infections; Dengue cases reached 1,179 by 7 August. Early symptoms overlap between flu and Dengue—high fever, headache, body pains, and fatigue—risking delayed treatment. H1N1 symptoms include abrupt fever, cough, sore throat, chills, myalgia, fatigue, and sometimes respiratory distress; Dengue can present rapid fever, retro-orbital or eye pain, myalgias, fatigue, rashes, progressing to abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or extreme weakness. Health authorities urge not to ignore flu-like symptoms, especially in children, elderly, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics during fever; stay hydrated, rest, and seek medical advice. Preventive measures: avoid crowds, wear masks, and practice hand hygiene to limit transmission.

triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に発生する季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2）とデング熱の同時流行を報じる地域保健記事。症例数増加は報告されているが重症度・死亡データは記載なし。既知の季節性疾患であり国際的な異常性は低いが、複数感染症の併発と症例増加のため経過観察・簡易評価は妥当と判断。

triage.headline_ja: 中国、1カ月で52万人の新規コロナ感染...韓国も3週間で入院者数2.8倍増
triage.triage_reason: 中国・韓国でCOVID-19感染者・入院者数の季節的増加が見られるが、当局は軽症が大半でパンデミックレベルではないとしており、新規性・異常性は低い。今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 韓国（Republic of Korea）は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。COVID-19は既知の疾患で季節性の増加パターンとみられ、当局も軽症主体・非パンデミックレベルと評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Araras registra terceira morte por febre maculosa neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araras records third death from Brazilian spotted fever this year
article.articleSummary: 52-year-old woman from Parque Tiradentes, Araras, who collected recyclable materials, died from Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa). She sought care at UPA and was transferred to Santa Casa, but was already in an advanced stage and did not survive. This is the third fatality from the disease in the region this year, with two children aged 8 and 9 dying in January in the neighboring municipality of Rio Claro. Rio Claro has not recorded spotted fever cases for about two and a half years; the last case before this year was January 2024. The Centro de Controle de Zoonoses notes that the star tick (carrapato-estrela) lives in vegetation and contact with vegetation facilitates bites. In wooded areas, avoid brushing against vegetation, wear light clothing, long pants, and socks over pants, and check the body after outdoor exposure to promptly remove any ticks.

triage.headline_ja: アララスで今年3人目の紅斑熱による死亡例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）はマダニ媒介性の地域風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしないが、今年3例目の死亡例発生および約2年半ぶりの発生地域再燃が見られるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: マダニ媒介性疾患であり人から人への感染拡大リスクはないため国際的な脅威度は低いが、地域内での死亡者増加と発生パターンの変化（リオクラロでの再発生）は継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: How the deadliest Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak can be stopped
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths across 56 health zones as of August 21, 2026, making it the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo virus drives transmission in Ituri and South Kivu, with Uganda reporting interruption of locally acquired transmission along the border. The response centers on communities: survivors, health workers, burial teams and community health workers who identify illness early, trace contacts and counter misinformation. As of August 20, 158 health workers have been infected and 45 have died. Urgent needs include PPE, trained staff, rapid testing, high-quality supportive care and predictable funding across facilities. Cross-border coordination remains essential; authorities aim to scale up surveillance and response by two to three times while avoiding blanket travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最悪クラスとなったブンディブギョ型エボラ流行を食い止めるには
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例5,290件・死者2,516人に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行。医療従事者への感染・死亡多数、越境伝播の報告もあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは地域伝播中断が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。South Kivu・IturiはDRC国内地域として扱った。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the second IHR Emergency Committee meeting on Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - 18 August 2026
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the second-largest Ebola outbreak, spreading faster than any prior event. By 18 August 2026, 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths have occurred across six provinces. Transmission persists amid insecurity, displacement and movement along roads, rivers and mining routes; many deaths occur at home or outside treatment centres, signaling unidentified transmission chains. The risk of cross-border spread continues after a traveller carried the virus to France; Uganda has halted transmission after the initial spillover. Under DRC leadership with WHO and partners, response efforts are scaled up: community-based surveillance, expanded treatment capacity, safe burials and community engagement, plus vaccine and therapeutic trials. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines have entered human trials; a cross-protective vaccine shows promise in animals and moves toward phase III; PARTNERS trial enrolled 100 patients. Challenges include faster data sharing, financing, access, security and cross-border coordination, while preserving health services.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国におけるブンディブギョウイルス病流行に関する第2回IHR緊急委員会での冒頭発言（2026年8月18日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR緊急委員会が2度目の会合を開くほどの大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョウ型）流行であり、感染者5000人・死者2300人超、国境を越えた伝播（フランスへの輸入例）も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびフランスへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は評価対象リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。IHR緊急委員会自体の開催は国際的懸念の高さを示すが、渡航・貿易制限措置の具体的言及は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: NKTI at full bed capacity due to surge in leptospirosis cases
article.articleSummary: In the Philippines, the National Kidney and Transplant Institute (NKTI) in Quezon City has reached full bed capacity and temporarily limited walk-in admissions due to a surge in leptospirosis, prompting an Aug 23 advisory. Non-emergency admissions should coordinate with attending physicians and consider other facilities to avoid prolonged waits as emergency-room volumes remain high. Leptospirosis, caused by bacteria in the urine/feces of infected animals (primarily rats), affects humans and animals. San Lazaro Hospital reported at least three leptospirosis deaths between Aug 10 and 22, and currently counts 60 leptospirosis patients, including 22 new admissions and 19 in severe condition, per a 24 Oras Weekend report. The Department of Health urged protective measures: wear boots, wash feet with soap and water, and avoid exposure if there is an open wound; consult a doctor before taking any medicine.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症患者急増によりNKTI病院が満床に
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・ケソン市で複数病院がレプトスピラ症患者急増により満床・死亡例が報告されており、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続）に該当し、社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンで雨季・洪水期に毎年発生する感染症だが、今回は病院の満床・複数死亡例が報告されており、地域医療体制への負荷が懸念される。人-人感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi-NCR H1N1 Spike: More Testing, Same Old Strain, Says Dr Soumya Swaminathan
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR reports a spike in H1N1 (swine flu) cases, attributed mainly to seasonal rise and heightened testing rather than a new or more virulent strain. Dr. Soumya Swaminathan cites ICMR surveillance data showing the circulating H1N1 remains a stable strain with no significant mutations. The surge coincides with ongoing COVID-19 circulation, and some detected infections may be COVID-19 rather than H1N1. She advises vaccination now, noting two weeks for vaccine-induced immunity, with prior immunity providing faster protection. Vulnerable groups—elderly, pregnant women, immunocompromised, and children—require extra monitoring. Public health measures emphasized include basic hygiene, mask use in public, and staying indoors when unwell. Hospitals nationwide should be prepared for potential rises; the situation underscores ongoing public health preparedness rather than panic.

triage.headline_ja: デリーNCRでH1N1感染急増:検査増加が主因、既存株と同じ―スワミナサン博士
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の増加であり専門家は既存株で変異なしと説明しているが、脆弱層への影響やCOVID-19との同時流行に留意し経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 専門家は既存株で新規変異なしと明言、季節性・検査増加が主因とされる。重症度・死亡数等の詳細情報は本文になく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala biryani outlet ordered to pay Rs 96,500 to woman over food poisoning
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Pathanamthitta District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered King's Biriyani Cafe (Chethonkara, Ranni) and proprietor Ashish John Mathew to pay Rs 96,500 to Reena Thomas for food poisoning linked to a Salmonella infection after consuming alfaham. Compensation includes Rs 36,500 for hospital expenses, Rs 50,000 in general damages, and Rs 10,000 for litigation, payable within 30 days. Thomas, who visited on October 21, 2025, developed vomiting, stomach pain, dizziness and weakness, requiring hospital treatment in Vechoochira and later Kanjirappally for about a week; doctors attributed Salmonella to undercooked or stale food. The cafe’s manager did not appear while the proprietor did; the commission ruled in favor of the complainant. The ruling underscores food safety and consumer protection in Kerala eateries.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州のビリヤニ店、食中毒を訴えた女性に9万6500ルピーの支払いを命じられる
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人の食中毒（サルモネラ感染）に関する消費者紛争裁判の記事であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 単発の食中毒事例で、感染症アウトブレイクとしての性質はない。腸チフス・パラチフスと分類されているが、記事内容はサルモネラ食中毒による個別の消費者訴訟である。

article.articleHeadline: Unapproved border routes undermine Ghana-Togo disease control efforts
article.articleSummary: Unapproved crossing routes along the Ghana–Togo border undermine Ebola preparedness and broader cross-border disease control as of 2026-08-23. A meeting to establish the Ghana-Togo Bilateral Technical Working Group on public health emergency preparedness, hosted by IOM with Global Affairs Canada, brought together health, immigration, customs, and local authorities to bolster Ebola-focused surveillance and response. While informal routes complicate routine screening and contact tracing, participants noted they also sustain essential family and community ties. Acting IOM Ebola Crises Coordinator Dr. Andrews Ubala cited porous borders, inadequate entry-point infrastructure, limited data digitalisation, fragmented reporting, scarce resources, and difficulties reaching mobile and displaced populations as key barriers. Deputy Port Health Director Alphonse Nindow said the group would formalize information-sharing modalities and joint protocols for surveillance, screening, case management, referral, and contact tracing. The aim is coordinated, timely responses without overlooking border communities' realities.

triage.headline_ja: 未承認の国境越えルートがガーナ・トーゴ間の感染症対策を弱体化
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ症例発生の報告はなく、国境管理体制強化に関する準備会議の内容だが、越境の脆弱性がアウトブレイクリスクに関連するため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、ガーナ・トーゴ国境における公衆衛生緊急事態対応強化のための二国間技術作業部会設立に関する内容。IOMとGlobal Affairs Canadaが支援。国境の非公式ルートが監視・接触者追跡を困難にしている点が課題として挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Papst erinnert an Ebola-Opfer im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope recalls Ebola victims in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-23, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused about 2,500 deaths, with the epidemic spreading rapidly per the UN. Pope Francis, during Angelus, urged international action that includes engaging local communities in prevention to save lives. In the Central African Republic, a gold mine collapse in Zamboyé near the Cameroon border last Tuesday killed dozens, with fatalities reportedly up to around 100. The artisanal mine has been temporarily closed; victims included men from the Central African Republic, Cameroon, and Chad. The pope’s remarks underscore ongoing public health and safety concerns in the region, advocating improved mining safety and lawful operations alongside the urgent response to the Ebola crisis in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、コンゴのエボラ犠牲者に祈りを捧げる
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行で死者約2,500人、国連によると急速に拡大しているとの報告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCにおけるエボラ流行を扱っており、中央アフリカ共和国・カメルーン・チャドに関する記述は金鉱山崩落事故であり感染症事案ではないため、対象国リストのDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bali reassures foreign tourists as Zika virus concerns emerge
article.articleSummary: Bali remains open to travelers as Zika concerns surface. No Zika infections have been detected or reported in Bali to date, according to the Bali Tourism Office and the Bali Provincial Health Office. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention issued a Level 2 Travel Health Notice for Indonesia, including Bali, on August 7, 2026, after reports of Zika cases among travelers returning from Bali. The notice recommends enhanced precautions against mosquito bites and, for pregnant women or those planning pregnancy, caution due to birth defect risks. Authorities urge tourists and industry players to maintain health standards, cleanliness, and vector precautions, highlighting Bali’s tropical climate and the continuity of dengue-prevention measures. Zika transmission locally has not been confirmed; precautions mirror dengue prevention, particularly against Aedes bites. No travel ban is in effect.

triage.headline_ja: バリ、ジカウイルスへの懸念浮上も外国人観光客に安全性を保証
triage.triage_reason: 米国CDCがバリ島（インドネシア）に対しレベル2渡航健康情報を発出し、渡航者由来のジカウイルス感染例が報告されたため、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限的措置の両方が該当する。
triage.notes: バリ島での現地感染は未確認だが、渡航者由来の症例報告を受け米CDCがレベル2渡航健康情報を発出。地域機関は感染ゼロと発表し観光への影響抑制を図っている。続報でバリ島内での実際の感染確認の有無を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: USP e Alemanha criam vacina inteligente e segura contra a chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of São Paulo (USP) and Germany create a smart and safe vaccine against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccine developed by USP (São Paulo) and University of Bonn (Germany) is a 'smart' platform using a genetically modified chikungunya virus that replicates only once, training the immune system without causing disease. In mice, a single dose provided complete protection, signaling a safer alternative for immune-compromised, elderly, and young patients compared with traditional live-attenuated or inactivated vaccines. The virus is engineered so that furin-dependent maturation is blocked; the inserted TEV protease recognition site ensures activation only in vitro, and initial replication yields immature, non-infectious virions that act as antigens. Remarkably, vaccinated mice also neutralized Mayaro virus, hinting at cross-protection and platform versatility for Zika, yellow fever, and SARS-CoV-2 variants. Research led by Danillo Esposito (Ribeirão Preto) with FAPESP support; collaboration includes USP-São Paulo and Bonn; further work aims to adapt to other arboviruses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ大学とドイツがチクングニア熱に対するスマートで安全なワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: これはマウスを用いたワクチン開発の基礎研究に関する報道であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病流行ではなく、チクングニアワクチンの研究開発（動物実験段階）に関する科学ニュース。ブラジル・ドイツの共同研究だが、実際の感染症発生地域ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Veja como é a 'vacina inteligente' contra a chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See what the 'smart vaccine' against Chikungunya looks like.
article.articleSummary: Researchers from the University of São Paulo (USP) in Ribeirão Preto and the University of Bonn developed a 'smart' chikungunya vaccine. The strategy uses a genetically modified chikungunya virus that can replicate only once in the host, providing a robust immune stimulus without causing disease. In mouse studies, a single dose protected animals, and the approach may form a versatile platform adaptable to other pathogens. The vaccine virus is engineered to prevent maturation into an infectious particle: it enters cells and triggers immunity, but cannot complete replication. Specifically, researchers replaced the furin cleavage site with a sequence recognized by the plant virus protease TEV, absent in humans and mosquitoes, ensuring no secondary infections after priming. The platform could address safety limits of current attenuated chikungunya vaccines, which gained FDA approval in 2025 with restrictions. The work, supported by FAPESP, also showed neutralization of Mayaro virus in immunized animals.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアに対する『スマートワクチン』とは
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン研究開発に関する科学的報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル(サンパウロ)とドイツ(ボン)の大学によるチクングニアワクチン開発研究の紹介であり、実際の感染症発生事例を報告するものではないため、対象国であるBrazilも含め発生国としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в ДР Конго унесла жизни более чем 2500 человек. Вирус распространяется "в геометрической прогрессии"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 2,500 lives. The virus is spreading at a geometric rate.
article.articleSummary: As of August 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths. Health authorities report the virus spreading at a geometric rate, outpacing response capacity. The current epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, unlike previous Zaïre-strain outbreaks, complicating early diagnosis due to symptom overlap with malaria. Africa CDC director Jean Kasaya notes substantial international funding, with promises totaling about $1 billion to support NGOs coordinating the response, while WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reiterates ongoing commitment to collaboration with the DRC government, local leaders, medical workers, Africa CDC, and partners. Vaccination efforts are underway: on August 21 a shipment of 16,250 doses of Ervebo arrived in Kinshasa, with WHO having pledged 70,000 doses and a further batch anticipated early next week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者2500人以上に。ウイルスは「幾何級数的に」拡大中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行（5,375症例、2,557死亡）が急速に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念・支援が既に生じているため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、マラリアとの症状の重複により早期診断が困難。国際的な資金・ワクチン支援（Ervebo）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Face au virus Ebola, Léon XIV demande la mobilisation de la communauté internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the face of the Ebola virus, Leon XIV calls for mobilization of the international community.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread alarmingly in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak centered in Ituri province. As of 21 August, UN Ebola coordinator reported over 2,500 deaths since the outbreak began earlier this year, with mortality accelerating in August—half of all deaths occurring in the last 20 days. After the Angelus, Pope Léon XIV urged the international community to act, calling for involvement of local communities in prevention to save lives. The Pope's appeal aligns with UN calls to intensify the health response. The article notes ongoing transmission in the DRC's east but does not provide detailed information on symptoms, lab confirmation, or infection source. No mention of imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに直面し、レオ14世が国際社会の団結を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の死者が2500人を超え、8月に入り死亡が加速している。教皇による国際社会への支援要請やUNの関与など社会的関心も極めて高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は感染源・検査確認・越境感染の詳細を提供していないため、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無は不明。ただし死亡者数の急増と教皇による国際的呼びかけから社会的関心は極めて高い。
