Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu in Durg: प्रदेश के इस जिले में सामने आया स्वाइन फ्लू का मामला, स्वास्थ्य विभाग में मचा हड़कंप, जनता से की ये अपील
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu in Durg: A Swine Flu case has emerged in this district of the state; the health department is in a tizzy, an appeal to the public.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1) confirmed in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, marking the district’s first case. A 2 years 11 months-old girl tested positive for H1N1 after presenting with high fever and flu-like symptoms and was admitted to a private hospital. She remains under specialist supervision with ongoing monitoring of her condition. Following confirmation, the health department activated precautions, conducting surveys in the patient’s home and surrounding areas and collecting samples from other family members to curb potential spread. Known symptoms include high fever, body pain, weakness, cough, sore throat, and breathing difficulties. Authorities urged people with such symptoms to seek testing at a nearby health center or district hospital. The response emphasizes vigilance and preventive measures in the community to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥルグの豚インフルエンザ:州内のこの地区で豚インフルエンザの症例が発生、保健当局に緊張走る、住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性に発生するH1N1の単発症例であり、異常性・重篤な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方の保健当局による通常の監視対応（家庭内調査・検体採取）であり、単一症例で地域的流行の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola response faces funding cliff as deaths pass 2,500
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola response faces a funding cliff as the outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 5,290 confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths, with 1,152 recoveries and about 840 in isolation or hospital (case fatality rate 47.6%). UN-coordinated efforts aim to scale treatment capacity from 900 to 3,000 beds within three months via five integrated response packages, following about $80 million invested to date. The response spans 56 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé, and involves Bundibugyo Ebola virus, described as the largest outbreak in DR Congo. Funding gaps threaten containment as the national plan rises from roughly $240 million to about $940 million. The US pledged $242 million in August (total commitments >$512 million); DR Congo has committed around $50 million. Fragmented financing has caused governance and payroll issues, including 15–20% fictitious payroll names, prompting biometric registration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応、死者2,500人超で資金危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが進行中で、死者数2,500人超・致死率47.6%と深刻。資金不足による対応の停滞が懸念され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国からの資金拠出や国連調整による対応拡大が報じられているが、記事は資金・ガバナンス面の課題（給与不正等）に焦点を当てており、他国への感染拡大は明記されていない。国際的拡大リスクはエボラの特性上高いと評価したが、直接的な越境事例の記載はない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Không chủ quan với sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't underestimate dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in southern Vietnam, notably Ho Chi Minh City and Tay Ninh, shows defervescence as a high-risk window. Year-to-date cases in Ho Chi Minh City total 25,774, with 1,097 new infections in week 32 (Aug 3–9, 2026). Hospitals report deterioration after fever subsides (days 4–6): shock, bleeding, and organ injury can occur abruptly. In Tay Ninh, a 31-year-old and a 35-year-old presented with warning signs during fever and after fever resolution, illustrating covert deterioration. A 21-year-old admitted June 22 deteriorated on day 7 after defervescence, with hematemesis, melena, shock, and liver/kidney injury; required ICU ventilation, transfusions, and continuous renal replacement therapy, recovering after three weeks. There is no specific antiviral for dengue; mortality remains low due to early risk stratification and proper resuscitation. An anticipated peak in hospital admissions August–November 2026 urges preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱を軽視してはいけない
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市を含む南部ベトナムでの季節性デング熱流行に関する記事で、症例数は多く重症化例も報告されているが、例年発生する既知の風土病であり異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、本記事は医療従事者・市民への注意喚起を目的とした一般的な公衆衛生記事と考えられる。重症化メカニズム（解熱後のショック・出血・臓器障害）についての医学的啓発内容が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Prison centrale de Boma : 17 détenus atteints de tuberculose et deux
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boma Central Prison: 17 inmates with tuberculosis and two.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis is spreading at Boma Central Prison in Kongo-Central, Democratic Republic of Congo. 17 inmates are infected and two deaths were recorded in the past week. The facility, built for about 160 inmates, now houses 509, over three times capacity, with overcrowding fostering transmission of TB amid poor nutrition and sanitation. The outbreak is compounded by insufficient collaboration among health, penitentiary, and judicial authorities to transfer sick detainees to the Boma General Reference Hospital. Advocates call for an on-site health facility within the prison to improve care. An independent source corroborates the information; the prison director declined to comment when contacted by Radio Okapi.

triage.headline_ja: ボマ中央刑務所：受刑者17人が結核に感染、2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内の過密状態による結核集団発生で死亡例も出ており、当局間の連携不足という管理面の問題も指摘されているため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も一定程度認められる。
triage.notes: 刑務所の過密状態（定員160名に対し509名収容）が感染拡大の主因とされ、保健・矯正・司法当局間の連携不足も指摘されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないが、施設内での管理体制強化が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Pope Leo XIV remembers victims of Ebola and mining disaster in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: During the Aug. 23 Angelus at the Vatican, Pope Leo XIV remembered the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, first declared in May 2026 and now responsible for about 2,500 deaths as of Aug. 21, with the country distributing a vaccine and calling it the deadliest outbreak in its history. He also mourned more than 100 workers killed in a mining landslide at a gold mine near Zamboyé, western Central African Republic on Aug. 18, with rescue efforts ongoing. The pope urged international support and local community involvement to prevent further loss of life and prayed for the victims. In his reflections, he emphasized knowing Jesus personally and following an authentic path of faith, even when it leads along unfamiliar routes.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、中央アフリカのエボラと鉱山事故の犠牲者を追悼
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪とされるエボラ流行が継続中で約2500人が死亡しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際支援が言及されているためフルRRAの対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事は教皇によるエボラ流行と鉱山事故の犠牲者への追悼を報じるもの。エボラ自体はDRCで2026年5月に宣言され、史上最悪の流行として約2500人死亡と報告。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山事故は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。バチカンも対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Con el fin de poner un freno al brote del ébola en el Congo el Papa León XIV pide una respuesta internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To curb the Ebola outbreak in Congo, Pope Leo XIV calls for an international response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 2,557 deaths and 5,375 confirmed cases reported as of August 22, 2026. The outbreak ranks as the second deadliest globally and the most infections recorded within the DRC. The case fatality ratio is 47.6%. Pope Leo XIV, after the Sunday Angelus, urged the international community to mobilize a response that also involves local communities in prevention to save many lives. The pontiff stressed prayers for the DRC and called for coordinated international action. The report focuses on outbreak magnitude and humanitarian dimensions, without detailing specific infection sources or additional laboratory confirmations beyond the counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行を食い止めるため、レオ14世教皇が国際的対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率47.6%、5,375症例・2,557死亡という大規模かつ深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、国際的関心と対応要請が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 教皇による国際的呼びかけがあり、社会的関心が高い。DRC史上最多感染数・史上2番目の致死数という規模から、既にフルRRA相当のシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы выходит из-под контроля - сообщается о росте жертв
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spirals out of control as death toll rises.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have escalated, with 5,290 confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths. Health workers estimate only 30–40% of actual cases are detected, so the true scale is far higher. Mortality is rising sharply in the northern and eastern regions, with half of all deaths in the last 20 days and the spread described as geometric. Contact tracing remains severely limited, identifying fewer than one case per ten known contacts. Experts suspect the outbreak began as early as February in the mining town of Mongbwalu, but officials announced it formally only in mid-May. Armed conflict, sanitation problems, and degraded infrastructure hinder response; humanitarian workers face misinformation and fear of hospitals. The UN reserves will supply 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine, and if current trends continue, the outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に - 死者数増加が報告される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の感染者・死者数が急増し、幾何級数的な拡大と接触者追跡の機能不全が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 実際の感染者数は報告の30-40%程度と推定され、2014-2016年流行を上回る可能性が指摘されている。武力紛争や医療インフラの劣化が対応を阻害しており、国際的な支援（UNによるErvebo ワクチン供給）が既に行われている。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 flu continues to spread in India, but no new strain found: ICMR
article.articleSummary: India continues to see H1N1 influenza spread, but ICMR officials stress there is no emergence of a new H1N1 strain. The circulating viruses in India align with the global strain in circulation since 2025, specifically A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1) pdm09, in clade 6B.1A.5a2a and subclade D.3.1.1; no new strain has been detected and no case or death counts are cited. The circulating viruses are well matched with Northern Hemisphere flu vaccine strains. H1N1 is a seasonal flu; most infections are not serious, with symptoms such as fever, cough, headache, and body pains. However, young children, older adults, and those with comorbidities may be at higher risk of severe illness. Authorities call for continued testing and surveillance and advise seeking medical care if symptoms worsen, while maintaining normal precautions.

triage.headline_ja: インドでH1N1インフルエンザの拡大続くも、新株は確認されず:ICMR
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの拡大が報告されているが、新規株の出現はなく、症例数・死亡数の報告もないため、現時点でフルRRAに進む根拠は乏しい。ワクチン株との適合も良好であり継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ICMRが新株出現を否定しており、季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行範囲内と考えられる。症例数・重症度データが不明のため、severityは不明とした。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Sees Rise in H1N1 Cases: Symptoms, Spread, Treatment and Prevention
article.articleSummary: Delhi records more than 1,700 H1N1 infections in 2026, as the influenza A(H1N1) virus is now labeled seasonal influenza. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has outlined early signs: fever, cough/sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, headache, body aches, muscle or joint pain, fatigue, loss of appetite, and diarrhea. Transmission occurs via droplets from coughs or sneezes and by close contact; enclosed spaces heighten risk. Most infections are mild, but breathing difficulty in older adults, young children, pregnant women, and people with asthma or diabetes warrants care. Treatment centers on rest, fluids, and fever/pain relief; oseltamivir may be prescribed for those at greater risk or with severe disease. Antibiotics are ineffective against influenza. Seek medical attention at first signs; public health officials urge vigilance amid the Delhi surge.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1症例が増加：症状、感染経路、治療と予防
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとして扱われるH1N1の症例増加であり、H1N1は既知の疾患で重症度も多くは軽症とされるが、症例数の規模と公衆衛生上の注意喚起があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ化したH1N1のデリーでの症例増加に関する一般向け保健情報記事。既知の病原体であり、公衆衛生当局が通常の注意喚起を行っているレベルで、緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : face à Ebola, les mineurs contraints de travailler pour survivre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Amid Ebola, minors forced to work to survive.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak disrupts daily life for artisanal miners in Iga-Barrière, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Many workers, displaced by years of conflict, continue mining to feed families despite contamination fears, earning around 10,000 francs daily. They demand a nearby Ebola treatment center, as patients are currently evacuated to Bunia, with some dying during transfer. The mobile nature of artisanal mining complicates contact tracing and exposure identification. An OECD (2024) estimate cites about two million people employed in artisanal and small-scale mining in the DRC. Vaccination progress is noted: 16,250 doses have arrived in Kinshasa as part of a 70,000-dose package with WHO and partners, but rapid vaccination, screening, and treatment access remain major challenges in remote mining areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行下、生活のために働かざるを得ない未成年者たち
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続流行下で、鉱山労働者の接触追跡が困難であり、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大や死亡例が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はイガ・バリエール地区の鉱山労働者に焦点を当てており、移動性の高い労働人口が接触追跡や治療アクセスを困難にしている点が強調されている。WHOと連携したワクチン接種（70,000回分のうち16,250回分がキンシャサに到着）が進行中だが、遠隔地でのワクチン接種・スクリーニング・治療アクセスは依然課題。

article.articleHeadline: Pope Leo Calls for Global Aid as Congo Battles Deadly Ebola...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused more than 2,500 deaths among roughly 5,300 confirmed infections across six provinces, led by the north-eastern Ituri region. The crisis is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or targeted antiviral therapies; patient care relies on early symptom management and supportive treatment. The outbreak was officially declared in May, with epidemiological transmission likely beginning months earlier, complicating contact tracing. Ongoing armed conflict and localized insecurity in eastern Congo hinder isolation efforts and humanitarian access, amplifying transmission. The situation drew international appeals, including Pope Leo XIV in St. Peter's Square on August 23, 2026, urging global solidarity and community-level involvement to save lives. WHO surveillance highlights the escalating severity and the need for coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ、コンゴの致死的エボラ流行に対し世界的支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による大規模流行（感染約5300例、死亡2500例超）が発生し、承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、武力紛争により対応が困難な状況で国際的関心も高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: バチカン市国は発生地域として挙がっているが、記事の主題（発生国）はDRCのみであり、教皇の発言地に過ぎないため除外。致死率が非常に高く（約47%）、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点、紛争により対応が阻害されている点は特に重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Papa pide ayuda internacional y comunitaria tras superar las 2,500 muertes por ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope appeals for international and community aid after surpassing 2,500 Ebola deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 2,500 people, 100 days into the epidemic. Pope Francis urged the international community to urgently bolster aid and to involve local communities directly in prevention efforts to curb transmission and save lives, stressing a locally driven approach and sustained regional support. The message, delivered after the Angelus, highlights the need for coordinated prevention measures and community engagement to halt the outbreak’s human toll. In the same remarks, the pontiff referenced a mining incident in Zamboyé, Central African Republic, calling for safety and legal oversight of mining activities across the continent. The appeal centers on solidarity, humanitarian assistance, and concrete actions to strengthen outbreak response at local and international levels.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、コンゴでのエボラ死者数が2,500人を超え国際社会と地域社会に支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者が2,500人を超え、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際支援の必要性が明確であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国での鉱山事故への言及はエボラとは別件であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中央アフリカ共和国自体もリスト対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Papa León XIV pide ayuda internacional ante brote de ébola que deja 2.557 muertos en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV appeals for international aid amid an Ebola outbreak that has left 2,557 dead in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reached 2,557 deaths and 5,375 confirmed cases as of August 20, 2026, according to the Congolese Ministry of Communications. The case fatality rate is 47.6%; 737 patients remain in isolation or under hospital care, and 1,167 have recovered. Contact tracing has reached 85.5%, exceeding the 85% target. Pope Leo XIV called for intensified international assistance and urged active involvement of affected communities in prevention efforts to curb transmission. He emphasized that international cooperation and local engagement are essential to reduce the outbreak’s impact and prevent further deaths. Authorities describe the event as one of the most severe Ebola episodes in the DRC’s recent history, prompting a strengthened, community-centered response.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世教皇、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行(死者2,557人)に対し国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.6%、死者2,557人・症例5,375人に達する大規模エボラ流行であり、教皇による国際支援要請など社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国政府は『近年で最も深刻なエボラ流行の一つ』と表現しており、教皇が国際協力の強化を呼びかけている。接触者追跡率85.5%は目標を上回るが、致死率の高さから重症度は非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pápež Lev XIV. vyzýva svet na pomoc v boji proti ebole v Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV appeals to the world for help in the fight against Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has claimed more than 2,500 lives and is the largest outbreak in the country by confirmed cases. The 17th outbreak is concentrated in the northern and eastern DRC, occurring amid weak health infrastructure and long-running violence by armed groups. Pope Leo XIV urgently appeals to the international community to counter the epidemic, urging preventive measures and active involvement of local communities to save lives. He notes his forthcoming Africa visit in April to bolster response efforts. The piece emphasizes the Congo as the epicenter of the current Ebola crisis and calls for strengthened international support to bolster outbreak surveillance and patient care in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、コンゴのエボラ流行との闘いへの支援を世界に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（死者2500人超）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、教皇の呼びかけにより社会的関心も高まっている。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行、死者2500人超で過去最大規模と報告。武装勢力による治安悪化と脆弱な医療体制が対応を困難にしている。教皇のアフリカ訪問予定（4月）も言及。

article.articleHeadline: Папата призова за международна помощ за жертвите на Ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Pope appealed for international aid for Ebola victims in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: On August 23, 2026, Pope Francis urged the international community to intensify aid for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, stressing the need to involve local communities in prevention to save lives. He expressed solidarity with the people of the Central African Republic after a mine collapse, praying for victims and urging safety and rule of law in mining. He noted that tomorrow, August 24, marks the ten-year anniversary of the Central Italy earthquake that affected Lazio, Umbria, and Marche, invoking prayers for the dead, their families, and affected communities. In St. Peter’s Square, he greeted Romans and pilgrims, giving a special nod to the cathedral in Gniezno, Poland; the seminarians and leadership of the Pontifical North American College; and youths from the Italian towns of Bormio and Valfurva.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ犠牲者への国際支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行に関する言及だが、教皇の呼びかけという二次的報道であり、感染状況の詳細（症例数、地域、対応状況）が不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は教皇によるエボラ被害者への国際支援要請を報じるものであり、エボラ流行そのものの詳細情報（発生規模、地域、致死率等）は含まれていない。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山事故やイタリア地震の話題は感染症と無関係のため対象外。続報でDRCのエボラ流行状況の詳細を確認する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: No new strain of H1N1, say ICMR sources as swine flu cases rise
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, ICMR sources say no new strain of influenza A(H1N1) has been identified amid rising swine flu cases in Delhi and across India. The circulating strains are well matched with Northern Hemisphere vaccine strains. The A(H1N1) pdm09 viruses belong to the A/Missouri/11/2025 lineage, clade 6B.1A.5a2a, subclade D.3.1.1, in circulation since 2025. Symptoms include fever, cough, headache and body ache; seasonal influenza is mostly self-limiting, but young children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities are at higher risk of complications. Delhi has reported over 2,300 Influenza-A cases this year, including more than 1,777 H1N1 cases up to Friday, with 114 H1N1 cases on Thursday. Health authorities urge respiratory hygiene and timely medical advice; surveillance is ongoing, and public health measures are in place. Union Health Minister Nadda reviewed preparedness and emphasized vigilance and healthcare facility readiness.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1に新たな変異株なし、ICMR筋が発言 豚インフルエンザ症例は増加
triage.triage_reason: デリーを中心にH1N1症例が増加しているが、新規変異株ではなく既存の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、ワクチン株とも一致しているため、現時点でIHR基準の複数該当は認められない。症例増加は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の株（A/Missouri/11/2025系統）による季節性インフルエンザの症例増加であり、新規変異株ではないことが確認されている。保健当局は監視と対応準備を継続中。今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: No Cause For Panic Over H1N1; Current Strains In Circulation Since 2025, Says ICMR
article.articleSummary: India reports no new H1N1 strain; circulating A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses match A/Missouri/11/2025-like, clade 6B.1A.5a2a, subclade D.3.1.1, in circulation since 2025. ICMR notes these strains align with Northern Hemisphere vaccine strains. Seasonal influenza, including H1N1, is mostly self-limiting; common symptoms are fever, cough, headache and body aches, with most people recovering with rest and appropriate care. High-risk groups include young children, the elderly, and those with underlying conditions, who may develop complications. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist, worsen, or are severe. Ongoing surveillance and public health measures are in place. The clarification followed a Delhi health review meeting chaired by Union Health Minister JP Nadda to assess preparedness for seasonal diseases, including influenza, dengue, and malaria.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1について過度な心配は不要、現在流行中の株は2025年から継続しているとICMRが説明
triage.triage_reason: ICMRが新規株ではなく2025年から流行中の既知株であり、パニックの必要はないと公式に否定的見解を示しており、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性疾患（インフルエンザ、デング熱、マラリア）への準備状況を確認するデリーでの保健省会議を受けたもので、ICMRはH1N1株について既知の株であり心配不要と明言している。危機的なシグナルではなく通常のサーベイランス報告に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Папа Лъв Четиринадесети призова международната общност да удвои усилията си при борбата с епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo the Fourteenth called on the international community to double its efforts in the fight against the Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Pope Leo XIV urged doubling international efforts to combat the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak—described as the deadliest in DR Congo’s history—has claimed thousands of lives and spread across northern and eastern regions where government presence is weak and health facilities are under-resourced amid ongoing armed conflict. The pope urged including local communities in response measures and expressed solidarity with people in Central African Republic after a mine collapse in western CAR near the Cameroon border, which killed dozens and left many missing. He also commemorated the ten-year anniversary of the 2016 Amatrice earthquake in Central Italy, which killed nearly 300. The pontiff noted his Africa visit in April this year.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世教皇、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行との戦いへの国際社会の取り組み倍増を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで「史上最悪」とされるエボラ流行が数千人の死者を出し拡大しており、教皇による国際支援要請という高い社会的関心も伴うためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事にはCARでの鉱山崩落事故やイタリアの地震追悼にも言及されているが、これらはエボラとは別事象であり対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。カメルーンはCAR国境付近の鉱山事故の文脈でのみ言及されエボラ関連ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Extrem viele Todesfälle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Extremely high death toll.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 5,100 infections and over 2,400 deaths in the first 100 days—far higher than 2014 West Africa. Ituri province is hardest hit, with cases in six eastern provinces and near the border with the Central African Republic. There are no specific vaccines or antivirals for Bundibugyo; nevertheless, WHO/Africa-CDC approved 70,000 Ervebo doses: 20,000 for clinical tests in Congo and 50,000 for health workers. Ervebo targets the Zaire variant; efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. Since July, two antivirals are in clinical testing. Only about 30–40% of cases are detected, as symptoms resemble other febrile illnesses. Transmission via body fluids and breast milk; babies and toddlers are at high risk. UN notes about one death every 30 minutes; Germany has provided €11 million, plus mobile labs and child-observation centers in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：極めて多い死亡者数
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスにより100日間で5,100人以上が感染、2,400人以上が死亡と2014年西アフリカ流行を上回る規模で、複数州・国境地域への拡大と国際支援(ドイツ資金・WHO/Africa CDCワクチン承認)が確認されているため。
triage.notes: Ituriはコンゴ国内のADM1地域のため国レベルのDRCに統合。中央アフリカ共和国・ドイツ・アンゴラは対象国リスト外のため除外。有効なワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が未確立で、検出率も30-40%と低く、公衆衛生上の脅威が非常に高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: León XIV pide una respuesta internacional para frenar el brote de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leon XIV calls for an international response to curb the outbreak of.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,557 deaths and 5,375 confirmed cases, according to the Congolese Ministry of Communications. The outbreak is the second deadliest globally and the most infections recorded in the DRC. The case fatality rate stands at 47.6%. There are 737 patients in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,167 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 85.5%, surpassing the 85% target. Pope Leo XIV urged an international response to curb the spread, calling for involvement of local communities in prevention after the Sunday Angelus, highlighting the need for global support to save lives amid the ongoing Ebola epidemic in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行阻止に向けた国際的対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は死亡者2,557人・症例5,375人、致死率47.6%と深刻で、教皇が国際支援を要請するなど社会的関心も高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に致死性の高いエボラ流行かつDRC史上最多の症例数。教皇による国際支援要請は社会的・政治的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak: Scaling Response is Key to Containing Deadly Virus
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has become the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths as of August 21, across 56 health zones. Declared 100 days ago and designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO and Africa CDC, the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak spans Ituri province and five other provinces amid ongoing insecurity. Community involvement—survivors, local leaders, health workers—and frontline responders are pivotal for early detection, contact tracing, and safe burials. As of August 20, 158 health workers have been infected, with 45 deaths. Scale-up of response is critical, requiring two to threefold enhancements in surveillance, laboratories, treatment, logistics, and funding, plus protection for workers and direct support to local organizations. Cross-border coordination is essential given population movement along travel routes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行:対応拡大が致死性ウイルス封じ込めの鍵
triage.triage_reason: WHO/Africa CDCがPHEICに指定した大規模エボラ流行(確定5,290例、死亡2,516例)であり、医療従事者感染や国境を越えた人口移動リスクも報告されているため。
triage.notes: PHEIC指定済みの史上2番目の規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)流行。医療従事者158名感染・45名死亡、治安不安定地域での対応が課題。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Flu: भारत में नहीं मिला कोई नया स्ट्रेन, ICMR की सलाह- घबराने की जरूरत नहीं; जानें लक्षण और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Flu: No new strain found in India, ICMR advises — no need to panic; Know the symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: India reports no new H1N1 strain; ICMR confirms circulating influenza strains fully align with the Northern Hemisphere vaccine strain, indicating current influenza vaccines remain protective in India. H1N1 and seasonal flu are typically self-limiting. Principal symptoms include high fever with chills, persistent cough and sore throat, headache and muscle pains, and extreme fatigue; most patients recover in a few days with rest and fluids. High-risk groups include young children, the elderly, and individuals with asthma, diabetes, heart disease, or weakened immunity; seek prompt medical care if symptoms persist or breathing becomes difficult. In Delhi, a high-level health meeting chaired by Health Minister J.P. Nadda reviewed preparedness for seasonal and vector-borne diseases; Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh stated the capital has adequate beds, doctors, medicines, and equipment to ensure timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1インフルエンザ：インドで新たな変異株は見つからず、ICMRが助言「パニックになる必要はない」；症状と予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: ICMRが新規変異株なし・ワクチン有効性維持を確認し、季節性インフルエンザとして通常の枠内と評価されており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デリーでの季節性・媒介性疾患への備え会議が言及されているが、これはルーチンの公衆衛生対応であり、新たな脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lakhimpur Kheri : बारिश में क्यों बढ़ जाता स्क्रब टाइफस का खतरा, लखीमपुर में अलर्ट स्वास्थ्य विभाग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lakhimpur Kheri: Why scrub typhus risk increases during the rains, Health Department on alert in Lakhimpur.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus risk rises in Lakhimpur Kheri during the monsoon as humidity in fields, shrubs, and grassy areas increases mite activity; health authorities are on alert. No cases have been reported in 2026 so far, though the district has previously seen infections (2021:7; 2022:12; 2023:22; 2024:13; 2025:14). Scrub typhus is transmitted by bites of infected mites. Early symptoms begin with fever and can include high fever, headache, body pains, extreme fatigue, and skin rashes, often resembling dengue or viral fever and leading to delayed diagnosis. If fever persists or rashes appear, seek medical evaluation promptly rather than self-medicating. Prevention emphasizes wearing full-sleeve clothing, covering most of the body, avoiding unnecessary entry into grassy or brushy areas, and heightened vigilance for workers in fields during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: ラキンプル・ケリ：雨季にツツガムシ病のリスクが高まる理由、ラキンプルで保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 2026年時点で症例報告なく、季節性の注意喚起記事に留まり、IHR・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 過去数年の季節的発生実績を踏まえた予防喚起記事であり、2026年の新規症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果伊波拉疫情升温 台延长管制至11月底 | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo intensifies; Taiwan extends control measures until the end of November.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists with 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths (case fatality ~47%), as of Aug 16 per WHO; Ituri Province accounts for about 84% of cases. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases, mainly linked to cross-border movement and medical care exposure, with no community transmission and a 42-day monitoring window through Aug 27. Taiwan's CDC extends border controls on the DRC through Nov 28; Uganda’s restrictions will be reviewed, potentially lifting on Aug 28 if no new cases by Aug 27. MSF reports over 2,000 patients admitted, more than 800 confirmed Ebola, and roughly one death every 30 minutes in the past week. Many deaths occur outside treatment centers, prompting calls to extend community-based surveillance, rapid patient transfer, more isolation beds, and stronger health-worker protection. Travelers with DRC/Uganda exposure must report on entry and undergo 21 days of self-monitoring; visas to DRC/Uganda are suspended except humanitarian cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大、台湾は11月末まで管理措置を延長
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行（5,021例、致死率47%）し、ウガンダにも越境事例が確認され、台湾が渡航制限を延長するなど国際的対応が発生しているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは越境感染事例として言及されているが対象国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情升溫 台延長管制至11月底 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak intensifies; Taiwan extends restrictions to the end of November | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 5,021 cumulative cases and 2,378 deaths (case fatality ~47%) as of Aug 16, per WHO, with Ituri Province accounting for about 84% of cases. Uganda reports 20 cases linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure; no community transmission, and a 42‑day monitoring period since June 21, expected to end Aug 27. Taiwan extends border controls on DRC and Uganda by 90 days to Nov 28; visa issuance suspended for residents of these countries with four humanitarian exceptions. Travelers with Congo/Uganda travel history must report to quarantine; asymptomatic individuals may undergo free airport testing and perform 21 days of self-health management. As of Aug 20, 5 Congolese and 38 Ugandans are under self-health management; 10 more volunteered for testing—all negative. MSF reports >60% of deaths outside Ebola treatment centers, with >2,000 patients treated and >800 confirmed infections; about one death every 30 minutes last week, prompting emphasis on community outreach, expanded beds, and frontline protection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ出血熱の流行が悪化、台湾は入国制限を11月末まで延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率約47%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの越境例や台湾による渡航制限強化など国際的な波及・対応が確認されているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。累計5,021例・死亡2,378例、致死率約47%、イツリ州が症例の約84%を占める。MSFは治療センター外での死亡が6割超と報告し、人道支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: DoH steps up lepto battle
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines: 3,760 cases nationwide from Jan 4 to mid-August 2026, with 3 deaths; total below 2025’s pace. Floodwaters may be contaminated with rat urine; individuals wading through floods should seek medical advice within 24–48 hours for assessment and possible doxycycline prophylaxis. DoH has positioned over 3.1 million doxycycline capsules for immediate post-exposure use. San Lazaro Hospital in Manila opened express lanes after recording 50 active leptospirosis cases and two deaths amid floods; SLH currently has 60 leptospirosis patients (22 new admissions, 19 severe). Notable cases include a patient who waded through floodwaters; another boy transferred from Gat Andres Bonifacio Medical Center to SLH for dialysis due to elevated creatinine and BUN, dialysis unavailable at SLH at that time. Severe disease can affect kidneys, liver, and respiratory system; outbreak linked to heavy rains and the southwest monsoon."}{

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、レプトスピラ症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで毎年発生する季節性のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで、重症例・死亡例はあるが昨年より少ないペースであり、国際的拡大リスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 洪水関連の季節性レプトスピラ症で、DoHが予防的ドキシサイクリン配布など対応済み。人-人感染はなく国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、重症例・透析事例があり医療リソースへの負荷は継続的に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: No new H1N1 strain identified, says ICMR as Delhi cases cross 1,777 - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Delhi has reported more than 1,777 H1N1 cases, with Influenza-A over 2,392 and Influenza-B at 210; no deaths reported. ICMR clarifies there is no new H1N1 strain, and circulating strains have persisted since 2025. The H1N1 pdm09-like virus is A/Missouri/11/2025, clade 6B.1A.5a2a, subclade D.3.1.1, well matched to Northern Hemisphere vaccine strains. Symptoms include fever, cough, headache and body ache, with most individuals recovering with appropriate care; young children, the elderly and those with underlying conditions are at greater risk of complications. Delhi and national surveillance continue via the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP); AIIMS and NCDC are designated referral laboratories. Public health guidance emphasizes cough etiquette, hand hygiene, avoiding close contact with respiratory cases, not touching the face, and avoiding spitting in public. Some cases may be more severe, but there is no cause for panic.

triage.headline_ja: ICMR、新たなH1N1株は確認されずと発表 ― デリーの感染者数は1,777人を超える
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1/インフルエンザA・B症例数が増加しているが、ICMRは新型株ではなく2025年以降流行中の既知株であり、死亡例もないと説明しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で確認されていない。
triage.notes: ICMRは既知の季節性インフルエンザ株（H1N1pdm09様ウイルス A/Missouri/11/2025、クレードD.3.1.1）であり、ワクチン株と適合していると説明。死亡例なく、既存のサーベイランス体制（IHIP、AIIMS、NCDC）で対応中。症例数増加のトレンドを継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: León XIV pide respuesta internacional ante el avance del ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: León XIV calls for an international response to the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda was designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the World Health Organization on May 17, with cross-border spread and substantial uncertainties about the epidemic’s magnitude. A United Nations report dated August 21 indicates the situation is worsening, reporting around 2,500 deaths in the last three months, with half occurring in the most recent 20 days. Pope Leo XIV urged the international community to mount a preventive, community-engaged response to save lives. The article also notes other tragedies: a mine collapse in Zamboyé, Central African Republic, on August 18, with over 100 fatalities, and marks the ten-year anniversary of the August 2016 earthquake in central Italy, emphasizing solidarity and reconstruction.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ拡大に対し国際的対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した越境エボラ流行が悪化しており、直近3か月で約2500人の死者が報告されるなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Папа Лъв XIV призова света да помогне в борбата с епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV urges the world to help in the fight against the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Pope Leo XIV urged the international community to double its efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, calling for the inclusion of local communities in lifesaving work. The outbreak predominantly affects northern and eastern DRC, where state presence is limited, health infrastructure is under-resourced, and armed groups have operated for decades, making control exceptionally difficult. The Pope emphasized that, beyond medical aid, effective organization, safety, and active local participation are essential to reach those on the ground. He noted his April Africa visit underscored the need for assistance to reach affected communities. In a broader message of solidarity, he also expressed sympathy for victims of a mine collapse in the Central African Republic near the Cameroon border and for those affected by a Central Italy earthquake a decade ago.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行との闘いへの世界的支援を訴える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はDRCで継続中の深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際社会への支援要請という社会的関心の高まりも見られるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は教皇によるDRCでのエボラ流行に対する国際支援要請が主題。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山崩落やイタリアの地震は別事案であり感染症イベントではないため対象国リストから除外。カメルーンも記事上では感染症発生地として言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Папата апелира за меѓународна помош за жртвите од ебола во ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Pope appeals for international aid for Ebola victims in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has 5,300 confirmed cases and over 2,500 deaths, with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak in May 2026 after cases in DRC and Uganda. The DRC health minister said more than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine have been received, noted as effective against other Ebola strains. Efforts to halt transmission are hampered by armed conflict in urban centers where the outbreak is concentrated. Pope Lav XIV appeals to the international community to respond, urging inclusion of local communities in prevention to save lives. Separately, the Pope prayed for victims of a mining disaster in Central African Republic, where over 100 died on 18 August in a gold mine in Zamboje, which had been closed prior to the disaster, calling for safety and rule of law at mining sites.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ犠牲者への国際支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,300症例・2,500人超の死者を出すエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がWHOにより宣言され、ウガンダへの拡大や紛争による対応の困難さから国際支援が要請されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山事故はエボラとは無関係の別事案であり、対象国でもないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 इन्फ्लुएंज़ा:निगरानी बढ़ी, लेकिन नए स्ट्रेन की पुष्टि नहीं; ICMR ने होशियार रहने के लिए क्यों कहा | H1n1 Health Update India Icmr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Influenza: Surveillance Intensified, But New Strain Not Confirmed; Why did ICMR Urge Vigilance? | H1N1 Health Update India ICMR
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, India’s Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) states that no new H1N1 influenza strain has been identified nationwide. Surveillance has been intensified amid growing concern. Health scientists report that current infections are linked to the seasonal influenza virus, not a novel lineage, and there is no laboratory confirmation of a new strain. The guidance advises the public to exercise caution, not fear, and to follow standard influenza precautions while authorities continue active monitoring for any genetic shift in circulating H1N1 viruses.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1インフルエンザ：監視強化も新株は確認されず、ICMRが警戒を呼びかけた理由とは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの監視強化に関する報道であり、新株の確認はないが当局が警戒を呼びかけているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 新規変異株は確認されておらず、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内とICMRが説明。監視強化の動向を継続的にフォローする必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: پاپ خواستار اقدام جهانی برای مهار شیوع ابولا شد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Pope called for global action to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 23 August 2026, Ebola remains a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (central Africa), marking the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the country, with rapid spread across a broad area and an unprecedented number of cases and deaths. The UN reports more than 2,500 fatalities linked to the outbreak. Pope Leo, speaking during his weekly Mass at St. Peter's Square in the Vatican, urged the international community to act promptly and highlighted that local communities must participate in prevention and containment to save lives, calling for expanded cooperation to limit transmission and reduce fatalities. The crisis underscores the need for broader international support alongside local prevention efforts as the outbreak continues to unfold in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、エボラ出血熱の流行を封じ込めるための国際的行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上17度目・前例のない規模のエボラ流行が発生し、死者2,500人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際社会への支援要請もなされているためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: バチカンは記事の主題（教皇の発言場所）であり、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Papieski apel w związku z epidemią eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Papal Appeal in Connection with the Ebola Epidemic.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-23, during the Sunday Angelus at St. Peter’s Square in the Vatican, Pope Leon XIV appealed to the international community to act regarding the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo. He urged collaboration with local communities in preventive measures to save lives amid the outbreak, noting the toll the disease has taken. The pontiff called on believers to translate faith into concrete action and to involve global partners in public health efforts, warning against complacency and reliance on second-hand beliefs. He framed the health crisis within a broader call to compassion and duty, inviting people to reflect on Jesus’ teachings and renew commitments in daily life. The address closed with greetings to the Primate Cathedral Choir of Gniezno. (Sylwia Wysocka, PAP)

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に関する教皇の訴え
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱流行について教皇が国際社会に支援を呼びかけており、疾患の重篤性と国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は教皇によるエボラ流行への呼びかけを伝える二次的報道であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・感染拡大状況等の疫学的詳細情報は含まれていない。コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行の現状についてはフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。ポーランド・バチカンは発生地域ではなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisadores da USP desenvolvem "vacina inteligente" contra chikungunya | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers from the University of São Paulo (USP) develop "smart vaccine" against chikungunya | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Researchers from the University of São Paulo (USP), Brazil, in collaboration with the University of Bonn, Germany, developed a maturation-deficient chikungunya virus vaccine platform. The engineered chikungunya virus can enter cells and stimulate immunity but cannot complete replication, since its maturation depends on an enzyme not present in humans or mosquitoes. In preclinical mouse studies, a single dose induced neutralizing antibodies and protected animals against chikungunya challenge; the formulation also elicited a response against Mayaro virus, indicating potential broader applicability. The approach aims to mimic live-attenuated vaccines while ensuring safety by stopping replication after initial exposure. If adaptable to other arboviruses such as Zika and Yellow fever, it could extend to SARS-CoV-2 variants. Findings are preclinical; translation to humans remains unproven. Funded by Fapesp, the study appears in npj Vaccines, titled “Maturation-deficient chikungunya virus elicits protective immune responses in a murine challenge model.”

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ大学(USP)の研究者、チクングニア熱に対する「スマートワクチン」を開発 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマウスを用いた前臨床段階のワクチン研究開発報告であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患発生ではなく、チクングニアウイルスに対する前臨床ワクチン研究（マウス実験）についての科学ニュース。実際の感染事例発生地域ではないため対象国リストには該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: PODCAST: Canada retaliates, robot runners and Ebola
article.articleSummary: UN warns over rapid spread of Ebola on 2026-08-23, highlighted in Reuters' Morning Bid podcast, underscoring ongoing global health concerns about transmission and surveillance. The Ebola note appears amid a broader round of headlines, illustrating how public health risks intersect with geopolitics and daily life. The episode also reports Canada promising 'dollar-for-dollar' tariffs in retaliation for U.S. 50% levies, a Chinese-made humanoid robot purportedly beating Usain Bolt's 100 m world record, and IndyCar's Freedom 250 Grand Prix racing through Washington, DC. Taken together, the segment reflects tensions in trade policy, rapid advances in robotics, and the persistence of infectious disease threats on the international stage.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャスト：カナダの報復関税、ロボットランナー、そしてエボラ
triage.triage_reason: 国連がエボラの急速な拡大を警告したとの言及があるが、発生国・症例数・重症度など具体的情報が皆無で、ポッドキャストの雑多な話題の一つとして触れられているに過ぎないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はロイターのポッドキャストダイジェストであり、エボラに関する言及は『国連が急速な拡大を警告』という一文のみ。発生国が特定できず、Bluedotが付与した米国・中国・カナダは他の話題（関税、ロボット、レース）に関連する地域であり、エボラの発生地とは考えられない。具体的な発生国情報が得られ次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ISPA dan Rabies Mulai Mengancam Ribuan Pengungsi Gempa NTT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acute Respiratory Infections (ARI) and Rabies Begin Threatening Thousands of Earthquake Refugees in East Nusa Tenggara
article.articleSummary: Earthquake-displaced populations in East Nusa Tenggara total 161,084, with Manggarai district hosting the largest cluster (46,519), followed by Nagekeo (34,256) and Manggarai Timur (31,372). Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) predominate at shelters, with 3,721 ARI cases reported. Rabies exposure is also detected, including 15 animal-bite rabies cases in Nagekeo and Manggarai Timur. To address the crisis, 11,106 health workers have been deployed: 134 doctors, 5,306 nurses, 3,974 midwives, and 1,647 other health staff. A shortfall of 133 health workers remains, notably 63 general physicians and specialists in surgery, orthopedics, neurosurgery, pediatrics, internal medicine, plus pharmacists. Of 169 affected puskesmas, 101 operate fully, 49 partially, 19 not at all due to building damage. BNPB has set up 6x12 meter emergency tents in Sikka (8 tents) and Manggarai (12 tents; 4 as emergency hospitals).

triage.headline_ja: ISPA（急性呼吸器感染症）と狂犬病、NTT地震避難民数千人を脅かし始める
triage.triage_reason: 地震避難民16万人超が集中する避難所でARI流行（3,721例）と狂犬病曝露（動物咬傷15例）が発生し、医療従事者不足・保健施設損壊により対応能力が逼迫しているため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は動物咬傷による曝露例（発症例ではない）が15件確認されているのみで重症度詳細は不明。ARIは避難所の密集環境下で流行しやすく、169保健所のうち19施設が機能停止、133名の医療従事者不足が報告されており、災害後の二次的感染症リスクとして経過観察・支援ニーズの評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Papa Leon face apel la acţiune internaţională împotriva epidemiei de Ebola din R.D. Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo appeals for international action against the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Pope Leo called on the international community on Sunday to help curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The outbreak has killed more than 2,500 people and spread across a large area of the Central African nation, with a record number of infections and deaths, according to UN officials. Speaking to worshippers in St. Peter's Square, the pope urged action that also involves local communities to prevent further fatalities. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and by the end of July 2026 it was the largest in the country's history by confirmed cases, surpassing the previous peak from 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に対する国際的行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模（2500人超の死者）のエボラ流行が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における第17回目のエボラ流行に関するもので、同国史上最大規模（確定症例数）とされる。バチカン市国は教皇の発言の場であり発生地域ではないため除外した。国際的な人的拡大の有無については記事に明記がないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Leão XIV recorda vítimas de Ebola e de desastre em mina na África Central
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leo XIV remembers Ebola victims and a mining disaster in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Pope Leo XIV addressed pilgrims in St. Peter’s Square, recalling two tragedies: an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and a fatal landslide at a gold mine in the western Central African Republic near Zamboyé. The DRC Ebola outbreak, first declared in May 2026, has claimed about 2,500 lives, with authorities deploying vaccines and describing it as the deadliest on record for the country. In the Central African Republic, the August 18 landslide buried and killed more than 100 mine workers, with rescue efforts ongoing. The Pope urged international and local communities to cooperate on prevention and safety in mining areas, offering prayers for the victims. He also used the Angelus reflection to emphasize a personal, ongoing relationship with Jesus and the meaning of faith in daily life.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、エボラ感染症の犠牲者と中央アフリカの鉱山災害を追悼
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2026年5月に宣言されたエボラ出血熱の流行が約2500人の死者を出し、同国史上最悪規模とされていることから、深刻性・異常性の両基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はローマ教皇の追悼発言を伝えるものであり、エボラ流行そのものの一次報道ではないが、死者数2500人・史上最悪という規模から既存の重大シグナルとして扱うべき。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山事故は感染症事案ではないため対象国リストの疾病基準には該当せず、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RDC: Balance preocupante tras 100 días de una epidemia aún sin controlar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: A worrisome assessment after 100 days of an outbreak still not under control.
article.articleSummary: 100 days into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the situation remains uncontrolled as the virus outpaces the response. Since May 15, six provinces and about 55 health zones are affected, up from one province and two zones. The spread is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, unlike the Zaire strain the country was accustomed to, contributing to late identification. International financial support has been substantial: promises total USD 1 billion, with Africa CDC reporting about USD 700 million pledged by partners for the response through NGOs. Governance-wise, Jean Kaseya says funds must be accounted for by the DRC government; Africa CDC coordinates, but the government must act. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, on Aug 22, urged all actors to do more to eradicate the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：発生100日を経ても収束せず、憂慮すべき現状
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの6州55保健地帯に拡大し100日経過しても未制御であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 通常のザイール株ではなくブンディブギョ株が原因で、識別の遅れが流行拡大に寄与している点が特記される。WHO事務局長も8月22日に対応強化を要請しており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Papa León XIV pidió respuesta a la comunidad internacional para frenar el brote de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV urged the international community to take action to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths, a case fatality rate of 47.6%. Pope Leo XIV urged urgent international action to curb the epidemic, advocating involvement of local communities in prevention to save many lives in the country’s deadliest outbreak to date. The appeal was made during the Sunday Angelus. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases. This underscores a severe, ongoing public health crisis in the DRC, requiring coordinated global support and community engagement to halt transmission and protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世教皇、コンゴでのエボラ流行を食い止めるため国際社会に対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模とされるエボラ流行が継続し、致死率47.6%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な支援要請もなされているためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染源や検査確定状況など詳細情報は不明だが、致死率・症例数の規模から深刻な流行と判断。教皇による国際支援要請は社会的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda as diferenças entre a Doença de Creutzfeldt-Jakob, que acomete Lito Sousa, e a 'vaca louca'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the differences between Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, which affects Lito Sousa, and mad cow disease.
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) and bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE, “mad cow disease”) are prion diseases. In humans, CJD has four forms: sporadic (≈85%), hereditary, iatrogenic, and variant (vCJD) linked to consumption of bovine products contaminated with BSE. vCJD tends to affect younger individuals and begins with psychiatric/behavioral symptoms before later neurological decline; sporadic CJD presents with abrupt cognitive and neurological signs (disorientation, memory loss, visual changes, ataxia, rigidity) and rapid deterioration. The disease is neurodegenerative and fatal, with about 90% dying within six months to a year after onset. In Brazil, SINAN records 1,576 suspected cases and 547 confirmed (359 lab-confirmed, 161 clinical-epidemiological, 27 unspecified), with most in the South, Southeast, and Northeast: SP 202, MG 57, PR 44, RJ 38, RS 35. The Ministry states Brazil has never recorded vCJD, nor a history of BSE-linked human disease from contaminated meat.

triage.headline_ja: クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病（Lito Sousaが罹患）と『狂牛病』の違いを理解する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCJDとBSEの違いを解説する教育的内容であり、ブラジルではvCJDやBSE関連のヒト感染例は報告されていないと明記されている。散発性CJDは非伝染性で公衆衛生上の緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 著名人の罹患を契機とした一般向け解説記事。ブラジルにおけるvCJD・BSE関連ヒト感染の報告は無いと明記されており、アウトブレイクシグナルには該当しない。散発性CJDの症例数（SINAN統計）は既知の背景発生率の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Artisanal miners keep digging for gold despite virus risk
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Congo, with artisanal miners in Iga-Barrière fueling transmission as mobile workers move between remote sites and population centers. The economy relies on small-scale mining, with many displaced workers seeking food and rent; others travel from nearby towns. The current outbreak has 5,375 confirmed cases across six provinces, with 2,557 deaths. Africa CDC says transmission has not peaked and could triple current levels, outpacing containment. Response challenges include mistrust and misinformation, and residents urge a nearby Ebola treatment center in Iga-Barrière to speed care instead of evacuations to Bunia. Some relief comes as 16,250 doses arrived at Kinshasa’s N'djili International Airport, part of 70,000 doses from WHO and partners, with more expected next week. About 2 million people in Congo work in artisanal and small-scale mining, linking livelihoods to outbreak dynamics. As of 23 August 2026, the outbreak remains uncontained.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウイルス感染リスクにもかかわらず、零細鉱夫たちは金の採掘を続ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは、6州にわたり5,375例の確定症例、2,557人の死亡を記録し、封じ込めが未達成でさらに悪化する恐れがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部（イガ・バリエール、ブニア等）でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを扱っており、キンシャサはワクチン到着地点として言及されているのみ。Africa CDCは感染がピークに達しておらず、現状の3倍に達する可能性を指摘。WHOとパートナーから70,000回分のワクチンが供給されている。

article.articleHeadline: Three-year-old girl tests positive for swine flu in Chhattisgarh's Durg; stable
article.articleSummary: An H1N1 swine flu infection has been confirmed in a two-year, 11-month-old girl in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, on August 23, 2026. The child developed cold and fever and was taken to a private hospital where tests confirmed H1N1. She has been admitted to an isolation ward and is under close medical observation; her condition is stable and she is out of danger. The health department is monitoring her family members for symptoms. Seasonal influenza, including H1N1, is typically self-limiting. Common symptoms include fever, cough, headache and body aches, and most people recover with appropriate care and rest.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州ドゥルグで3歳女児が豚インフルエンザ陽性、安定した状態
triage.triage_reason: 単発の季節性H1N1感染例で、患者は安定・軽症であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の単発症例で、患者は既に安定・回復傾向。地域保健当局が家族の経過観察を行っている程度で、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: بابا الفاتيكان يدعو لتكثيف جهود احتواء تفشّي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Pope Calls for Intensified Efforts to Contain the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest by confirmed cases to date, with 5,300 cases and over 2,500 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain spreading in the north and east despite weak health infrastructure and ongoing violence. The current outbreak is the seventeenth in DRC. Health authorities face obstacles including armed conflict, attacks on medical personnel and facilities, population displacement, and limited infrastructure. Kinshasa received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine, part of a WHO and partners’ 70,000-dose allocation; more doses are expected next week. Bundibugyo is a rare strain with no specific licensed vaccine or treatment; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola disease and may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, according to WHO. The Pope calls for intensified international and local collaboration to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、エボラ流行の封じ込め努力強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（5,300症例、2,500人超死亡）が拡大しており、武力紛争や医療インフラの脆弱性も重なり公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による稀な流行で、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が限定的である可能性があり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: USP desenvolve estratégia de vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: USP develops vaccine strategy against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccine strategy developed by the University of São Paulo (USP) in collaboration with the University of Bonn, Germany, uses a genetically modified chikungunya virus designed to undergo only a single replication cycle. The approach aims to activate the immune system while preventing infectious propagation. In studies conducted at the Ribeirão Preto campus (FCFRP-USP), researchers altered the viral genome to disrupt the maturation process—specifically the furin-cleavage sequence—so that after the initial replication, produced particles cannot infect new cells. The modified virus is further engineered so the sequence is recognized by an enzyme from tobacco mosaic virus, not present in humans or mosquitoes, thereby enabling immune stimulation without re-infectivity. In mice, a single dose protected the animals, indicating potential for a vaccine strategy against chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: JJ: USPがチクングニアワクチン戦略を開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はサンパウロ大学とボン大学によるチクングニアワクチン開発の研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生・流行に関する情報ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン開発に関する研究成果の報告であり、チクングニア熱の実際の発生・流行事例を報じたものではない。感染症サーベイランスのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Recall: More food products recalled across Canada this week over health concerns | INsauga
article.articleSummary: Several Canadian recalls issued this week for food products due to health concerns. CFIA-recalled cheeses from Bianca Murgia and other brands (distributed in Ontario and Quebec) involve Burratina/Burrata with generic E. coli noted as non-pathogenic; CFIA classifies these as Class 2 recalls (moderate risk) with no reported reactions. Wu Xian Zhai Vegetarian Beef and Preserved Beancurd products (108 g) distributed in Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan and Nova Scotia contain undeclared wheat, risking serious reactions for those with wheat allergy or celiac disease; CFIA investigation underway with potential further recalls; no reactions reported. OneTang Walnut Soft Candy with Black Sesame (Ontario, Manitoba) recalled for extraneous material (stones); CFIA Class 3 (low risk). Cardinal Roadhouse Chicken Burgers (Ontario, BC, Newfoundland and Labrador) recalled due to undeclared egg; Class 2 recall with egg allergy risk. Consumers should discard, not sell, and return recalled items where applicable.

triage.headline_ja: リコール:今週カナダ全土でさらに食品が健康懸念を理由に回収
triage.triage_reason: カナダにおける食品リコール情報であり、対象国リストに該当する国での感染症発生ではなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダ国内の食品リコール（E.coli非病原性株、アレルゲン未表示、異物混入等）に関するもので、対象国（フィリピン等）は発生地域として付与されているが記事の主題ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Glasgow scientists join urgent Ebola vaccine research as outbreak intensifies
article.articleSummary: Glasgow researchers study cross-protection of Zaire ebolavirus vaccines against Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid the Democratic Republic of Congo’s (DRC) largest Ebola outbreak on record, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths in DRC as of August 12, 2026. There is no licensed Bundibugyo-specific vaccine. The CEPI-funded project (US$4.17 million) analyzes stored blood from thousands vaccinated against Zaire ebolavirus, including participants from the Glasgow Ebola Vaccine study and Ugandan healthcare workers vaccinated during 2019, to determine whether antibodies elicited by Ervebo can recognise Bundibugyo. Conducted with Uganda Virus Research Institute, the work aims to map cross-protection, improve surveillance, and inform outbreak preparedness and transmission understanding in at-risk regions. DRC authorities are deploying Ervebo in the current outbreak. WHO/Africa CDC have released 70,000 doses: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline workers; first results are expected within months.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴーの科学者ら、感染拡大が続くエボラ出血熱に対する緊急ワクチン研究に参加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定4,665例、死亡2,184例）が継続しており、既存ワクチンの交差防御研究が進められている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、国際的な支援体制（WHO/Africa CDC）も稼働中のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はグラスゴー大学によるワクチン交差防御研究が主題だが、背景にあるDRCでの史上最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo種）自体が重大なシグナルであるため、DRCを対象国として抽出した。ウガンダ・英国・米国は研究協力先であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 100 jours d'épidémie Ebola en république démocratique du Congo : comment expliquer la flambée des cas ? - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 days into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: How to explain the surge in cases? - RTBF Actus
article.articleSummary: After 100 days in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola is spreading faster than health services can respond. This is the most extensive outbreak the DRC has seen. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola kills more than half of those infected, with deaths occurring 7–14 days after symptoms appear. About 2,500 people have died in the past three months, with half of those fatalities in the last 20 days. The outbreak has expanded from a single province to six. There are fears it could reach Kinshasa, the capital. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis described the spread as exponential, outpacing response efforts across the region. The article notes that containment is complicated and cites numerous, unspecified reasons.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行100日目：症例急増の理由とは？ - RTBF Actus
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州に拡大し、死者数約2500人、指数関数的な増加が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAに進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: RDC lucha contra el peor brote de ébola de su historia a los 100 días de su declaración | El Norte de Castilla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC fights the worst Ebola outbreak in its history 100 days after its declaration
article.articleSummary: On Aug 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, reaching 100 days since it was declared on May 15. The outbreak has killed more than 2,500 people, with about half of all fatalities identified in the past three weeks, according to UN agencies. The World Health Organization and UNICEF, cited by the European Commission, warn the virus is spreading at an exponential pace. The northeast of the country remains the epicenter, where long-running conflict complicates response efforts and endangers health workers. The report emphasizes the gravity of the situation and the need for intensified public health measures and protection for frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、宣言から100日を迎え史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行と戦う
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で死者2500人超、指数関数的拡大と紛争地域での対応困難が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHO・UNICEF・欧州委員会が言及する史上最悪規模のエボラ流行。紛争地域での医療従事者保護と対応強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: León XIV pide una respuesta internacional para frenar el brote de ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: León XIV calls for an international response to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Ebola continues to devastate the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 2,557 deaths and 5,375 confirmed cases reported. Pope León XIV urged the international community to mount a coordinated response to curb the spread of the outbreak and to save many lives. Speaking during his Sunday Angelus, the pontiff emphasized solidarity with the DRC and prayed for those affected by the epidemic, reiterating concern over its ongoing toll. The appeal underscores a call for global support, resources, and public health measures to halt transmission, though the article does not specify interventions. The focus remains on stopping further spread and aiding affected communities in the DRC amid the continuing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を食い止めるための国際的対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりDRCで死者2,557人・症例5,375人と大規模な被害が続いており、法王が国際的支援を呼びかけるなど社会的・国際的関心も高いため、IHR基準複数該当と判断しPICKUPとする。
triage.notes: 死亡者数・症例数が非常に大きく、既に大規模流行が進行中と考えられるため、フルリスク評価が必要。具体的な発生州や対応状況については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo dobio 16.000 vakcina dok ebola hara zemljom: Hiljade ljudi već umrle, zaraza se širi rekordnom brzinom - stručnjake posebno brine jedan detalj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo has received 16,000 vaccines as Ebola ravages the country: Thousands have already died, the outbreak is spreading at a record pace — experts are particularly concerned about one detail.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received its first large Ebola vaccine shipment, 16,250 doses of Ervebo, arriving at Kinshasa’s N’Djili airport as part of a 70,000-dose WHO-and-partners allocation; more doses are due early next week. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the largest in the country’s history, with 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths across six provinces, while WHO had logged 4,665 cases and 2,184 deaths as of Aug 12 (46.8% fatality). Ervebo protects against Zaire ebolavirus; cross-protection against Bundibugyo is unproven, so part of the stock will aid protection while Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are developed. Symptoms resemble malaria, hindering detection; only about 16% of contacts are traced and roughly 97% of deaths occur outside facilities. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and mobile mining communities complicate control; the WHO emergency was declared in May, and the outbreak could surpass 2014–2016 toll if unchecked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ猛威の中でワクチン1万6000回分を受領：既に数千人が死亡、感染は記録的な速さで拡大 — 専門家が特に懸念する一つの詳細
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、致死率46.8%）が発生し、WHOが緊急事態を宣言、大規模ワクチン配布が行われている。IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し、社会的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）で、紛争・住民移動・鉱山コミュニティの流動性が対策を複雑化。症状がマラリアと類似し検出が困難、接触者追跡率も約16%と低い。WHOによる緊急事態宣言済みで、既にフルRRA相当の対応が進行中とみられる。
