article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली के बाद नोएडा में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक, 14 मरीजों में H1N1 की पुष्टि होने पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट - noida reports 14 swine flu cases cmo urges calm prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu hits Noida after Delhi; 14 patients test positive for H1N1, health department on alert - Noida reports 14 swine flu cases; CMO urges calm and prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Noida in Gautam Buddha Nagar district has reported 14 laboratory-confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases after Delhi, with infections detected in private hospital OPDs. Chief Medical Officer Madan Mohan Mani Tripathi said patients presented with fever, cough and sore throat; a few reside outside the district. The health department is monitoring all cases and says the situation is under control, with an advisory for hospital managers to be issued on Monday. Dr. Adya Singh from the online medicine department noted that monsoon-driven weather changes have boosted viral activity, affecting children, the elderly, and those with preexisting illnesses. Preventive measures include hydration, balanced nutrition, hand hygiene, masking in crowded places, avoiding close contact and sharing utensils, ensuring ventilation, and seeking medical care for fever lasting more than 2–3 days or breathing difficulties. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics; antivirals may be used only on doctor’s prescription.

triage.headline_ja: デリーに続きノイダでもスワインフルー(H1N1)発生、14人が陽性確認—保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の国内既知感染症であり、当局は「状況はコントロール下」としているが、症例数増加や地域拡大が見られるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年インドで報告される既知の疾患。デリー・ノイダでの複数症例確認だが、当局は制御下と発表。重症度・死亡例の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: El papa León XIV llama a no convertir la fe en "una mera costumbre"; pide ayuda para frenar el ébola en la R.D. del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV urges not to turn faith into 'a mere custom'; asks for help to curb Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak globally and the deadliest in the DRC, with the most infections recorded in the country. The case fatality rate is 47.6%. About 737 patients remain isolated or hospitalized, and 1,167 have recovered. Contact tracing covers 85.5% of contacts, exceeding the 85% target. Pope Leo XIV urged international action to curb transmission and stressed engaging local communities in prevention to save lives, linking spiritual renewal with public health solidarity. The Angelus remarks call for renewed commitment at personal and church levels to support outbreak response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、信仰を単なる習慣にしないよう呼びかけ、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行阻止への支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（5,375症例、致死率47.6%）のエボラ流行が継続しており、国際的支援要請も出ているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 教皇による国際的呼びかけは社会的関心の高さを示すが、記事自体には国境を越えた伝播や渡航制限に関する具体的記述はない。致死率の高さと感染規模から、コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪のエボラ流行とされている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: BAU researchers report first scientific goats' Bcc detection
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh Agricultural University researchers report the first scientific detection of Burkholderia cepacia complex (Bcc) in goats in Bangladesh, published in PLOS ONE. In a BAU farm study, blood samples were taken from 40 Black Bengal goats: 30 with a history of respiratory problems and abortion, and 10 clinically healthy controls. Bcc was detected in samples from several ill goats; no growth in controls. Molecular work—culture, serology, PCR, DNA sequencing, and phylogenetic analysis—confirmed isolates as Burkholderia cepacia complex. Phylogeny shows strains closely related to Burkholderia spp. previously reported in India, Japan, and China. DNA sequences deposited in GenBank. The researchers caution that Bcc includes environmentally persistent opportunistic pathogens; however, the study found no evidence of transmission from goats to humans. This finding may prompt further investigation into distribution, possible sources, and implications for animal and public health. Funded by UGC Bangladesh and Ministry of Education.

triage.headline_ja: BAU研究者、ヤギにおけるBcc（Burkholderia cepacia complex）の初の科学的検出を報告
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュの農業大学によるヤギを対象とした学術研究報告であり、ヒトへの感染は確認されていない。公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にJapan/India/Chinaが含まれるが、これは系統樹解析上の近縁株の報告国であり、実際の研究・検出はバングラデシュ（対象国リスト外）で行われている。ヒトへの伝播は確認されていない学術研究報告。

article.articleHeadline: الحصبة في مواجهة العالم.. تراجع اللقاحات يعيد خطر المرض - صحيفة الوئام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Facing the World: Decline in Vaccinations Reignites the Disease's Risk - Al-Wiam Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in 2026 span Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with global infections estimated up to 11 million. Outbreaks include Burundi, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Somalia, Sudan, Yemen, and rising activity in India. In the Americas, Canada lost measles-free status in November 2025 after ongoing transmission; the United States recorded the highest measles cases in 2026 since 1991, while Mexico faces a risk of losing measles-free status. Vaccination gaps drive spread: Europe first-dose ~94%, second ~88%; LMICs first-dose ~80%, second ~70%. COVID-19 disrupted vaccination services and supply chains, leaving millions with zero-dose status. Surveillance is hampered in low-income settings by limited lab capacity, risking underestimation of totals. Containment requires higher vaccine coverage, better access, restored confidence, and countering misinformation; there is no specific antiviral.

triage.headline_ja: 世界に立ち向かう麻疹…ワクチン接種率の低下が病気のリスクを再燃させる - アル・ウィアム紙
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹が複数大陸（アフリカ、アジア、欧州、米州）で流行し、世界的に推定1100万人が感染、カナダ・米国・メキシコで麻疹排除状態の喪失リスクなど、国際的拡大と異常事態が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は世界的な麻疹流行動向の概説であり、対象国のうちDRCとインドが具体的な流行国として言及されている。他の対象国（ガーナ、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インドネシア、中国、タイ、フィリピン、ザンビア、ブラジル）への言及はなし。ワクチン接種率低下とCOVID-19によるサービス中断が主因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: PAPA LEÓN XIV PIDE RESPUESTA INTERNACIONAL ANTE EPIDEMIA DE ÉBOLA EN RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV Calls for International Response Amid Ebola Epidemic in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) triggers international concern as of August 20, with 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths. The case fatality ratio is 47.6%. A total of 737 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,167 have recovered. Health authorities report an 85.5% contact-tracing rate, slightly above the 85% target, underscoring ongoing surveillance. The outbreak is described as the second-deadliest Ebola epidemic globally and the most infections recorded within the DRC. Pope Leo XIV urged a coordinated international response that actively involves local communities in prevention and care, calling for strengthened prevention efforts, medical treatment, and community engagement to save lives. The appeal intensifies focus on international support and local participation to curb transmission in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世教皇、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に対する国際的対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.6%、5,375症例・2,557死亡というコンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: 教皇による国際的呼びかけは社会的関心の高さを示す象徴的事例。DRC史上最大規模・致死率の高いエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja más de 2,500 muertos en RDC a 100 días del brote; el Papa con reclamo internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves more than 2,500 dead in the DRC 100 days since the outbreak; the Pope calls for international action.
article.articleSummary: At 100 days since its May 15 declaration, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 2,500 deaths, with rapid spread amid armed violence and mass displacement centered in Ituri, where the Allied Democratic Forces operate. Displaced populations move toward North and South Kivu, where fighting with M23 militiamen challenges containment. About 260 attacks on health workers across six provinces have killed at least eight medical staff, with 43 more dying of Ebola. As an emergency measure, the first shipment of Ervebo vaccine arrived to target the Bundibugyo strain; some 70,000 doses are expected in coming days for additional trial programs, though efficacy for this strain is uncertain since no strain-specific vaccine exists. Over 60% of Ebola deaths have occurred outside treatment centers, often at home. The outbreak remains contained within DRC after a Uganda-border expansion attempt; international action is urged by WHO and Pope Leo XIV.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRCで発生から100日で死者2,500人超；教皇が国際的対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が死者2,500人超と深刻化し、武力紛争による対応困難と国境を越えた拡大の試みがあり、WHOと教皇による国際的関心も高まっているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国境への拡大の試みが言及されているが、記事では発生はDRC国内に留まっているとされているため、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Pope calls for more efforts to stop Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On 23 August 2026, Pope Leo XIV urged the international community to intensify efforts to contain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where health officials warn the outbreak is spreading exponentially. The current Ebola crisis is described as the deadliest in DRC history, having already killed thousands of people and affecting northern and eastern regions where state presence is weak and health infrastructure is severely limited. Armed groups and decades of violence undermine surveillance and response capabilities, complicating containment efforts and delaying timely care. The pope called for a response that also involves local communities to save lives, emphasizing solidarity and coordinated action. He has previously visited Africa in April.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行阻止へさらなる努力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、DRC史上最悪とされるエボラ流行が進行中であり社会的関心も高いため、フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 教皇による国際社会への支援要請報道であり、DRCにおけるエボラ流行の深刻さ（史上最悪、指数関数的拡大、武装勢力による対応妨害）が強調されている。詳細な症例数・致死率などの数値情報は記事に含まれず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Polytechnic hostel inmates complain of neglect amid fever spread
article.articleSummary: Madurai's Government Polytechnic College hostel on Tirupparankundram Road reports 13 fever and diarrhoea cases among inmates, with health officials planning a Monday screening to determine illness extent. Officials caution that the severity of illness cannot yet be established without formal checks. Residents allege neglect and compromised amenities: unreliable drinking water, worms and insects in stored water, a nonfunctional purifier, and a water outage that resumed only after protests. Sanitation concerns include only two toilet blocks in use, ongoing cleanliness issues, and removal of old steel cots from rooms. Food provision is questioned: refrigerator for vegetables out of service, reportedly insufficient milk and curd, and lack of expenditure transparency despite students paying Rs 15,000–19,000 per semester. Health inspectors will survey sanitation and water arrangements, and verify drinking-water systems. Some students were away on Sunday, and complaints describe being shuffled between the PWD office and principal Thenmozhi’s office amid delays.

triage.headline_ja: 工科大学寮の入寮者、発熱の流行の中で放置を訴える
triage.triage_reason: インド・マドゥライの単一の職業訓練校寮内で発熱・下痢が13例発生した局地的事例で、重症度や原因病原体は未確定。飲料水衛生の問題が疑われるが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至っていない。
triage.notes: 寮内の飲料水汚染・衛生設備不備が疑われる局地的な発熱・下痢集団発生。病原体・重症度は未確認で、当局による月曜日の健康調査結果待ち。感染症としての性質が確定していないため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1: ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಂದಿ ಜ್ವರ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಹೈ ಅಲರ್ಟ್
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1: Increase in swine flu cases in the state, Health Department on high alert.
article.articleSummary: On August 23, 2026, Karnataka reports a significant rise in H1N1 (swine flu) cases, with 4,125 laboratory-confirmed infections across the state from January to August; Bengaluru district accounts for a larger share. In response, the Health Department has issued preventive guidelines to curb transmission. Key measures include mandatory home isolation for confirmed or suspected cases; public masking; regular hand hygiene with soap or sanitizer; drinking hot water; avoiding touching the eyes, nose, or mouth; seeking medical testing rather than self-medication when symptoms appear; avoiding handshakes if cold or fever is present; covering while coughing or sneezing; and avoiding crowded places. District-level counts are referenced but not detailed in the excerpt. The article does not provide specifics on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1:カルナタカ州で豚インフルエンザ症例が増加、保健局が厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1感染増加であり異常性は低いが、症例数増加と州保健局の警戒発表があるため、重症度や死亡者数など追加情報を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1はインド国内で季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、今回の報道も州保健局による予防的注意喚起の一環と考えられる。重症度・死亡者数の情報が不足しているため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Could Be Three Times Its Confirmed Size as Vaccine Doses Finally Arrive
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 5,290 confirmed Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) cases and 2,516 deaths, with Africa CDC estimating only 30–40% of infections detected, implying tens of thousands may be affected. Declared a PHEIC on May 17, this is the fastest-moving filovirus outbreak on record and could exceed the 2014 West Africa epidemic. Detection and contact tracing are markedly insufficient: fewer than 10% linked to known contacts; 82% followed up, but total identified contacts were only about 16% of expected. Community deaths account for 97% of fatalities; overall case fatality is 46.7% (68.2% in North Kivu). Transmission likely began February 2026; WHO confirmed May 15. Vaccine doses: 70,000 Ervebo released Aug 18—20,000 for a Phase 3 trial and 50,000 for frontline workers; efficacy against Bundibugyo unproven; informed consent required. Outbreak spans six provinces and three countries; Ituri dominates with 4,447/1,984; North Kivu 663/452; Bas-Uele two; South Kivu limited. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are pre-trial; PARTNERS trial underway.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、確認数の3倍に達する可能性 ワクチンがようやく到着
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みで史上最速拡大のフィロウイルス流行であり、致死率極めて高く検出・接触者追跡が著しく不十分なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済み(2026年5月17日)。3か国・6州にまたがるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ワクチン(Ervebo)の効果はBundibugyo株に対して未証明であり、今後の推移を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: León XIV pidió apoyo internacional ante el brote de ébola y las tragedias en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV appealed for international support amid the Ebola outbreak and the tragedies in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Pope Leo XIV urged a stronger international response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, emphasizing the inclusion of local communities in prevention to save lives, after leading the Angelus in St. Peter's Square. He also referenced the Central African Republic's tragedy following the August 18 collapse of the Zamboyé mine, which left more than 100 dead. The pope prayed for victims and called for safety and legality in mining operations. He marked the tenth anniversary of the August 24, 2016 Central Italy earthquake, which affected Lazio, Umbria and Marche, causing 299 deaths, about 400 injuries, and over 40,000 displaced. The remarks connect faith to concrete solidarity and reconstruction efforts amid ongoing health and humanitarian crises across Africa and Europe.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世教皇、エボラ出血熱の流行とアフリカの悲劇に対し国際支援を訴える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し教皇が国際支援を呼びかけており、重症度が高く人道的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は教皇の呼びかけを主題とし、DRCのエボラ流行そのものの新規データ（症例数・死亡数・発生地域詳細）は含まれていない。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山事故やイタリア地震は対象国リスト外または本イベントの主題外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: apa pede esforços contra a epidemia de ebola na RDC, que completa 100 dias ainda fora de controle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: APA calls for intensified efforts to combat the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, which has reached 100 days and remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo marks 100 days with over 2,500 deaths, spreading across six provinces amid armed conflict and fragile health systems. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is currently the most disseminated, contributing to late identification since the May 15 outbreak declaration when only one province and two zones were affected; now about six provinces and roughly 55 zones report cases. The event is described as the deadliest in DRC history, with transmission outrunning the response. International funding promises total around US$1 billion, with nearly US$700 million already disbursed by partners; Africa CDC calls for rapid, transparent allocation to frontline teams and NGOs. The RDC government is urged to manage funds transparently. WHO Director-General Tedros, alongside the Pope, calls for intensified, coordinated international and community efforts to contain and eradicate the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: APA、DRCで100日を迎え依然制御不能なエボラ流行への対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2500人以上が死亡し6州に拡大するエボラ流行が制御不能な状態が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 武装紛争下で脆弱な保健システムのため対応が困難。DRC史上最悪の流行とされ、国際資金約10億ドルのうち約7億ドルが既に拠出されているが、透明性ある配分が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Cent dies del pitjor brot d'Ebola al Congo, amb més de 2.300 morts i 5.000 infectats - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One hundred days of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's worst Ebola outbreak, with more than 2,300 deaths and 5,000 infected - 3CatInfo
article.articleSummary: 100 days after the Ebola outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the current wave in Ituri and surrounding northern and eastern areas has surpassed 5,000 infections and 2,300 deaths, with the past week averaging about one death every 30 minutes. The Bundibugyo variant drives this outbreak, with roughly 50% mortality and no approved vaccine or treatment. Vaccines and containment measures are being scaled up: 16,000 doses have arrived; the WHO will deploy 70,000 doses of the Ervebo (Zaire) vaccine to test, though its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. Vaccination requires informed consent; alongside isolation, contact tracing, and treatment, authorities—supported by NGOs such as MSF—are expanding public-awareness campaigns. Transmission is rapid due to mobility linked to mining and insecurity; border regions near Uganda and South Sudan are hotspots. Kinshasa's Port of Bende-Bende screens river passengers for fever; incubation is 2–21 days. The 2018–2020 outbreak killed 2,300 of 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最悪のエボラ流行から100日、死者2,300人以上・感染者5,000人以上
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続し、死者2,300人超・感染者5,000人超、致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療法未承認、周辺国国境地域での拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・南スーダンが挙げられているが、記事本文では国境地域が『ホットスポット』とされているのみで、当該国での感染確認の記述はないため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCのみを対象国として計上。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra incentivises tribal participation to tackle high malaria burden in Gadchiroli
article.articleSummary: Malaria control in Gadchiroli district, Maharashtra, adopts cash incentives to prompt early testing and treatment. A tribal family will receive ₹500 if a fever patient tests positive; a vaidu (traditional healer) gets ₹200 for referring a patient who tests positive via rapid diagnostic test to an ASHA or primary health centre. Gadchiroli, Maharashtra’s worst-affected rural district and a high-endemic forest belt, reported 3,004 malaria cases from January 1 to August 15, 2026, including 1,680 in July. The district accounts for about 33% of Maharashtra’s malaria with only 1% of its population. Contributing factors include dense forests (roughly 70%), tribal health-seeking behavior, historical underinvestment, and emerging mosquito resistance to insecticides. An awareness campaign, weekly IEC activities in tribal schools, health booths at bazaar days, and widespread distribution of rapid tests accompany the incentive scheme.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラーシュトラ州、ガドチロリ県における高いマラリア負担に対処するため部族住民の参加を促進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病地域における既存の対策強化・インセンティブ導入に関する地方保健行政のニュースであり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアは風土病であり継続的な曝露はあるが、記事内容は地域保健当局による対策強化策の紹介であり、緊急性・異常性は低い。殺虫剤耐性の出現は今後の動向として注視の価値はあるが、現時点でPICKUP相当ではない。

article.articleHeadline: When measles returns: The rare brain disease that can emerge years after infection
article.articleSummary: SSPE (subacute sclerosing panencephalitis) is a rare, progressive, usually fatal neurological disease caused by persistent measles infection. After a child recovers from measles—fever subsides and rash fades—years may pass before brain-related symptoms appear. Early signs include cognitive decline: forgetting lessons, loss of previously acquired skills, and behavioral changes, accompanied by worsening school performance. As SSPE progresses, frequent falls occur, followed by sudden jerking movements and seizures. Over time there is a gradual loss of movement, speech, and vision. The report highlights SSPE as a delayed consequence of measles infection, underscoring the long latency and severe outcome of this brain disease.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再燃する時：感染後何年も経ってから発症しうる稀な脳疾患
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は麻疹の既知の合併症であるSSPE（亜急性硬化性全脳炎）に関する啓発的な医学解説記事であり、具体的な発生・症例増加等のイベント報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の麻疹アウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、SSPEという疾患の一般的な医学解説記事であるため、具体的な発生国の特定は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Papa pede esforços contra a epidemia de ebola na RDC, que completa 100 dias ainda fora de controle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope calls for efforts against the Ebola epidemic in the DRC, which has reached 100 days and remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo marks 100 days since it was officially declared, with 2,557 deaths among 5,375 confirmed cases. Pope Leo XIV urged intensified global action and local community involvement to stop the spread and end what is described as the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The appeal followed the Angelus prayers at St. Peter's Square. The epidemic continues in the northern and eastern regions of the DRC, where state presence is limited, health infrastructure is precarious, and several armed groups have operated for decades. The article emphasizes international support and community engagement as critical to saving lives amid the ongoing crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行への対応強化を呼びかけ―発生100日を経てなお制御不能

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Rise: Fever Hospital Sees 500 Outpatients a day
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Fever Hospital, Nallakunta, Hyderabad, reports rising H1N1 influenza with around 500 outpatients daily and 54 inpatients on Sunday. RT-PCR tests and influenza kits are used for symptomatic patients. Monsoon-driven humidity and shifting weather are linked to spread, with crowded places, schools, offices, and poorly ventilated spaces facilitating transmission. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, body aches, and fatigue; however these overlap with other viral infections, and not every fever is H1N1. Paediatric guidance urges hydration, fever management, and consulting a doctor if fever lasts over five days; infants with fast breathing require urgent care, and mildly ill children should stay home from school. Most healthy individuals recover with rest and fluids; testing is guided by severity and clinical assessment. Preventive measures include handwashing, masking when symptomatic, avoiding close contact, and not self-medicating with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1感染例が増加：発熱病院で1日500人の外来患者
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の患者数増加が報告されているが、重症度や社会的関心の高まりに関する情報が乏しく、フルRRAに進むには材料不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における季節性H1N1の地域的増加。Hyderabadの単一病院での外来患者急増が中心で、国全体や国際的な拡大の証拠はない。重症度（死亡率・重症例の割合）に関する具体的データが不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue em Foz: cidade completa dois anos sem mortes e amplia método Wolbachia para 100% da área
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Foz do Iguaçu: the city marks two years without deaths and expands the Wolbachia method to 100% of the area.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil, marks two consecutive years without deaths. The latest municipal epidemiological bulletin shows 3,535 notifications, 35 confirmed dengue cases, 3,345 ruled out, and zero deaths. In 2025, there were 1,031 confirmed cases; 2024 recorded 14,683 cases and 10 deaths, with the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) noting a substantial year‑to‑year decline. A Wolbachia-release program expands to 100% of the city: starting 25 August 2026, Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti will be released in 28 neighborhoods; the first releases occurred in 2024. The initiative is led by Fiocruz and Wolbito do Brasil with support from Brazil’s Ministry of Health, Paraná State Health Secretariat, and Itaipu Binacional. CCZ Technical Coordinator Renata Defante Lopes says the effort, along with community actions, reduced transmission risk; nevertheless, the dengue vector remains and residents are urged to remove standing water, tidy yards, and monitor for breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: フォス・ド・イグアスのデング熱:死亡者ゼロを2年連続達成、ウォルバキア法を全域100%に拡大
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例は減少傾向で死者ゼロが2年続いており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。ウォルバキア法拡大という予防的・肯定的な内容の記事であり社会的懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング対策の成功事例(ウォルバキア法拡大、死者ゼロ継続)を報じるポジティブな内容であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 'No new swine flu strain, don't panic,' says ICMR; Delhi logs over 2,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Delhi’s swine flu outbreak surpasses 2,000 cases this year, but ICMR says there is no new strain and vaccines remain well-matched to circulating viruses. The dominant nationwide lineage is A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1) pdm09-like, clade 6B.1A.5a2a, subclade D.3.1.1, in circulation since 2025. As of 23 August 2026, Delhi accounts for over 2,000 cases, with around 70% of last week’s respiratory infections in the capital due to H1N1; nationwide numbers are beginning to decline. Seasonal influenza is largely self-limiting, presenting with fever, cough, headache, and body aches; high-risk groups include young children, the elderly, and those with underlying conditions. ICMR calls for ongoing surveillance and warns against panic, while Delhi authorities report no shortages of medicines, beds or staff. Preventive measures emphasize respiratory and hand hygiene; WHO vaccine guidance includes A/Missouri/11/2025 pdm09-like.

triage.headline_ja: 「新たな豚インフルエンザ株はない、パニックにならないで」とICMRが発表、デリーで2,000例超を記録
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1季節性インフルエンザの症例数が増加しているが、ICMRは新規変異株ではなく既存ワクチンで対応可能と説明しており、全国的には減少傾向。深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態とは言えないが、症例数の多さから経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ株（A/Missouri/11/2025 H1N1pdm09様）であり新規株ではないとICMRが明言。医薬品・病床・人員の不足もなく、当局は落ち着いた対応を呼びかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DRC 'growing exponentially,' UN warns
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is expanding exponentially, with 5,290+ infections and 2,516 deaths since the May 15 declaration. Half of deaths in the past 20 days; the epidemic is spreading to an area larger than France, outpacing the response. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; about one death every 30 minutes. Approximately 160 healthcare workers have been infected, 43 dead. Frontline responders face security threats: youths attacking personnel, ambulances burned or stoned, and health facilities attacked, complicating the effort in Bunia and surrounding regions. The outbreak risks crossing into neighboring countries. Funding coverage extends only for the coming weeks; without immediate international support, delays will increase deaths, hinder containment, and raise costs. UN officials urge urgent international help to sustain humanitarian and medical deployments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が『指数関数的に拡大』、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で死者数が急増し、ワクチン・治療法がなく、医療従事者への攻撃や国境を越える拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、致死率が高い。医療従事者への暴力や資金不足により対応が困難化しており、近隣国への越境拡大リスクも指摘されている。国連が国際支援を緊急要請しており、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo lucha a la desesperada contra el peor brote de ébola de su historia a los 100 días de su declaración
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is fighting desperately against the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, 100 days after its declaration.
article.articleSummary: 100 days into the Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ituri province remains the epicenter with over 2,500 deaths reported. The UN says transmission is expanding exponentially, as violence by the Allied Democratic Forces (an ISIS affiliate) drives displacement into Kivu and hinders case tracking. Clashes with the Movement of 23 March have sparked a separate response in coordination with international agencies but without government dialogue. About 260 attacks on healthcare workers have occurred, with eight killed; Ebola has killed 43 others. The DRC has received a batch of the Ervebo vaccine, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo strain is uncertain and no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. More than 60% of deaths have occurred outside treatment centers. A Uganda spread scare subsided; in 2025, 236,000 Congolese became refugees in neighboring countries. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Gebreyesus warns the outbreak not controlled and calls for stronger cross-border surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最悪のエボラ流行宣言から100日、必死の闘い続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で死者2500人超、WHO事務局長が制御不能と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大懸念は『沈静化した』と記載されており確定例ではないため、ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれず除外。武装勢力による治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃・難民流出（周辺国へ23.6万人）が流行制御を著しく困難にしている点が特筆される。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン有効性が不明である点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : face à la progression d'Ebola, le pape Léon XIV appelle la communauté internationale à se mobiliser pour sauver des vies - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: As Ebola progresses, Pope Leo XIV calls on the international community to mobilize to save lives.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain spreading across multiple provinces. The World Health Organization warns the situation is far from under control and categorizes the outbreak risk as very high. Vaccination continues, with a first batch of 16,520 Ervebo doses delivered to support the response, prioritized for healthcare workers and community relays in affected areas. Pope Leo XIV, via X, urged the international community to intensify support for Congolese authorities and to involve local communities in prevention and outreach to save lives. Ongoing efforts include prevention, vaccination, surveillance, and community engagement to contain transmission and reduce fatalities amid continued transmission and international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ拡大を受け、教皇レオ14世が国際社会に人命救助への協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがリスク「非常に高い」と評価する第17次エボラ流行が複数州に拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが『制御下にない』と警告し、リスクレベルを『非常に高い』と分類。複数州への拡大とワクチン投入が進行中で、国際的な支援要請も明確。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Scare In India? ICMR Says No New Strain Detected, Situation Being Monitored
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza in India, including H1N1, shows no evidence of a new strain, according to the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The agency clarified there is no cause for panic as the prevailing influenza strains in circulation have been present since 2025 and remain well matched to the vaccine strains recommended for the Northern Hemisphere. ICMR emphasized that the current situation is being monitored and that laboratory assessments have not identified any emergent variant. The briefing notes that seasonal influenza generally resolves on its own, underscoring continued adherence to routine public health measures and vaccination strategies for the season. The statement focuses on ongoing surveillance and reassurance to the public, without reporting specific case counts or outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: インドでH1N1の懸念?ICMRは新変異株は検出されていないと発表、状況を監視中
triage.triage_reason: ICMRが新変異株の検出はなく、既存の季節性インフルエンザ株がワクチン株と一致していると公表しており、パニックの必要はないとしている。異常性・重症性・国際的拡大の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は懸念を否定する安心情報が主体であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの詳細は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 大陸新冠爆發驚人 病患遭醫院拒測核酸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Astonishing COVID-19 outbreak in Mainland China as hospitals deny nucleic acid testing to patients.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak intensifies in Mainland China with reports of hospitals denying nucleic acid (PCR) testing, offering only blood tests and not identifying the infecting virus. The July national curve shows 522,000 new confirmed cases, up from 79,000 in June, a monthly rise of about 560.8%, with 487 severe cases and 1 death. For Aug 10–17 (week 33), the PCR positivity rate stood at 21.2%, with NB.1.8.1 lineage still the predominant strain and highest positivity among ages 15–59. Outpatient proportions over weeks 30–33 ranged roughly 20–22%. Anecdotal reports from Shanghai, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Shandong describe patients being refused PCR testing, receiving only bloodwork, and not being told the virus type. Some clinicians warn that data may be falsified or underreported to downplay outbreaks, while noting harsh weather and disasters could accelerate transmission and drive new variants.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土で新型コロナウイルス感染が急増、病院がPCR検査を拒否
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の感染再拡大と検査拒否の報告はあるが、重症化率・死亡率は低く、情報源も政治色の強いメディアで公式確認が取れていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 情報源はEpoch Times（政治的立場が明確なメディア）であり、公式統計との整合性が不明。PCR検査拒否や過小報告の主張は未検証。重症例・死亡例は比較的少なく、既存流行株(NB.1.8.1)による季節的増加の可能性もある。

article.articleHeadline: 大陆新冠爆发惊人 病患遭医院拒测核酸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An astonishing COVID-19 outbreak in Mainland China; patients were refused nucleic acid testing by hospitals.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreaks in Mainland China intensify as hospitals reportedly refuse nucleic acid PCR testing, offering only blood tests and not clearly identifying the infecting virus. The Chinese CDC data show a July surge of about 522,000 new confirmed cases, up 560% from June, with 487 severe cases and 1 death. By mid-August, the weekly test-positive rate stood at 21.2% (Aug 10–17), and NB.1.8.1 remained the dominant lineage; among ages 15–59, positivity was highest. Over four weeks, outpatient COVID proportions were 20.3% (Jul 20–27), 22.3% (Jul 27–Aug 2), 21.1% (Aug 3–9), and 21.2% (Aug 10–17). Patient reports from Shanghai, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Shandong describe hospitals delaying or denying PCR, administering blood tests instead, with some diagnoses made only after days. Some experts question data reliability, suggesting underreporting of severe cases and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土で新型コロナウイルスの流行が驚くべき規模に拡大、患者が病院で核酸検査を拒否される
triage.triage_reason: 中国複数省で新型コロナ感染者が急増し（前月比560%増）、病院がPCR検査を拒否するなど診断・報告体制の異常性が指摘されており、データの信頼性・透明性に関する社会的関心も高いため、詳細確認のためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 中国国家疾病予防管理局のデータでは7月に52万件超の新規感染、重症487件、死亡1件と報告されているが、専門家はデータの過少報告（特に重症・死亡例）を疑っている。上海・浙江・江蘇・山東の複数省で病院がPCR検査を拒否し血液検査のみで対応している事例が報告されており、公式データの信頼性検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Noida: 14 Swine Flu Cases Surface After Over 114 Test Positive For H1N1 In Delhi
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) activity in Noida and Delhi: 14 people in Noida report intermittent fever, cough, cold, and sore throat after testing positive in Delhi where over 114 cases have been detected. Some cases (3-4) are from outside the district. Health authorities are monitoring all patients; an advisory to hospital managers will be issued. CMO Dr. Madan Mohan Mani Tripathi urges calm and outlines preventive measures: hydration, balanced diet, hand hygiene, avoiding rain exposure, and wearing a mask in crowds. If fever lasts >2-3 days, breathing difficulty, or worsening weakness, seek medical care; antibiotics should not be taken without consultation. OPD patients report viral infection symptoms, with children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities most at risk. Weather changes due to rain are noted as contributing to viral infections.

triage.headline_ja: ノイダ：デリーでH1N1陽性114人超確認後、豚インフルエンザ14例が新たに発生
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の国内発生で、症例数は増加しているが重症例・死亡の報告はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デリー・ノイダ地域での季節性H1N1流行。症状は軽度〜中等度（発熱・咳・咽頭痛等）で、地元保健当局が監視・注意喚起を実施中。死亡や重症例の報告はなし。今後の症例数推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Tangerang Menjadi Contoh Keteladanan Nasional Soal Pemeriksaan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tangerang Becomes a National Model for TB Screening.
article.articleSummary: Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia is named a national model for tuberculosis (TB) screening after exceeding national targets in the Free Health Checks (PKG) program and TB case finding. As of August 19, 2026, PKG coverage in Banten reached 5,934,010 people (100.60% of target), placing the province among Indonesia’s top three for coverage. TB detections exceeded estimates at 112% of the expected burden, with a 91% treatment success rate. A key driver is portable X-ray screening, integrated with noncommunicable disease screening for hypertension and diabetes mellitus. The government allocated 16 portable X-ray units through the 2026 national budget for eight districts/cities in Banten. In Tangerang, PKG reached 1.52 million of a 1.6 million target; the remaining 100,000 will be reached by September via outreach to children, the elderly, and pregnant women at posyandu.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲランがTBC検査に関する国家的模範事例に
triage.triage_reason: 結核検診プログラムの成功事例を伝える内容であり、異常な公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではなく、通常の保健施策の進捗報告である。
triage.notes: 結核の既知の流行地域における検診プログラムの成功事例報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: क्या H1N1 का कोई नया वेरिएंट सामने आया? ICMR ने बताया कितना अलर्ट रहने की जरूरत - icmr no new h1n1 strain swine flu not a major threat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has a new variant of H1N1 emerged? ICMR explains how vigilant you need to be — ICMR: No new H1N1 strain; swine flu not a major threat.
article.articleSummary: No new H1N1 strain detected; swine flu is not a major threat at present. ICMR says the circulating influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 virus in India aligns with A/Missouri/11/2025-like strains. In Delhi this year, over 2,300 influenza A cases have been reported. Typical symptoms include fever, cough, headache, and body aches, with most people recovering in 3–5 days with proper care. Risk of complications is higher for young children, the elderly, and individuals with preexisting conditions; seek timely medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen. Health Minister J. P. Nadda reviewed the situation, urging strengthened surveillance and adequate hospital readiness—beds, oxygen, ventilators, medicines, and testing. Public health guidance emphasizes avoiding crowded places, masking in public when needed, keeping distance from the sick, and avoiding touching the eyes, nose, or mouth with dirty hands.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1の新変異株は出現したのか？ICMRが警戒レベルを説明――ICMR「新型H1N1株はなく、豚インフルエンザは大きな脅威ではない」
triage.triage_reason: ICMRは既知のA/Missouri/11/2025様株であり新変異株ではないと明言し、大きな脅威ではないとしている。季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加であり、シグナルとして拾う根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はICMRによる安心情報の発信であり、新規株の出現を否定し、既存の季節性インフルエンザ対応の範囲内であることを強調している。デリーでの症例数（2300件超）は季節性流行として通常範囲と考えられる。保健大臣による監視強化・病院準備の呼びかけは予防的措置であり、危機的状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: le ministre de la Santé affirme que le virus est " très contagieux ", mais assure que la situation reste sous contrôle grâce à une riposte " robuste "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the health minister says the virus is "very contagious," but assures that the situation remains under control thanks to a "robust" response.
article.articleSummary: DRC is confronting the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, spreading across multiple provinces three months after the May 15 declaration. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba says the virus is highly contagious but the response remains robust and under control, despite differences from the Zaire strain that complicate public messaging. Authorities highlight rapid laboratory expansion, with 20 on-site labs established in two months to improve diagnosis. Emphasis is on early clinical management and preventive treatment for high-risk contacts to reduce transmission and severity. Vaccination is not a standalone solution; it offers partial protection and will be assessed alongside other measures. Kisangani is cited as a learning site, with expectations for more vaccine effectiveness data in coming weeks before broader use. WHO partners warn of high mortality risk, but the minister asserts ongoing control of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRC：保健大臣がウイルスは「非常に感染力が強い」と発言も、「強固な」対応により状況は制御下にあると断言
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）が複数州に拡大しており、高い致死率とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Kisanganiは学習拠点として言及されているが、発生地域はDRC全体（複数州）にわたる。WHOパートナーが高い死亡率リスクを警告しており、ワクチン効果データは今後数週間で明らかになる見込み。

article.articleHeadline: El papa León XIV exige respuestas urgentes por parte de la comunidad internacional a la crisis del ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV demands urgent responses from the international community to the Ebola crisis in Africa.
article.articleSummary: On August 23, 2026, Pope Leo XIV urged urgent international preventive action against the Ebola outbreak in Africa, centered on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 due to rising cases, cross-border transmission risk, and uncertainty about the outbreak’s scale. In the last three months, Ebola deaths exceed 2,500, with about half in the past 20 days, signaling rapid spread amid economic and health crises. The latest DRC Ministry update reports 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths (case fatality 47.6%), with 737 hospitalized and 1,167 recovered. A mine collapse in Zambayé killed over 100 people, drawing condolences and calls for mining safety and legality. The United States has allocated nearly $38 million in emergency funds, bringing total U.S. emergency support above $200 million to bolster surveillance and health-system capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、アフリカのエボラ危機に対し国際社会の緊急対応を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱がWHOによりPHEIC宣言され、死者数2,500人超・致死率47.6%と深刻。国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国からの緊急支援（総額2億ドル超）やWHOのPHEIC宣言など国際的対応が既に進行中。記事は教皇の発言を中心に、DRCでの感染拡大状況を報じている。

article.articleHeadline: Rain Alert: Telangana Health Department Warns of Seasonal Infections
article.articleSummary: As of 24 August 2026, Hyderabad, Telangana: with the India Meteorological Department forecasting rainfall for over a week, the state health department issued an advisory to guard against seasonal infections. Lower temperatures and higher humidity can foster transmission of vector-borne, waterborne and airborne diseases. Mosquito-borne illnesses highlighted include dengue, malaria and chikungunya; residents are urged to use mosquito nets or screen doors and windows, cover beds with nets, wear repellents, and eliminate standing water around homes. To prevent waterborne infections such as acute gastroenteritis, jaundice and typhoid, the guidance recommends drinking filtered or boiled water, washing hands before meals, and avoiding stale or unhygienic food. For airborne infections like viral fevers and influenza, avoid close contact with sick individuals, use hand sanitizers frequently, and cover coughs or sneezes with a handkerchief. Individuals with flu-like symptoms should visit the nearest government health facility.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季警報:テランガナ州保健局、季節性感染症に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性感染症に対する一般的な予防advisoryであり、具体的な症例数や異常な発生状況の報告はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の降雨に伴う予防的な健康advisoryであり、具体的な感染症の発生や症例数の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: After Delhi, Swine Flu Reaches Chhattisgarh. 3-Year-Old Tests Positive
article.articleSummary: H1N1 swine flu has been confirmed in a two-year, 11-month-old girl in Durg district, Chhattisgarh. The child is admitted to a private hospital's isolation ward and is currently in stable condition under close medical observation. Family members are being monitored for symptoms. The diagnosis followed initial cold and fever, with swine flu tests returning positive. Health officials said seasonal influenza including H1N1 is typically self-limiting; common symptoms include fever, cough, headache, and body aches, with most patients recovering with appropriate care and rest. As of 23 Aug 2026, this case follows reports of H1N1 in Delhi and indicates the spread to Chhattisgarh. No details provided on infection source or exposure. The article notes ongoing monitoring and isolation measures.

triage.headline_ja: デリーに続き、豚インフルエンザがチャッティースガルへ。3歳児が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の散発例で重症度は低く自己限定的とされるが、デリーからの拡大が報告されており動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザであり自己限定的とされる。デリーからチャッティースガルへの地理的拡大が報告されているが、国内での既知の季節性流行の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox Cases Doubled Last Fall as CDC Data Point to a Virus Settling Into Endemic Circulation
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) caused by clade IIb continues in the United States at low but persistent levels through 2024–2025, with a notable fall surge. CDC data show 2,803 US mpox cases in 2024 and 2,519 in 2025, with a seasonal spike: 423 cases in Sept–Oct 2024 vs 873 in Sept–Oct 2025, returning to background by December. Demographics remained stable: most cases were men, many who have sex with men; Black and Hispanic patients were disproportionately affected; median age around 35. Genomics show most US samples come from the same lineage as the 2022 outbreak; 21 likely importations, including 10 clade Ib cases from DRC; three Oct 2025 cases formed a domestic cluster with travel links, no wider spread. Vaccination matters: unvaccinated had higher hospitalization risk; two-dose vaccination reduces risk; 76% with known status had no doses. HIV doubles hospitalization risk regardless of vaccination. A sustained surveillance and vaccination effort is needed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のMpox症例が昨秋倍増、CDCデータはウイルスが風土病化しつつあることを示唆
triage.triage_reason: 主題は米国におけるMpox（クレードIIb）の風土病化を示すサーベイランスデータであり、対象国での主要な発生イベントではない。DRCは輸入症例の由来として言及されているのみで、DRC国内の発生状況を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国内のMpox（クレードIIb）の低レベルだが持続的な流行状況に関するCDCデータのレビューであり、DRCはクレードIb輸入症例10件の由来国として言及されるのみで、DRC国内の発生を主題として扱っていないため対象国として計上しない。米国は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les soins à domicile, facteur de propagation dans une aire de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: home-based care, a driver of transmission in a health zone - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, Ebola-driven outbreak activity in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centers on the Centre Soleniama health zone near Bunia. Home-based care is identified as the principal driver of transmission in the area, hindering surveillance and outbreak control. The health facility has not admitted a patient for nearly a month, attributed to community mistrust of formal health services and a preference for self-medication or at-home care. Resistance to follow-up by community health workers further complicates response and delays treatment for the sick. Authorities urge residents of Ituri’s Irumu territory and surrounding areas, near the Djugu border, to reconnect with health facilities, cooperate with medical teams, and abandon home-based care to enable rapid and appropriate management of Ebola cases and containment of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ:自宅療養が保健地域における感染拡大の要因に - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当し得る重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、コミュニティの医療不信による自宅療養が感染拡大とサーベイランス阻害の要因となっている点で流行しやすさ・管理可能性の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCイツリ州エボラ流行の継続報告。自宅療養によるコミュニティレベルでの感染拡大と保健施設への不信が主な懸念点。新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学データは記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Agra News: लंपी स्किन डिजीज ने किसानों की बढ़ाई चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agra News: Lumpy skin disease has raised farmers' concerns.
article.articleSummary: In Agra district, Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cattle has alarmed farmers as milk production falls. The outbreak has led authorities to seal borders with Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh to prevent entry of sick animals; only healthy cattle will be admitted. A rapid vaccination drive is underway, with vaccination completed in all government cattle sheds; of about 200,000 cattle in the district, roughly 150,000 have not yet been vaccinated. District Magistrate Manish has directed SDMs and ACPs to prioritize border sealing and vaccination. Farmers are also seeking advice from private veterinarians in addition to government facilities. The measures aim to curb the spread from neighboring states and mitigate the economic impact on dairy farming, as authorities monitor the evolving LSD situation in Agra.

triage.headline_ja: アグラニュース：ランピースキン病が農家の懸念を高めている
triage.triage_reason: 牛のランピースキン病がアグラ地区で拡大し、州境封鎖や大規模ワクチン接種など行政対応が取られており、農家・行政の関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 本疾患（ランピースキン病）は牛など反芻動物に感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの感染性はないが、酪農業への経済的影響と行政対応（州境封鎖・ワクチン接種）から動物衛生シグナルとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: When Farm Animals Get Sick, Human Health Is Often Next
article.articleSummary: Newborn camel dies from a gut infection in Central Asia; China reports the earliest documented human death from a bloodstream infection tied to Macrococcus caseolyticus, a staphylococcus relative once deemed harmless; and a sheep DNA vaccine field trial in West Africa suggests protection against Rift Valley Fever, underscoring how livestock health intersects human health. The editorial in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology synthesizes ten veterinary–zoonotic studies on bacterial and viral pathogens, virulence, antimicrobial resistance, host–pathogen dynamics, and disease-control strategies. Bacterial work highlights nutrient and iron competition in avian pathogenic E. coli and the emergence of virulence/drug-resistance genes in Macrococcus caseolyticus; coinfections in young camels with Clostridium perfringens; viral risks include persistence of viral material and cell-line–dependent results. Pandemic preparedness implications include swine influenza–induced microbiome shifts and Rift Valley Fever vaccine field data. Calls for integrated genomics, diagnostics, and microbiome-focused approaches.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜が病気になると、人間の健康も脅かされることが多い
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は複数の獣医学・人獣共通感染症研究をまとめた総説記事であり、特定の国での急性アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術的な総説（エディトリアル）であり、中国での症例は既往の1例報告、西アフリカでのリフトバレー熱ワクチン試験も研究段階。地理的発生地域として挙げられた中国・アンゴラは対象国リストの中国のみ該当するが、具体的な発生イベントではなく研究紹介のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Flu risk rises for older adults during rainy season
article.articleSummary: Bangkok, Thailand—Influenza risk rises for adults aged 60+ with chronic illnesses during the rainy season, with potential pneumonia, heart failure, and prolonged hospitalization. Nationwide influenza cases exceeded 1 million in 2025; in the first half of 2026, more than 200,000 cases were reported with 25 deaths. Annual vaccination is vital, ideally before or during the rainy season to allow immunity development; combine with masks, handwashing, and avoiding crowds. For older adults, high-dose vaccines—four times the antigen of standard-dose vaccines—offer stronger protection. Clinical data cited by the Infectious Disease Association of Thailand show a 24.22% greater reduction in infections, 31.93% fewer influenza hospitalizations, 6.6% fewer hospitalizations for cardiovascular disease, and 21.3% fewer hospitalizations for heart failure. Options depend on age and health; older adults with chronic diseases should consult a doctor.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に高齢者のインフルエンザリスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発・予防接種推奨記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する定例的な健康啓発記事。統計は過去のデータ（2025年通年、2026年上半期）であり、新規の異常な集団発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: خبرگزاری آریا - پاپ خواستار اقدام جهانی برای مهار شیوع ابولا در کنگو شد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ariya News Agency - The Pope called for global action to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-23, Pope Leo urged the international community to take immediate, comprehensive action to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), which has killed more than 2,500 people. The current outbreak is the 17th and largest in the DRC by confirmed cases, surpassing the record set during 2018–2020. Speaking from St. Peter’s Square in the Vatican, the pope expressed condolences to victims and pressed for multinational support and collaboration with local communities to save lives by stopping transmission. The appeal emphasizes sustained preventive efforts, international partnership, and urgent measures to curb spread in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: アリヤ通信 - 教皇、コンゴのエボラ流行阻止に向け世界的行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2500人以上が死亡した過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: バチカンは発生地域ではなく教皇の発言拠点であるため除外。DRCの17回目・過去最大のエボラ流行として既知の深刻事案。

article.articleHeadline: Peste: a doença medieval que nunca desapareceu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague: The Medieval Disease That Never Disappeared
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains endemic in parts of Africa and is rare in the western United States. Globally, about 3,000 cases are reported annually. Hotspots include the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar, which had a major outbreak in 2017; Madagascar experiences 250–500 infections per year. The disease presents in three forms: bubonic plague from flea bites causing swollen lymph nodes; septicemic plague in the bloodstream; and pneumonic plague in the lungs, the only form with likely human-to-human transmission. In 1347–1353, Europe suffered about 25 million deaths, roughly 60% of the population. Y. pestis may have circulated earlier; the ymt gene enabling flea transmission arose at the end of the Bronze Age, fueling pandemics. It disappeared from Europe after 1945 (Corsica last cases). Rapid diagnosis is crucial; misdiagnosis can be fatal, as in a runner. Researchers at the Robert Koch Institute aim to improve diagnostics, especially in Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：決して消えなかった中世の病気
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストの歴史・生物学・診断技術に関する一般解説記事であり、特定の国における現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: DRC、ウガンダ、マダガスカルはペストの『ホットスポット』として一般的背景情報で言及されているが、現在の具体的な発生事例を報じるものではないため、対象国として検証対象から除外した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू के संक्रमण किन्हें सबसे ज्यादा खतरा; क्या बोला ICMR?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu infections: who is most at risk; what did ICMR say?
article.articleSummary: India's health authorities, via ICMR sources, report no new H1N1 strain has emerged amid swine flu concerns. The influenza strains circulating include the existing H1N1 and other seasonal varieties, and the vaccines currently in use are effective against the circulating forms, aligning well with the antigenic makeup of the viruses. H1N1 and seasonal influenza infections are typically self-limiting, with most cases resolving with appropriate care. Common symptoms include fever, cough, headache, and body pains; while most patients recover, timely medical attention remains important, particularly for individuals at higher risk. The update provides reassurance about vaccine adequacy and ongoing suitability of the current vaccine formulations for prevention. No evidence of an unusual, more dangerous strain has been reported, underlining standard public health guidance on vaccination and symptomatic treatment in India.

triage.headline_ja: スワイン(豚)インフルエンザ感染:最もリスクが高いのは誰か;ICMRは何と述べたか?
triage.triage_reason: 既存のH1N1・季節性インフルエンザの流行状況を伝える通常の公衆衛生情報であり、新規株の出現や異常事態は否定されている。
triage.notes: 記事はICMRによる季節性インフルエンザ・H1N1に関する通常の注意喚起であり、新規の異常株出現は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak Hits 5,375 Cases, 2,557 Deaths as Vaccine Rollout Begins
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths as of August 23, 2026, with vaccine rollout beginning to curb transmission. The report confirms ongoing transmission in the DRC and marks a pivotal milestone as vaccination campaigns are deployed to affected communities. Health authorities are coordinating immunization efforts alongside surveillance to monitor case trends and identify hotspots, aiming to reduce further spread and mortality. The numbers represent cumulative totals during the current outbreak, underscoring the urgency of rapid vaccination, community mobilization, and sustained public health interventions across affected provinces. Published by KTN News on 2026-08-23, the piece highlights the shift from outbreak response to vaccine-supported containment.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱、症例数5,375人、死者2,557人に到達 ワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行し(5,375症例、2,557死亡)、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 致死率約47.6%と非常に高く、既に大規模な流行状態。ワクチン展開が進行中だが依然として継続的な感染拡大の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina Experimental Da USP Contra Chikungunya Protege Camundongos Com Uma Dose - ABC Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USP's Experimental Vaccine Against Chikungunya Protects Mice With a Single Dose - ABC Agora
article.articleSummary: Experimental chikungunya vaccine developed by the University of São Paulo (USP) and University of Bonn shows single-dose protection in mice. The approach uses a genetically modified chikungunya virus engineered to activate the immune system while being unable to sustain infection. The furin-cleavage site is replaced with a TEV protease–cleavage sequence, a enzyme not present in humans or mosquitoes; after vaccination, the virus activates but cannot complete a productive infection, producing immature particles that act as antigens. In mouse models, one dose protected against lethal chikungunya challenge and reduced viremia and disease signs in immunocompetent animals. The results, published in npj Vaccines, are not yet applicable to humans, and safety, dosing, and efficacy require further studies. Notably, vaccinated mice generated antibodies neutralizing Mayaro virus, suggesting potential for other arboviruses and platforms against Zika, yellow fever, and some SARS-CoV-2 variants. Funded by Fapesp; collaboration with Bonn.

triage.headline_ja: USPの実験的チクングニアワクチン、マウスに単回投与で防御効果
triage.triage_reason: 研究段階のワクチン開発ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマウスモデルでのワクチン基礎研究の報告であり、実際の疾患アウトブレイクや症例発生に関する情報ではない。ブラジル・ドイツは研究機関の所在地であり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Seasonal influenza cases under close watch in Bhopal
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza with H1N1 is under close watch in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, where authorities report three new H1N1 cases in the past week, bringing August's total to six. Patients present with prolonged cough, cold and breathing difficulties typical of seasonal influenza; symptoms monitored by officials and hospitals. Testing suspected cases remains crucial for timely treatment and assessing community transmission, with isolation facilities in place. High-risk groups, including the elderly, pregnant women, and those with persistent seasonal illnesses, are advised to seek medical care and avoid self-medication. Four government laboratories are sanctioned for testing: RMRCT (ICMR), Jabalpur; DRDE, Gwalior; AIIMS Bhopal; and the State Virology Laboratory at GMC Bhopal. The Centre urges coordinated surveillance and early detection; local bodies should raise awareness. Precautions include masking in crowded places and hand hygiene. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールで季節性インフルエンザの症例を注視
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例数は8月で6件と少なく、既存の監視・検査体制で対応中の通常の季節性流行報告であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の通常の監視報告。中央政府が調整的サーベイランスを促しているが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、既存の検査体制（4施設）で対応可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Les sénateurs et députés élus du Haut-Uele en tournée de sensibilisation contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The elected senators and MPs from Haut-Uele on an Ebola awareness tour - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 178 laboratory-confirmed cases since the outbreak was officially declared, including 75 deaths and 18 recoveries. On Aug 23, 2026, elected senators and national and provincial MPs from Haut-Uele launched a six-territory awareness tour starting in Isiro to boost community engagement, dispel denial, and reinforce adherence to preventive measures. Twelve national MPs participated, delivering messages in local languages to enhance understanding. The governor, customary chiefs, and the response team joined the mobilization, explaining Ebola’s main symptoms, prevention steps, and actions to take on suspicion. The effort aims to rebuild trust with communities, curb rumors, and promote rapid health-facility access. The campaign follows July outbreak activity in the province and references Ituri as a neighboring context.

triage.headline_ja: ハウト・ウエレ州選出の上院議員・国会議員がエボラ啓発ツアーを実施 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ハウト・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の感染確認例178例・死亡75例が継続しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある進行中のアウトブレイクであるため。
triage.notes: 記事は既に公式宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクに関する啓発活動報告。178例確認・75死亡・18回復という深刻な状況が継続しており、既存の対応継続案件としてフルRRAでの状況確認が推奨される。イトゥリ州は近隣文脈として言及されるのみで、確定症例の記載はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 三大傳染病毒 夾擊香港 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Major Infectious Viruses Strike Hong Kong
article.articleSummary: Three major infectious viruses threaten Hong Kong. Rat hepatitis E virus (rat HEV) presents with fever, myalgia, fatigue, then jaundice and dark urine, with a 2–10 week incubation; fecal-oral transmission via foods, water, or objects contaminated by rat secretions, including the hazard of drinking from a rat-crossed soda can. Alcohol-based sanitizers do not inactivate rat HEV; thorough handwashing with soap and water for at least 20 seconds or cleaning environments with 1:99 bleach is advised. High-risk groups include chronic liver disease patients, the immunocompromised, and the elderly; infection can trigger acute liver failure; no specific antiviral exists, only supportive care. Cicada virus (Omicron BA.3.2) mainly affects children, with COVID-19–like symptoms: fever, severe sore throat, dry cough, and loss of taste/smell; early rapid tests can yield false negatives, so throat swabs or deep throat saliva are recommended. Ebola virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) causes fever, bone pain, fatigue, progressing to hemorrhagic symptoms; incubation 2–21 days; transmission via contact with secretions, blood, or vomit, plus zoonotic spillover from fruit bats or primates; no approved vaccine or targeted therapy; mortality ranges 30–50%; management is supportive (fluids, electrolytes, ventilation).

triage.headline_ja: 三大感染ウイルスが香港を襲う｜am730
triage.triage_reason: 香港でのラットE型肝炎ウイルス、Omicron変異株、エボラウイルスに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な新規発生・症例数などの情報が記事本文に欠如しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はラットHEV、Omicron BA.3.2、エボラ(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)についての一般的な健康教育情報であり、実際の新規アウトブレイクや具体的な症例報告ではない可能性が高い。エボラについては香港での発生ではなく病気解説と思われるため、地域検証では香港（Chinaに含める）のみを対象とし、実際の発生状況の続報を要する。
