article.articleHeadline: Observateur Paalga - 17e épidémie d'Ébola en RDC : 100 jours après l'alerte, tous les voyants sont au rouge
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Observateur Paalga - 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC: 100 days after the alert, all warning lights are red.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is facing the 17th Ebola outbreak, with 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths across 55 health districts in six regions, 100 days after the alert. The health system is overwhelmed; healthcare workers are dissatisfied, and many people distrust authorities. The Bundibugyo strain is identified as the outbreak source, with no specific cure or preventive, complicating control and raising cross-border fears. The risk now extends to neighboring countries, especially South Sudan. WHO and Africa CDC warn of escalation; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for stronger action, while Africa CDC Chief Jean Kaseya criticizes funding delays. Kenya has trained 1,000 health workers and deployed 200 to aid DRC. Promises total about $1.5 billion, including $700 million from Africa CDC, but disbursement is slow and conditional. Vaccine trials in Britain and use of the Zaire strain raise mistrust.

triage.headline_ja: オブセルヴァトゥール・パーガ紙 - コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行：警報から100日、すべての警告灯が赤に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,375症例・2,557死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が進行中で、医療体制崩壊、国境を越えた拡大リスク（南スーダン等）、WHO・Africa CDCによる警告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスーダン・ケニア・英国も含まれるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での流行であり、ケニアは支援要員派遣、英国はワクチン治験実施国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。致死率約48%と非常に高く、資金拠出の遅延や住民の不信感も報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Railways Launch 10-Day Water Cooler Inspection Drive After CAG Flags E. Coli In Drinking Water Samples
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-23, a CAG audit found E. coli in drinking-water samples from water coolers at four Central Railway stations—Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, and Lonavala—prompting the Railway Board to launch a 10-day nationwide inspection drive. The effort directs all zonal railways and production units to inspect water coolers, clean tanks, and check for rust, leaks, lids and gaskets, repairing any leakage from taps or pipelines. It also mandates scrutiny of UV- and RO-based purification systems, ensuring regular servicing, timely filter replacement, and replacement of defective or unhygienic units. Surrounding area cleanliness and adherence to hygiene standards are to be verified, with comprehensive record-keeping. Senior officials will monitor implementation, and zonal railways must submit compliance reports to the Railway Board post-drive; routine inspections will follow.

triage.headline_ja: CAGが飲料水サンプルから大腸菌を検出、鉄道当局が10日間のウォータークーラー点検活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: 監査により飲料水設備の大腸菌汚染が指摘されたが、実際の患者発生や集団感染の報告はなく、予防的な設備点検・是正措置の実施に留まる。
triage.notes: 実際の感染者・症例報告はなく、監査結果を受けた設備点検・予防措置に関する報道。公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo recibe más de 16 mil dosis de la vacuna contra el ébola mientras lucha contra un brote sin precedentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine as it fights an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is fighting an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the fastest-spreading on record—across six provinces, with 5,375 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths. WHO data show transmission not yet peaked and potentially tripling the known rate, threatening to surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak's toll. The Ebola vaccine Ervebo, authorized for Ebola, has shown effectiveness in previous outbreaks and may offer partial protection against Bundibugyo; however, there is no specific vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. Doses: 16,250 arrived at Kinshasa's N'djili International Airport, part of a 70,000-dose package, with more expected early next week. Containment is hampered by armed conflict, attacks on workers and facilities, mobile populations, displacement, and weak infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、前例のないエボラ流行と戦う中、1万6千回分以上のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大懸念）、かつ社会的・国際的関心が非常に高い前例のない規模のエボラ流行であるためフルRRAへ移行。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種によるアウトブレイクで、過去最速の拡大速度、5,375症例・2,557死亡（CFR約47.6%）、6州に拡大中。武力紛争や人口移動により封じ込めが困難。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、実際の発生国として確認できないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus Sincicial Respiratório ainda preocupa no Paraná mesmo com queda de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Still a Concern in Paraná Even with a Decline in Cases.
article.articleSummary: RSV-driven severe acute respiratory illness (SRAG) remains a concern in Paraná and across several states (Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Roraima, São Paulo, Santa Catarina, Sergipe, Rio Grande do Sul) despite overall declines in SRAG over six and three weeks. InfoGripe Week SE 32 (Aug 9–15, 2026) shows most states with decreasing or stable SRAG trends; Rondônia, Piauí, Bahia and Sergipe report slight increases. Vaccination is underscored as the main prevention against severe SRAG from influenza, RSV and COVID-19. Eleven states are at alert/risk for SRAG in the last two weeks; four capitals—Aracaju, Cuiabá, Salvador, Porto Alegre—display SRAG growth signals over six weeks, while Belo Horizonte, Florianópolis and São Luís remain at alert without growth. In 2026, RSV accounts for about 42.2% of SRAG positives ( total 137,551 cases; 74,214 lab-positive), with influenza A 18.2%, influenza B 5.4%, rhinovirus 30.1%, and SARS-CoV-2 3.9% among positives; mortality is highest among the elderly, mainly from influenza A.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、症例減少にもかかわらずRSV（呼吸器合胞体ウイルス）感染が依然懸念材料
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの複数州における季節性RSV/インフルエンザ/COVID-19によるSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）のサーベイランス報告であり、全体的には減少傾向にある通常の季節的流行動態を示すもので、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: InfoGripe（ブラジル国内サーベイランスシステム）による定例の季節性呼吸器疾患報告。一部州（ロンドニア、ピアウイ、バイーア、セルジッペ）でわずかな増加が見られるが、全体としては既存の監視体制内で管理されている通常の季節変動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo volta a acender alerta no Brasil: vacina é a melhor proteção contra a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Again Raises Alarm in Brazil: Vaccination Is the Best Protection Against the Disease.
article.articleSummary: As of July 2026, Brazil reported 17 confirmed measles cases, with 14 still under follow-up in São Paulo state: 11 in the city of São Paulo, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one in Guarulhos. The outbreak underscores measles’ high transmissibility, as an infected person can spread the virus without direct contact and the virus can remain airborne for up to two hours after departure. Prevention centers on the measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine, with authorities stressing that vaccination protects individuals and the community. São Paulo State Health Department also recommends a zero-dose for babies aged 6 months through 11 months 29 days to extend protection before the routine schedule begins; however, this dose does not replace standard immunization doses. Adults without documented vaccination should verify status to determine if updates are needed, reducing further spread domestically and globally.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹が再び警戒を呼ぶ：ワクチンが病気に対する最善の防御
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹確定例が複数報告され、感染力の高さと未接種者への感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における麻疹の散発的アウトブレイク（17例確認、14例経過観察中）を報告。死亡例や重症例の記載はなく、国際的拡大の証拠も限定的だが、感染力の高さとワクチン接種呼びかけから公衆衛生上の注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ大流行は人災か　米なき国際保健の不安あらわに
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Ebola pandemic a man-made disaster? The anxiety of international health without the United States comes to light.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC, formerly Zaire) shows no sign of abating. Since mid-May 2026, emergency declarations have been issued; cases exceed 5,000 with about half resulting in death (roughly 2,500 deaths). If the trend continues, this could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. Ebola emerged in 1976, and Africa has faced repeated outbreaks in the past half-century. The article's title questions whether the crisis is a man-made disaster and notes anxiety about international health without the United States, highlighting reliance on global cooperation in medical and public health responses. Ongoing transmission in the DRC underscores challenges in outbreak control and the need for sustained international coordination, including implications for imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ大流行は人災か　米なき国際保健の不安あらわに
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,000例超・致死率約50%という過去最大級のエボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 米国の国際保健関与低下による対応体制への懸念が記事の主題の一つであり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。米国はイベント発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 코로나 중국서 지난달 52만명 확진... 국내서도 검출률 9.1%로 급증
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: 520,000 confirmed cases in China last month... Detection rate in Korea also surges to 9.1%
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 surges in China and rising detection in South Korea. China’s CDC reports about 522,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases in the last month, a more than sixfold increase from June, with 487 severe patients and 1 death. Omicron lineage NB.1.8.1 is driving transmission nationwide; in sentinel hospitals (1,041 sites) the positive rate among influenza-like illness patients rose from 8.2% at end of June to 21.2% by end of July. In Korea, the weekly detected rate stands at 9.1% for August 9–15, up from 5.7% the prior week and 3.2% three weeks earlier. COVID-19 hospitalizations in Korea increased from 23 to 56 at hospital-level facilities. The currently dominant local variant in Korea is BA.3.2, with the China outbreak still showing NB.1.8.1 circulation. Experts warn that summer waves reflect indoor cooling and waning immunity, with COVID behaving seasonally like influenza; high-risk groups should maintain precautions.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ、中国で先月52万人確定...国内でも検出率9.1%に急増
triage.triage_reason: 中国・韓国でCOVID-19検出率が季節的に上昇しているが、重症化率・死亡率は低く、既知の変異株による予想範囲内の夏季流行と考えられるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 韓国（Republic of Korea）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。季節性のCOVID-19流行として既知のオミクロン系統（NB.1.8.1, BA.3.2）が関与しており、重症例・死亡は少数。今後の重症化率や医療逼迫の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué pidió el Papa León XIV ante la epidemia de ébola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What did Pope Leo XIV request in response to the Ebola epidemic?
article.articleSummary: Pope Leo XIV urged an immediate, coordinated international response to the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, advocating a preventive plan anchored in local community engagement to mitigate transmission. His appeal aligns with the World Health Organization’s May 17 designation of the DRC-Uganda Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, highlighting cross-border risk. A United Nations report dated August 21 records approximately 2,500 Ebola deaths in the past three months, with half occurring in the last 20 days, indicating accelerating mortality. The Pontiff called for rapid deployment of preventive and medical resources by countries and international agencies. He also expressed solidarity with victims of the August 18 mining disaster in Zamboyé, Central African Republic, urging strict guarantees of legality and safety in mining, alongside prayers for the 10th anniversary of the 2016 central Italy earthquake.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇レオ14世、エボラ流行への対応として何を要請したか？
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRC-ウガンダのエボラ流行をPHEICに指定し、直近3ヶ月で約2500人が死亡するなど深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが明確であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにまたがるエボラ流行についてWHOがPHEICを宣言したことを報じており、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ、中央アフリカ共和国、イタリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC recibe 16 mil vacunas contra grave brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC receives 16,000 vaccines against a severe Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 16,000-dose vaccine shipment arrives to stem Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Health Minister Roger Kamba urges tougher containment and community-level controls amid a devastating toll. The government's strategy combines vaccination with intensified epidemiological surveillance and strengthened treatment centers to halt transmission, described by the World Health Organization as unprecedented in speed. Official figures report more than 5,000 Ebola cases and about 2,300 deaths, with the outbreak spanning an area larger than France, the largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded in the DRC. Rapid spread strains local response capacity and risks collapse without intensified humanitarian aid. Security and logistical barriers persist as health workers face hostility and direct attacks in conflict zones, exhausting the health system. The United Nations appeals for immediate international support: more specialized personnel, protective supplies, and funding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、深刻なエボラ出血熱流行に対し1万6000回分のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（5000症例超、死者2300人）が発生し、国際的な緊急支援要請もあることからIHR・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行が主題。フランスは地理的規模の比較対象として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تعلن ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" إلى 5514 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo announces an increase in Ebola cases to 5,514.
article.articleSummary: As of August 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Reported figures vary by source: Cairo News cites 5,514 confirmed cases with 2,642 deaths, while the Ministry of Health records 3,874 cases and 1,751 deaths. The outbreak is described as the deadliest in the DRC’s history and the fastest-spreading Ebola event there. WHO warns that containment remains difficult, with ongoing security and humanitarian challenges hampering response and increasing the risk of transmission to neighboring countries. The United States announced an additional $242 million in emergency funding for regional response, preparedness, and humanitarian aid. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this Bundibugyo strain, underscoring the urgency of containment and lifesaving measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が5,514例に増加と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最多・最速拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続し、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ国際的拡大リスクも指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 報告数が情報源によって大きく異なる（5,514例 vs 3,874例）。米国は資金援助国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点は特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Dispar dan Dinkes Bali Respon Travel Alert AS, Pastikan Bali Nihil Kasus Virus Zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bali Tourism Office and Bali Health Office Respond to US Travel Alert, Ensure Bali Has Zero Zika Virus Cases.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus remains unreported in Bali, Indonesia, despite a CDC Travel Alert Level 2 urging enhanced precautions for travelers. As of 22 August 2026, Bali's Tourism Office (Dispar) and Bali Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan) confirm there are zero locally transmitted Zika cases in Bali, following coordination with the provincial health department. The alert is advisory, not a travel ban, and Bali is described as safe and suitable for visitors. Authorities emphasize protective measures against mosquito bites due to tropical conditions and mosquito-borne disease risks, including dengue. Tourism stakeholders are urged to maintain high health and comfort standards. No details on imported or exported Zika cases or laboratory confirmations are provided.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州観光局と保健局、米国の渡航警戒に対応 ― バリ州のジカウイルス感染症例はゼロと確認
triage.triage_reason: バリ州でのジカウイルス感染は確認されておらず、当局がゼロ症例であることを明言している。実質的な公衆衛生事案ではなく、米国の渡航警戒への対応広報にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はジカウイルスの症例ゼロを確認する内容であり、実際の感染事例の発生を報告するものではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí chega a 15 mortes por dengue em 2026, aponta Sesapi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí reaches 15 dengue deaths in 2026, according to Sesapi.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Piauí reaches 15 confirmed deaths in 2026, per Sesapi’s arboviruses panel, with five more deaths under investigation. Through July, the state had 11 confirmed fatalities. Since year start, there were 16,960 probable dengue cases, of which 10,428 were confirmed; 550 showed warning signs and 31 progressed to severe dengue. The Ministry of Health notes dengue can affect all ages, but the elderly and those with chronic diseases (diabetes, hypertension) are at higher risk of complications. Most dengue deaths are preventable with early diagnosis, appropriate care, and a health network prepared to identify and treat worsening cases. Common symptoms: high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, weakness, joint pains, and red skin spots. In Teresina, the capital, 7,364 probable and 4,678 confirmed cases represent about 43% of state totals; one death is confirmed, three under investigation; 295 warning signs and 10 severe dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、2026年のデング熱死者数が15人に到達（セサピ発表）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州における季節性デング熱の流行報告であり、死亡者数・症例数は一定の規模だが、ブラジルでは毎年恒例の流行パターンであり異常性は低い。国際的拡大リスクも限定的なため、フルRRAには進まないが症例数の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健当局(Sesapi)による定期的な疫学データ公表記事。デング熱はブラジルで毎年季節的に流行する既知の風土病であり、国際的な緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Papa León XIV ora por las víctimas del ébola en el Congo y la tragedia en Centroáfrica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV prays for the victims of Ebola in the Congo and the tragedy in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Pope Leo XIV urged intensified international action to end the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, urging coordination with local communities to contain the outbreak and prevent further deaths. Speaking during the Angelus at St. Peter’s Square, he pressed for a strengthened global response to the health emergency and emphasized community involvement in prevention efforts. He also expressed solidarity with the Central African Republic after the August 18 collapse of a mine in Zamboyé, which caused more than 100 fatalities, calling for improved safety standards and legal oversight of mining operations. In addition, he recalled the August 24, 2016 earthquake in central Italy on its tenth anniversary, offering prayers for the families and communities affected, who suffered at least 299 dead, around 400 injured, and more than 40,000 displaced. The pope framed these crises as calls for international cooperation, prevention, and solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: レオ14世教皇、コンゴのエボラ犠牲者と中央アフリカの悲劇のために祈る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ流行が既存の公衆衛生上の懸念として言及されているが、本記事は教皇の発言を中心とした二次的報道であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・発生状況等の一次情報が不足している。
triage.notes: エボラはDRCで継続中の既知の流行として言及されているのみで、本記事自体は宗教的・人道的観点からの発言報道であり、疫学的な新規情報は含まれていない。中央アフリカ共和国の鉱山事故・イタリア地震は対象国リスト外またはエボラと無関係のため評価対象外。既存のRRA・続報の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Health Department warns of seasonal disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 23 August 2026, Hyderabad's Health Department issued an advisory ahead of the monsoon-driven rise in seasonal illnesses in Telangana. IMD-Hyderabad’s seven-day forecast calls for light to moderate rain statewide, with heavy alerts in several districts over the next three days, bringing cooler temperatures and higher humidity that may boost vector-borne, waterborne, and airborne diseases. Preventive guidance covers: waterborne illnesses such as acute gastroenteritis, jaundice, and typhoid—drink filtered or boiled water, wash hands, and avoid stale food. For airborne infections: avoid close contact, use hand sanitizers, cover coughs/sneezes, and seek government care if flu-like symptoms; call 108 in emergencies. For mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue and chikungunya: install nets, use repellents, keep drains clear, cover septic tanks with mesh, and observe Friday-Dry Day to reduce standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、季節性疾患の発生に警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・予防的な注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や異常な発生状況の報告がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に伴う予防的な公衆衛生アドバイザリーであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。具体的な症例数や異常発生の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : trois nouveaux patients guéris quittent le centre de traitement de Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: three more recovered patients leave the Beni treatment center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three more Ebola survivors left the Beni Ebola Treatment Center in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 23 August 2026, bringing the center's total cures to 12 since the first positive case in the Beni health zone. Among the three healed is a healthcare worker who treated patients in the community and was infected there; another is a nurse who recovered, praising colleagues and the community for adherence to isolation. They completed a 14-day stay at the center. Doctor Anicet Badirisha urged early treatment and trust in care providers, noting that Ebola affects all demographics. The government via the Health Ministry and International Medical Corps support the center.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：回復した患者3名がベニ治療センターを退所 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州ベニ）で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（累計治癒12名）を確認する記事であり、致死率の高いエボラは公衆衛生上の重大性・国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は回復患者の退所という前向きなニュースだが、ベニ保健区でのエボラ発生継続を示しており、既存アウトブレイクの進行状況モニタリングとしてPICKUPとした。International Medical Corpsが支援している点から国際的関与も既にあり。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. Mais de 2.600 mortos na República Democrática do Congo - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. More than 2,600 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Renascença
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 2,642 and infected 5,514 people since it was declared in May. The death toll is more than 100 higher than figures reported by UNHCR on Friday. The case fatality rate stands at about 45.8%. Data from the Congolese Ministry of Communications show the surge amid ongoing transmission, with the outbreak described as growing 'exponentially' by the report. The World Health Organization assesses the national and regional public health risk as low for the rest of Africa and for the world, despite the expanding outbreak. Information is current as of 2026-08-23. Details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or cross-border cases are not provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で死者2,600人超 - Renascença
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約45.8%、感染者5,514人・死者2,642人と大規模で「指数関数的」拡大が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と流行しやすさの観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは国内・地域・世界的リスクを低いと評価しているが、症例致死率が高く感染者数が急増しているためフルRRAでの詳細評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 〈社説〉エボラの猛威　対策を総動員して防疫を｜信濃毎日新聞デジタル　信州・長野県のニュースサイト
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Editorial: The ferocity of Ebola — mobilize all measures to prevent an outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo in Central Africa is experiencing an unrelenting Ebola outbreak, with WHO declaring a public health emergency in May; as of August 2026 the confirmed infections exceed 5,000 and deaths exceed 2,500. The pace now rivals the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids, with symptoms of high fever, headache, and diarrhea. The current strain has an estimated case fatality of about 40%; there are no established vaccines or treatments. WHO has donated about 70,000 doses of an unapproved vaccine, though efficacy against this strain is unknown. Public health response includes contact tracing, but several hospitalized patients were not among traced contacts, suggesting undetected transmission. The article urges vaccine development and stronger health systems, noting Japan’s role on the WHO Executive Board and its Tokyo training center for universal health coverage, while acknowledging concerns that the United States’ withdrawal from WHO weakens health security.

triage.headline_ja: 〈社説〉エボラの猛威　対策を総動員して防疫を
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、感染者5000人・死者2500人超と2014-16年西アフリカ流行に匹敵する規模であり、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は日本の社説であり、発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。日本・米国・アンゴラ・ナイジェリアは文脈上の言及であり、実際の発生地ではない。WHOが既にPHEICを宣言済みの重大なエボラ流行事案。

article.articleHeadline: Una zoonosis crea otra vez una alarma sanitaria: el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A zoonosis once again triggers a public health alert: Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD), caused by Ebolavirus species (notably Zaire ebolavirus), is a severe zoonotic infection first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the present-day Democratic Republic of the Congo. Natural reservoirs are frugivorous bats, with spillover to humans via contact with infected animals such as monkeys or wild antelope. Human transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids, contaminated objects or surfaces, or handling of deceased patients; it is not airborne. Incubation ranges 2–21 days, with symptoms including high fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting, rash, and potential hemorrhage. The 2014–2016 devastating outbreak hit Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, overwhelming health systems. Today, vaccines and monoclonal antibodies exist, plus ring vaccination and advanced isolation protocols. A One Health approach and strengthened emergency agencies are essential to prevent and respond to future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症が再び公衆衛生上の警戒を引き起こす：エボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ出血熱に関する一般的な解説・歴史的背景（2014-2016年の流行）を扱ったものであり、現在進行中の新規発生を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして識別しない。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な解説記事であり、DRC・リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネはいずれも過去の流行（1976年発見、2014-2016年流行）への言及であって、現時点での新規発生を示すものではない。したがって対象国リストに該当する新規発生地域として検証できない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 16 520 doses de vaccin réceptionnées à N'djili, sur 50 120 attendues d'ici le 24 août
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 16,520 vaccine doses received at N'djili, out of 50,120 expected by August 24.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: Kinshasa received 16,520 RVBO/Ervebo vaccine doses at N’djili airport on Aug 21, 2026, toward 50,120 expected by Aug 24, funded by Gavi and manufactured in Germany by MSD. The batch passed through Switzerland, Luxembourg and Belgium; no vaccination counts or schedule outside Tshopo were provided. The International Coordination Group unlocked 70,000 Ervebo doses for DRC from a 500,000 request. Ervebo is approved for the Zaïre strain, while the current outbreak is Bundibugyo, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists; use is compassionate. A northern vaccination process began in Tshopo with 2,000 doses prioritised for Makiso-Kisangani, Kabondo, Mangobo and Buta (Bas-Uélé); Nord-Kivu is preparing a similar campaign. As of Aug 19, 5,290 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,516 deaths (CFR 47.6%), with 1,152 recoveries and 837 isolated or suspected patients. Ituri accounts for 4,447 cases and 1,984 deaths (84.1%); Nord-Kivu 663 cases, 452 deaths (CFR 68.2%).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ンジリ空港で16,520回分のワクチンを受領、8月24日までに50,120回分到着予定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で承認ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率47.6%と高く、国際的なワクチン供給支援（Gavi、ICG）が行われている重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: スイス・ベルギー・ルクセンブルク・ドイツはワクチン製造・輸送経路として言及されているのみで、感染発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。現行流行はブンディブギョ株でErveboはザイール株用の適応外（人道的使用）である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 港大研究團隊制定全球病毒監測藍圖 善用航空樞紐 提早發現病毒變異株 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HKU research team draws up a global virus surveillance blueprint, leveraging aviation hubs to detect virus variants early.
article.articleSummary: HKU public health team proposes a global virus genomic surveillance blueprint that leverages international aviation hubs to detect new virus variants days earlier. By integrating about 9.5 million viral genomes with epidemiological data and the global air travel network, the model precisely tracks Omicron's global spread, its evolution, mobility, and the effects of local control measures. Focusing surveillance on two highly connected international hubs—Hong Kong and the United Arab Emirates—can reveal emerging variants about 2.6-3.3 days earlier than broader networks. The approach offers substantial cost-effectiveness: even with roughly halved global diagnostics or sequencing resources, focusing on aviation hubs maintains performance. The team also developed a high-resolution multi-strain, multi-population transmission model that merges diagnostic records, sequences, air passenger data, and outbreak cases, to assess strategies. While not replacing existing systems, the framework enhances global early warning and could be applied to SARS, avian influenza, MERS, COVID-19, and future pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: 香港大学研究チームが世界的なウイルス監視ブループリントを策定、航空ハブを活用してウイルス変異株を早期発見
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、学術研究チームによるサーベイランス手法の提案に関する記事であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではなく、香港大学による将来的なパンデミック早期警戒システム構築に関する研究発表。香港・UAE・中国は研究モデルの説明上言及されているのみで、実際の疾病発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de la situation epidemiologique du cholera en RD Congo (Interne OMS), semaine 32, 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report on the epidemiological situation of cholera in DR Congo (WHO internal), week 32, 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 August 2026 (week 32), the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,528 suspected cholera cases, similar to week 31, with incidence above 1,000 for several weeks ahead of the rainy season. Across 26 provinces, 16 have reported suspected cases in 70 health zones (out of 519). No new health zones were affected in week 32. South Kivu and North Kivu provinces together accounted for 52.55% of suspected cholera cases. Preventive oral cholera vaccination is planned in the Mulungu and Shabunda health zones (South Kivu) for mid-September, with community sensitization and funding approval pending. In North Kivu, armed clashes in five health zones have caused mass displacement and limited access to affected areas, worsened by poor hygiene and sanitation in zones returning from Masisi. Ongoing outbreaks require close monitoring ahead of the rains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるコレラの疫学的状況報告（WHO内部資料）、2026年第32週
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,528人の疑い症例が継続し、複数州・保健区域にまたがる大規模流行が雨季を前に続いており、武力紛争による人口移動とアクセス制限が状況を悪化させているため、WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil（Paraíba州等）が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCのコレラ流行のみを扱っており、Brazilへの言及はないため除外した。これはWHOの定期疫学報告であり、継続中のアウトブレイクとして紛争地域でのアクセス制限・ワクチン接種計画の遅延が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 中 코로나 다시 덮쳤다...한달 새 확진 6.6배 폭증, 한국도 '3배 급증'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in China hits again... confirmed cases surge 6.6-fold in a month, South Korea also sees a threefold surge.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 surges again in July 2026: China reports 522,000 confirmed cases (July 1–31), about 6.6-fold higher than June’s 79,000, with 487 severe cases and 1 death. Across 1,041 sentinel hospitals, the positivity rate among respiratory patients rose from 8.2% (June 29–July 5) to 11.2%, 15.3%, 19.5%, and 21.2% (July 27–Aug 2), meaning roughly one in five patients with respiratory symptoms test positive. The dominant variant is Omicron lineage NB.1.8.1. In South Korea, respiratory-virus surveillance shows COVID-19 detection at 9.1% of samples from 106 facilities (July 9–15), up from 5.7% the previous week and 3.2% three weeks earlier, with hospitalizations increasing from 23 to 56. These concurrent rises in East Asia underscore renewed transmission and elevated summer-wave concern.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でコロナが再び猛威...1か月で確診6.6倍急増、韓国も『3倍急増』
triage.triage_reason: 中国・韓国でCOVID-19陽性率・症例数が急増しているが、重症化率・死亡率は低く既知の変異株（オミクロン系統）であるため、直ちにIHR基準を2つ以上満たすとは言えず、動向注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 韓国（Republic of Korea）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。COVID-19は既知病原体であり、季節性の夏季流行拡大と見られるが、中国での症例急増（6.6倍）と陽性率上昇（8.2%→21.2%）は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 중국서 코로나 재확산...한국도 재유행 우려↑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 resurgence in China... South Korea also at risk of renewed outbreak.
article.articleSummary: China faces a renewed COVID-19 surge, with July reporting 522,000 new confirmed cases; among them 487 are severe and 1 death. The nationwide test positivity rose for five straight weeks and exceeded 20%. In the same period, South Korea sees rising domestic detections, with the second week of August showing a 9.1% positive rate, roughly 2.8 times higher than three weeks earlier. Authorities are closely watching neighboring countries' trends and domestic infection trajectories, and have stepped up public health measures to mitigate a possible summer resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でコロナ再拡散…韓国も再流行の懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的再拡大であり既知の疾患だが、中国・韓国双方で陽性率上昇が報告されており動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節性再流行は既知の現象であり、重症化率・致死率も低い（52.2万例中死亡1例）。韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は主題国として含める。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de la situation epidemiologique du cholera en RD Congo (Interne OMS), semaine 31, 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report on the Epidemiological Situation of Cholera in the DRC (WHO Internal), Week 31, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Week 31, 2026: 1,568 suspected cases and 59 deaths reported across 16 of 26 provinces and 67 of 519 health zones. South Kivu and North Kivu together account for about half of the suspected cases. The western region remains concerning, especially Sud-Ubangi. Three new health zones affected: Mulungu (South Kivu) with 69 cases/6 deaths; Kitenda (Kwango) with 5 cases/0 deaths; Oshwe (Mai-Ndombe) with 3 cases/1 death. Response activities include continued delivery and receipt of inputs for grid-based interventions in Kongo Central, Tanganyika, and Sud-Ubangi, with local procurement planned in Nord (North), South Kivu, and Haut-Katanga. Preparations for an Oral Cholera Vaccine (OCV) campaign in the Congo River corridor islands continue, with a joint DRC-Republic of the Congo cross-border vaccination plan developed with WHO support.

article.articleHeadline: Cochrane Map Reveals Major Gaps in Dengue Research
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention research mapped by Cochrane reveals abundant studies but few are synthesized into actionable, high-quality systematic reviews. The global map, published in the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews on 2026-08-24, identifies dengue spread by Aedes aegypti with Brazil reporting among the highest case numbers and disproportionate impact on marginalized communities. While research spans community education, vector control, vaccines, and environmental interventions, critical gaps remain in systematic reviews—especially for adult vector and aquatic-stage interventions, implementation, and behavioural outcomes. Of note, the adult dengue vaccine evidence mainly lacks real-world implementation data. Among 47 randomized trials and 140 non-randomized studies for community education, evidence on its impact on transmission is inconclusive. The EGM prioritizes four areas: environmental interventions, community education, aquatic-stage and adult-vector interventions. The authors urge updated vector-control reviews, better synthesis of implementation/behavioural data, and evaluation of adverse effects beyond vaccines; emphasize epidemiological outcomes over entomological surrogates.

Major outbreak centers lie in cities controlled by rebel groups and ongoing clashes with government forces hinder relief and vaccination efforts. The situation underscores urgent global collaboration and enhanced on-ground public health measures.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xplained: Why are swine flu cases rising in Delhi, and how different is H1N1 from COVID-19?
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases this year, with all government hospitals on alert as officials review the situation. Globally, H1N1 is less infectious than early SARS-CoV-2 (R0 about 1.46 vs ~2.5), and most infections are mild; its shorter serial interval (~3 days) and rapid household spread can drive local surges. High-risk groups include those aged 65+, pregnant women, children under 5, and individuals with cardiovascular, pulmonary, kidney or liver disease, or diabetes. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets within 1–2 meters; contaminated surfaces pose added risk. Oseltamivir is the preferred antiviral, most effective within 48 hours of symptom onset, and is listed in India’s National Essential Medicines List with availability in government and large private hospitals. H1N1 originated in 2009 in Mexico and became a seasonal influenza alongside H3N2 and influenza B; a Lancet study cited about 284,000 deaths in the first year.

Common symptoms include high fever, headache or retro-orbital pain, nausea, weakness, joint pains, and red body spots; seek care for severe abdominal pain, vomiting, dizziness, breathing difficulty, bleeding, or extreme fatigue. article.articleHeadline: Cochrane Map Reveals Major Evidence Gaps in Dengue Prevention Research
article.articleSummary: Global dengue prevention research mapped by Cochrane reveals hundreds of primary studies on transmission reduction but few are synthesized into current reviews to support policy. Published 2026-08-24 in the Cochrane Database, the evidence and gap map consolidates primary studies and systematic reviews to show where evidence exists and where gaps persist. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti in urban settings, remains especially burdensome in Brazil, with climate change and inadequate water management driving spread. The map classifies evidence by intervention and outcome, highlighting gaps where interventions reduce mosquitoes but not infections, or are difficult to implement at scale. Community education is relatively well-documented (47 randomized trials, 140 non-randomized). Yet robust conclusions on population-level infection reduction, long-term effects, implementation, and real-world vaccine uptake are limited, underscoring the need for targeted synthesis to inform policy.

article.articleHeadline: 4,000 साल पहले भी ये बीमारी लोगों को करती परेशान, भारत में आज भी मिलते हैं इसके निशान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even 4,000 years ago this disease troubled people, and its traces are still found in India today.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) in India has ancient roots. A 2000 BCE skull from Balathal, Rajasthan, showed leprosy lesions, indicating the disease existed in ancient India (late Indus Valley), per a PLOS ONE study published May 27, 2009. Today India continues to report new cases; WHO records over 107,000 new leprosy cases in 2023–24, a large share of global cases. Leprosy is caused by Mycobacterium leprae and chiefly affects skin, nerves, and eyes; if untreated, it can cause permanent damage to various organs. Modern multidrug therapy can cure it. Social stigma remains a major barrier to care. In Delhi, Fortis Hospital's consultant nephrologist Dr. Bhanu Mishra notes that early symptoms are often ignored due to stigma, underscoring the need for awareness and access to MDT.

article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) receives 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to bolster the response to an unprecedented Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Ervebo is authorized against Zaire ebolavirus, with no approved indication for Bundibugyo; 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 trial assessing potential protection against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses will vaccinate frontline health workers per WHO SAGE guidance. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to 54 health zones across six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. Confirmation occurred on May 15, 2026. As of Aug 12, there were 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality ~46.8%); by Aug 18, 5,208 cases and >2,476 deaths (~47.5%). No vaccines are specifically authorized for Bundibugyo; laboratory and animal data hint at possible protection, but clinical evidence in humans is lacking.

article.articleSummary: As of August 24, 2026, India reports rising H1N1 influenza cases in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Maharashtra, prompting concerns about a new swine flu variant. ICMR scientists and health experts state genome sequencing and regular surveillance show no significant virus changes; no new mutation or virulent strain detected. The circulating infection is the ordinary seasonal H1N1, spreading with monsoon humidity and temperature fluctuations. Hospitals are reportedly fully prepared, with ample antivirals, testing kits, and isolation beds across major public and private facilities; the situation is not a pandemic or emergency, though cases have increased and hospitalizations remain low. High-risk groups include adults over 65, young children, pregnant women, and individuals with diabetes or asthma. Precautions: seek medical advice promptly on symptoms, wear masks in crowded areas, practice hand hygiene, and cover coughs or sneezes with a tissue.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1株最新情報：新たな豚インフルエンザ変異株は出現したのか？病院は万全の準備、注意喚起を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例増加が報告されているが、ICMRは新規変異株ではないと確認しており、パンデミックや緊急事態でもないため現時点でのフルRRA移行基準は満たさないが、継続的な監視は必要。
triage.notes: ICMRにより新規変異株ではないと否定されており、季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行動態とされる。病院の対応能力も十分と報告されているため深刻度は低いが、複数州での症例増加と社会的関心の高まりから経過観察の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DRC hit 5,515 as Pope Leo urges global action to save lives
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 5,515 confirmed cases and 2,642 deaths; 51 new cases detected in Ituri and North Kivu as of Aug 24, 2026. Declared mid-May, this Bundibugyo-strain outbreak is the DRC's 17th Ebola event and a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with Uganda in the risk area. The outbreak is on track to become the deadliest in the DRC's history, surpassing the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. Case fatality has risen from ~20% in early June to ~48%; contact tracing improved from 30% to over 85%. About 160 health workers have been infected, ~45 have died. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; WHO pledged 70,000 Ervebo doses, with 16,250 arriving in the DRC. Response must be scaled two-threefold, with better protection for frontline workers, rapid diagnosis, and high-quality care. Some zones in Uganda and DRC have interrupted transmission; Pope Leo urged action to save lives.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ症例数が5,515人に達し、教皇レオが命を救うための世界的行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率48%・DRC史上最悪規模に達しており、IHR基準の複数該当・社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda・Angolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではUgandaは『リスクエリア』としての言及のみで実際の症例発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）。Uganda・Angolaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。既にWHO PHEIC宣言済みの深刻な流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cả nước ghi nhận hơn 3.000 ca tay chân miệng mỗi tuần, Bộ Y tế cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide records more than 3,000 hand, foot and mouth disease cases per week, Ministry of Health warns.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is circulating nationwide in Vietnam, with more than 3,000 weekly cases on average over the past four weeks, concentrated in southern provinces and large southern cities. Through the first eight months of 2026, HFMD cases total nearly 100,000, about 2.5 times higher than the corresponding period in 2025. The disease is endemic year-round, with expected increases in September–October when schools reopen and children gather. Prevention centers on the Ministry of Health’s '3 clean' guidance: clean eating, clean living, and clean hands. Practical measures include using safe water and utensils, frequent handwashing, regular cleaning of homes and classrooms, adequate handwashing facilities in nurseries, and early isolation of symptomatic children. Parents should seek medical care for fever, mouth ulcers, vesicular rashes on hands/feet, or other signs, and coordinate with local health authorities if cases cluster. Dengue fever up 1.7x; COVID-19 and rabies decline.

triage.headline_ja: 全国で週3,000件超の手足口病、保健省が警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム全国でHFMD症例が前年同期比約2.5倍に増加し、保健省が警告を発しているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: デング熱も1.7倍増加と併記されているが、記事主題はHFMD。重症度（入院・死亡数）に関する具体的記載がなく不明。学校再開に伴う9-10月の増加が懸念される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi health minister to hold meeting today as H1N1 cases rise to almost 1,800
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports H1N1 cases rising to almost 1,800, with officials noting a definite uptick and patients presenting high fever; no ICU or ventilator cases reported yet, and Delhi states there is no panic and full preparedness—beds, doctors, medicines, and equipment available. Technical guidelines on patient categorisation, treatment protocols, ventilatory management, masks, and home care have been circulated, and healthcare workers are being trained on symptoms and follow-up. Union health minister Nadda urged continued vigilance, stronger surveillance, and early clinical management to curb spread. Public guidance calls for respiratory hygiene, masking in crowds, hand hygiene, avoiding close contact with respiratory illness sufferers, and seeking medical advice rather than self-medicating. Delhi has not recorded H1N1 deaths since 2019 (31 deaths when cases reached 3,627); 2024 saw a major outbreak with no deaths. Experts cite seasonality, low influenza vaccination uptake, and early testing as contributing factors; H1N1 is an influenza-A swine-origin subtype from 2009.

triage.headline_ja: デリー保健大臣、H1N1症例が約1800人に増加する中、本日会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、保健大臣による緊急会議開催など政府・社会的関心が高まっているためフルRRA対象とする。ただし重症度・国際的異常性は低い。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の株であり、ICU・人工呼吸器症例や死亡は報告されていない。デリー州政府は十分な医療体制を確保していると表明しており、国際的な異常事態ではないが、症例数増加と行政の対応（会議開催・全国的注意喚起）から動向注視が必要。
